# Audio Visual 
Install & Service Engineer

**Location:** UK 

**Salary:** £32,000 – £45,000K Dependant on Experience

**Contract Type:** Full-Time, Permanent

**Reporting To:** Services Contract Co-ordinator/Project Manager

## Company Overview

_21st Century AV is a leading provider of cutting-edge audio visual solutions, delivering state-of-the-art technology and comprehensive support services to clients across t__he UK. Our dedication to exceptional customer service has established us as a trusted partner in the AV industry. We are currently seeking a skilled Audio Visual Engineer to join our dynamic team, responsible for managing service contract emergency callouts__,_ _planned maintenance visits__, surveys, commissioning and installations_

## Role Overview

The Audio Visual Engineer at 21st Century AV will provide on and off-site technical support to our clients, ensuring the optimal performance of audio visual systems. This role involves responding to emergency callouts, conducting scheduled maintenance visits, and managing various administrative tasks, including accurate logging and reporting. Additionally the candidate will be responsible for surveys, installs, commissioning and basic level of audio programming. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

## Key Responsibilities

#### **Emergency Callouts**

- Respond promptly to emergency service requests, providing on-site troubleshooting and repairs for audio visual systems.
- Ensure technical calls are managed within a 2-hour response time and arrive on-site within 24 hours.
- Maintain clear communication with clients and the service team regarding the status and resolution of issues.

#### **Planned Maintenance Visits (PMV)**

- Conduct regular maintenance visits as per the service contract schedule.
- Accurately log details of each visit, including serial numbers of equipment serviced, using the company’s CRM system.
- Take and maintain drawings/pictures relevant to each service contract for reference and documentation.
- Identify potential issues during maintenance visits and recommend proactive solutions.
- Provide feedback to the Service Contract Manager after each visit to ensure continuity and customer satisfaction.

#### **Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

- Provide expert technical support for a range of audio visual equipment, with a particular focus on Yealink and Logitech systems, ensuring that skills are kept up to date.
- Maintain a log of supplier and manufacturer support contacts to facilitate on-site resolutions.
- Collaborate with the internal support team to escalate and resolve complex technical issues.
- Document all service activities, including repairs, maintenance, and client interactions, in accordance with company procedures.

#### **Client Relationship Management**

- Build and maintain positive relationships with clients, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
- Provide clients with technical advice and guidance on system operation and maintenance.
- Work proactively to elevate the service contract experience for customers.
- Ensure an accurate and detailed site visit report is produced on the same day and sent to the team

#### **Site Surveys & Commissioning**

- Conduct full install and technical site surveys
- Independent installation and team installation for 21st Century AV
- Final day commissioning or training on installation works.

#### **Vehicle & Equipment Management**

- Ensure the upkeep, cleanliness, and audit compliance of the company vehicle.
- Maintain demo stock and ensure all equipment is ready and available for client demonstrations when required.
- Adhere to the company’s PPE and dress code standards for all site visits.

#### **Ad Hoc Responsibilities**

- Provide internal AV support for the office as needed.
- Continuously manage your own training and professional development to stay current with industry trends and technologies.

## Required Skills & Experience

#### **Technical Expertise:**

- Proven experience as an audio visual engineer (not just service)
- Strong understanding of audio visual systems, including installation, configuration, and maintenance, particularly with Yealink and Logitech systems.
- Proficiency in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues with AV equipment.

#### **Certifications & Qualifications:**

- Relevant technical certifications (e.g., CTS, Crestron, Extron, AMX) are highly desirable.
- Electrical or electronics engineering qualification (HNC/HND or equivalent) is advantageous.

#### **Communication & Organisational Skills:**

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical clients.
- Strong organisational skills to manage schedules, logs, and client interactions effectively.
- Strong written skills for documenting service activities and reporting.

#### **Problem-Solving Ability:**

- Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Proactive approach to identifying and solving technical issues.

### **Flexibility & Availability:**

- Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends and evenings, as required for emergency callouts.
- Valid UK driving license and willingness to travel across the UK for on-site visits.

## **Benefits:**

- Competitive salary
- Company vehicle and mobile phone.
- Pension, Medical & EAP programs
- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
- Supportive team environment with career progression prospects.

## **Application Process:**

To apply, please send your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this role to [alison@21stcenturyav.com](mailto:alison@21stcenturyav.com). Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

## **Equal Opportunity Employer:**

21st Century AV is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

This job specification is a guideline and not an exhaustive list of responsibilities and qualifications. The role may require additional duties as necessary.

The Role & Key Responsibilities

Job Title: People Relations Specialist – UK

Location: UK (with regular travel to sites across the region)

Contract and Shift details: 6 months FTC, full time

Package includes: Salary from £35,000, plus a benefits package designed to support your wellbeing and reward your impact, including discretionary performance related bonus, car allowance, private healthcare and a matched pension contribution of up to 10%

Where growth meets purpose

Rewarding your passion

About us

We’re AB Agri, part of Associated British Foods (ABF plc) and we’re passionate about feeding the world responsibly and affordably by making quality animal feed, creating nutrition and technology-based products, and offering data services for the agri-food industry. 

Application Notes

Apply today or contact our recruitment team for more information.

 ">About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Customer Solutions Engineer to join the Technical Account Management team. This role gives Abnormal a flexible, technical resource for situations that fall between standard support and a long-term, dedicated Technical Account Manager. Customer Solutions Engineers are floating technical specialists who partner with CSMs for the duration of a specific need, triggered by things like recurring support cases, asks beyond the typical support experience, or short-term project-based work. The ideal candidate combines deep technical fluency with strong triage judgment and is comfortable moving between engagements without an existing playbook.

What you will do 

• Serve as a flexible technical resource CSMs can bring into challenging or recurring account situations that a standard support case isn't built to resolve.

• Take on short-term, project-based technical engagements for customers without a dedicated TAM.

• Partner with CSMs to assess customer technical needs, join investigative or best-practices calls, and determine the right next step.

• Lead hands-on platform optimization: configuration reviews, best-practices setup, and proactive tuning that prevents issues from recurring.

• Document session recaps and next steps in the CRM so recommendations are clear to the customer and visible to the broader team.

• Advise customers on underused contracted features and flag upsell or professional services/deployment opportunities where relevant.

• Recognize when a situation exceeds this role's scope and hand it to the Critical Situation Manager or Technical Support with a clear, documented hand-off.

• Surface patterns across engagements to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to drive systemic improvement.

Must Haves 

• 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (email infrastructure, IT security/administration, engineering, or technical support) in enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity

• Solid grounding in Abnormal's platform and configuration best practices, sufficient to work independently with customers without a senior technical resource in the room

• Strong triage judgment; able to recognize quickly whether a situation calls for hands-on technical guidance or a more senior technical resource

• Comfortable stepping into a customer relationship for a defined engagement and stepping back out; this is not a standing account-ownership role

• Able to manage multiple concurrent, time-bound engagements across a broad book of business rather than a fixed set of named accounts

• Excellent communication skills across technical and business stakeholders, including comfort presenting to senior customer stakeholders

Nice to Have 

• Familiarity with email authentication/delivery protocols and cloud email platforms (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace)

• Prior experience in a floating/pooled technical resource model (e.g., professional services, deployment, or solutions engineering)

• Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience

 ">About the Role

Abnormal is growing fast, and the way we show up in the world has to keep pace. Our Strategic Events are where our story stops being a pitch and starts being an experience, where CISOs and practitioners walk in curious and walk out convinced. This role will support the strategic events programs across EMEA, including major third-party events, flagship first-party events, and high-profile executive events.

As Strategic Events Specialist, EMEA, you'll bring new ideas and experiences to how we create impact across our events program. You're someone who thrives on a great project plan, keeping deadlines tracked and on target, and managing multiple stakeholders at once across different time zones. Your communication is second to none, and you're always thinking one step ahead when it comes to delivering an event, pre-event and on-site. You understand the importance of an event running smoothly, and love learning as you go to optimise for the future.

This role is perfect for somebody looking for their next step up: a hands-on IC role where you’ll play a lead role in some of our largest flagship events across EMEA, and pitch in on general team tasks day to day. You'll run established event formats independently and apply good judgement within known processes, while leaning on your manager for guidance on new or first-of-their-kind activations. If that sounds like your kind of thing, we want to hear from you!

How You'll Deliver Impact

Project Management, Event Logistics & Vendor Management

• Support all event logistics end to end and take full ownership of numerous projects, such as creative tasks, room blocks, catering orders, swag orders, staff schedules, promotional assets, and much more.

• Help coordinate with external stakeholders, such as venues, agencies, event organisers, hotels, couriers, and many more.

• Help source agencies, venues, production partners and suppliers.

• Assist with run-of-shows, timelines and contingency plans across multiple concurrent events and markets.

• Coordinate invitation strategy, registration, attendee communications and internal promotion so the right people show up, market by market.

Regional Strategy & Portfolio Support

• Support the EMEA strategic event mapping and calendar planning, prioritising investment against pipeline and account-engagement goals.

• Share experiences and feedback on which events make most sense for our strategic events program across EMEA.

Internal Cross-Functional & Partner/Alliance Collaboration

• Build relationships with Regional Revenue Marketing, Sales, SDR/BDR, Customer Marketing, Product, Sales Engineering, Partner/Alliance Marketing and Brand/Creative across regions and time zones.

• Work closely with the Revenue Marketing Manager team to ensure Sales are fully enabled on all event details and what is expected of them.

Budget Ownership & ROI Tracking

• Support budget tracking for your owned events and the events you support.

• Suggest alternative, more cost-effective ways of doing things at events, including researching vendors and agencies for cost comparisons.

• Budget admin, including raising purchase orders, submitting invoices, and updating budget management tools.

On-Site Execution

• Lead on-site at your own events, including training other on-site team members and coordinating and leading staff orientations.

• Support on-site execution for flagship regional events, directing any temporary or contract event staff and troubleshooting in real time.

• Set clear expectations on-site for all teams by hosting staff orientations virtually and in person 

Post-Event Follow-Up & Program Result Accountability

• Post-event admin, including list uploads and sending post-event reports.

• Help build repeatable regional playbooks and share best practice with peers across the broader Strategic Events team, including other regions 

• Run post-event retrospectives and apply lessons learned to improve the next event, raising the bar for the regional program as it scales

• Ensure tight alignment with regional teams to ensure full ROI of event is realised, by sharing regular lead status update reports 

What You Bring

• 2–4 years' experience in B2B events or experiential marketing, ideally within technology, SaaS, cybersecurity or enterprise software.

• Experience of owning established, repeatable event formats end-to-end — not just coordinating logistics for someone else's plan — with sound judgement on known procedures and a willingness to ask for guidance on new or first-of-their-kind activations.

• Experience running executive-level programmes (dinners, roundtables, advisory boards) as well as larger conference/trade show activations.

• Multi-market EMEA experience and the ability to work across different time zones and regions.

• Strong program management habits: organised, deadline-driven, and increasingly independent on routine work.

• Budget, vendor and contract management experience across multiple concurrent workstreams.

• Confidence working cross-functionally with Sales, SDR/BDR and Marketing stakeholders, and translating event activity into commercial outcomes.

• Comfortable presenting event results and ROI to stakeholders using registration, pipeline and engagement data.

• Willingness to travel roughly 40–50%, mainly across EMEA, with some APAC and AMER travel, including evening/weekend work around live events.

Cybersecurity or enterprise software experience is a plus, not a requirement. What matters is commercial judgement, regional ownership, and exceptional execution.

Preferred

• Experience with event and marketing technology such as Asana, Allocadia, Coupa, Jifflenow, Cvent, Salesforce, Sigma, Splash, RainFocus, Claude, and Google Suite.

• An additional European language.

• Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) principles and target-account event strategies.

The Ideal Candidate

You know a great event is not a logistics exercise. It's a story told in three dimensions — one that brings a brand to life, earns trust with prospects and customers, arms the sales team, and produces measurable business impact.

You're equally at home building a project plan in a spreadsheet and troubleshooting a badge-printer jam at 7am. You're calm when things go sideways, direct when something isn't working, and generous with your stakeholders when it goes right.

Most of all, you care about the craft. The details other people don't notice are exactly the ones you fix.

What Success Looks Like

• Your events are delivered flawlessly and consistently

• Registrations, attendance, meetings and pipeline consistently hit or beat plan for the events you own.

• Budgets and vendor relationships are managed with discipline and transparency.

• Every event has a clear measurement story and a defensible ROI.

• Build a continuous knowledge base of industry and account insights as well as market changes and potential business opportunities.

• Lead a best-in-class structured sales process leveraging all value adding capabilities across the international organization.
• 3-5 years of net new sales experience in machinery and equipment manufacturing, electronic & high tech manufacturing, defense, aviation, plastic products and other industrial manufacturing industries and understand their challenges to be able to do value selling.

Infor is looking for an experienced and commercially driven Account Manager to join our Hospitality sales organization in EMEA. This role is focused primarily on creating and closing net-new business across Europe, helping hospitality organizations modernize operations, improve commercial performance, and deliver stronger guest experiences through industry-specific cloud solutions.

This is a high-impact, entrepreneurial position for a seller who enjoys building a market, developing senior relationships, and navigating complex enterprise sales cycles. • Revenue management and optimization
• Financial management, budgeting, forecasting, and planning
• Event, conference, and function-space management
• Workforce management and operational solutions
• Emerging AI-enabled capabilities for the hospitality ecosystem

• Develop and execute a focused business development strategy across selected European hospitality markets.
• Create a healthy, qualified pipeline through disciplined prospecting, industry networking, referrals, partners, consultants, trade events, and collaboration with Business Development Representatives.
• Identify and engage hotel operators, management companies, hospitality groups, and other relevant organizations.
• Lead the full sales cycle, from initial outreach and discovery through solution alignment, proposal, negotiation, and contract signature.
• Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, including CFOs, revenue leaders, IT leaders, operations executives, and other business decision-makers.

• Maintain accurate opportunity plans, pipeline coverage, forecasts, and next actions.
• Retain strategic ownership of customer relationships after the initial sale while working with Inside Sales on smaller expansion opportunities.
• Achieve or exceed agreed revenue, pipeline, and new-business targets.

• A strong hunter mindset, with clear evidence of independently generating and converting net-new opportunities.
• Experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing strategic deals.
• Ability to build credibility with executive and functional decision-makers.
• Strong discovery, presentation, commercial negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
• Confidence operating independently across markets while mobilizing internal specialists and partners.
• Fluent written and spoken English.
• Willingness and ability to travel regularly within Europe.

• Experience selling technology into hotels, hospitality groups, travel, leisure, or an adjacent industry.
• Understanding of hotel operations, hotel ownership and management structures, property management, revenue management, hospitality finance, or guest technology.
• An established network among hospitality operators, consultants, technology partners, or industry decision-makers.
• Additional European language skills, particularly for markets where local-language selling is important.
• At least three years of relevant sales experience, with the maturity to become productive quickly in a complex environment.

What success looks like
· Consistent creation of high-quality, self-generated pipeline.
· Strong pipeline coverage aligned with annual revenue goals.
· New customer acquisition and signed software agreements.
· Trusted relationships with hospitality decision-makers, influencers, consultants, and partners.
· Effective management of both shorter-term opportunities and strategic pursuits that may develop over several years.
· Growing market visibility for Infor Hospitality across Europe.

We have our own, bespoke City and Guilds accredited training centre.  Last year, we delivered training to 117 engineers on service and maintenance, commissioning, brazing, refrigeration, water chillers, and more.

· Excellent training opportunities.

· 25 days holiday per annum, plus bank holidays, increasing with service.

· Engineers take turns to be on standby for out-of-hours calls and are paid a standby allowance plus overtime if they are called out.

Financial and Regulatory Stewardship

• Ensure compliance with company guidelines, statutory requirements, and regulatory standards across all applicable jurisdictions.

Customer and Stakeholder Management

• Build strong working relationships with insureds, brokers, claimants, attorneys, and internal stakeholders.
• Communicate claim status, strategy, and exposure effectively to management and business partners.

• Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• 4+ years of Commercial Auto Liability and/or Commercial General Liability claims handling experience.
• Demonstrated experience handling bodily injury claims involving moderate to significant exposure.
• Experience interpreting policy coverage and drafting coverage position letters, reservation of rights letters, and denial letters.
• Experience managing both litigated and non-litigated claims.
• Excellent analytical, investigative, and critical-thinking skills.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Active Property & Casualty Adjuster License preferred; must obtain required state licensing within six months of hire.

About the Role
We are looking for a Network Automation Engineer to help build and scale automation across our enterprise network environment. You’ll combine strong networking knowledge with software and automation skills to reduce manual work, improve network reliability, and enable API-driven operations. A key part of the role will be developing and operating our Network Source of Truth (SSoT/NSoT) using Nautobot, and integrating it with network infrastructure, automation, observability, and other enterprise platforms. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving real network problems with Python, APIs, Ansible, Git, and modern automation practices, not simply administering network devices.

What Success Looks Like
Requirements
• Design and build network automation for provisioning, configuration, validation, migrations, and operational workflows.
• Help lead the implementation and ongoing development of Nautobot as the Network Source of Truth.
• Integrate Nautobot and other network platforms using REST APIs, GraphQL, and Python.
• Develop reusable automation using Python, Ansible, Jinja2, Terraform, and related technologies.
• Automate synchronization and validation of network inventory, IPAM, configuration, and operational data.
• Build automated pre-change and post-change validation to make network changes safer and more reliable.
• Apply Git, CI/CD, testing, and Infrastructure as Code practices to network automation.
• Integrate automation with network management, observability, and enterprise platforms.
• Troubleshoot complex issues spanning networks, automation, APIs, and data.
• Partner with network architects, engineering and operations teams to identify opportunities for automation and improve how the network is operated.
• Evaluate and prototype emerging network automation technologies and capabilities.

Qualifications
• 7+ years of network engineering, network automation, or related experience in large enterprise environments.
• Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing and switching, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and IPAM.
• Strong Python development or scripting skills.
• Hands-on experience with Ansible or similar automation platforms.
• Experience building integrations using REST APIs and working with JSON/YAML.
• Experience with a network Source of Truth, IPAM, DCIM, or inventory platform, ideally Nautobot or NetBox.
• Experience with Git and CI/CD practices.
• Experience automating network technologies from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, F5, or similar.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, architecture, operations, and technology teams.

Preferred Skills
• Hands-on experience developing Nautobot Jobs, Apps/plugins, APIs, GraphQL integrations, or data models.
• Experience with NetBox, Nornir, Netmiko, NAPALM, pyATS, Jinja2, or similar automation technologies.
• Familiarity with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
• Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and Linux environments.
• Cloud networking experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Knowledge of VXLAN/EVPN, controller-based networking, intent-based networking, or SDN.
• Relevant Cisco, Juniper, DevNet, cloud, or automation certifications.

You’ll help move network operations from manual, device-by-device processes toward automated, data-driven workflows, with Nautobot serving as a trusted source of network data and APIs, automation, validation, and CI/CD providing the foundation for scalable network operations.

The Community You Will Join

The Cities team leads the work necessary to implement the regulatory products and processes needed globally to comply with regulations, and does so in a manner that also sustainably supports Airbnb's growth.

Within Cities, this role owns Airbnb's platform regulatory compliance program across EMEA — the growing set of EU and UK obligations that sit alongside, and increasingly beyond, short-term rental regulation.

The Difference You Will Make

As Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA, you are the accountable owner for a portfolio of platform regulations that is expanding in scope, scrutiny, and consequence — including the Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act, and more.

You will translate each obligation into a durable operating process, a defensible reporting methodology, or a product change — and serve as a trusted advisor to Legal, Policy, and Product leadership on how Airbnb meets its regulatory commitments in the region.

A Typical Day: 

• Own the EMEA compliance portfolio. Establish the operating processes and documentation that sustain obligations at scale, and report and monitor status and risk.

• Deliver regulatory reporting and submissions. Own the annual and ad hoc reporting calendar end to end. Deliver against regulatory deadlines, and iterate so each cycle is faster and more defensible than the last.

• Assess obligations and strengthen assurance. Identify new and changing obligations early, evaluate our readiness against them, and recommend the measures required to meet them. 

• Translate regulatory requirements into scalable solutions. Define the product, engineering, and data requirements needed to meet obligations at scale, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap, sequence delivery, and validate outcomes against compliance standards.

Your Expertise: 

• 12+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, compliance program management, or regulatory operations — preferably in a technology platform or another highly regulated industry.

• Proven track record owning a multi-jurisdiction, cross-functional compliance program end to end, with direct experience across the Digital Services Act, and the UK Online Safety Act. 

• Hands-on experience with a recurring regulator-facing reporting cycle and the relationship management that comes with it.

As a Founding Software Engineer, you'll help build the next generation of AI agents for the physical world. We're building systems that turn unstructured emails, documents, messages and enterprise data into reliable, autonomous workflows that take actions on behalf of our customers. job_title: Solution Director - AI Change and Transformation
job_description:
We’re on a mission to close the world’s tech skills gap. 

We help organisations navigate the future of technology, combining human expertise, emerging tech and AI to deliver better outcomes, faster. Since 2014, we’ve worked side-by-side with clients to solve complex challenges, build high-performing teams, and create lasting capability. As technology continues to evolve, we believe the most successful organisations will be those that combine the best of both: human ingenuity AND intelligent technology.

That belief is embedded in everything we do. We call it the genius of the AND: deep expertise AND practical delivery, innovation AND responsibility, ambitious work AND sustainable careers.Through our Guide, Build and Equip approach, we help organisations embrace change, deliver meaningful impact, and develop the skills they need to thrive in an increasingly agentic world.

**About you:**

- You care deeply about producing high-quality work that delivers real value.
- You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and solving complex problems collaboratively.
- You bring strong expertise in your craft, alongside a willingness to keep learning.
- You communicate clearly and build trust quickly with clients and teammates.
- You’re pragmatic, adaptable and outcome-focused.
- You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others grow.
- You value low-ego collaboration and enjoy working as part of multidisciplinary teams.

As a Change and Transformation Solution Director you will work with clients to design and deliver the meaningful changes needed to successfully assess, consult, recommend and accelerate their AI transformation.  You will also be closely aligned to AND Digital’s AI, automation and intelligent systems practice, contributing and enhancing our AI transformation offer and taking those to market.  You will be comfortable speaking publicly about AND’s AI-based ambitions, attending events and representing the business at networking opportunities.

**As a result, you will need to be able to:**

- Manage a client engagement to deliver all aspects required through discussions with clients (not just following a specified statement of work).
- Act as a trusted advisor to C-suite and Director-level stakeholders, influencing their AI strategy, organisational design, change or transformation plans to improve delivery and strategic execution.
- Assess a client’s current state and work with them to envision their future in order to deliver on their AI ambitions and plot a path towards an AI-enabled future.
- Design new ways of working, including how digital, data, AI operates alongside other business functions, and how those other functions can themselves become more technology-led.
- Develop new and innovative thinking, creating programmes of work and consulting engagements that drive out business innovation and opportunities.
- Lead the compilation of compelling commercial / business cases to help our clients understand the value AND and the proposed changes can bring to the business.
- Transition organisations to new technology-led ways of working, through effective planning, communications and change management.

- Work with AND colleagues to engage senior executives, both inside and outside of IT / Technology / Digital, to help their understanding of AI and the need for change.
- Get ‘hands on’ with the work and produce the required outputs and outcomes.
- Help grow the regional ‘Club’ as part of the Leadership team via internal initiatives such as proposition development, thought leadership and team engagement.
- Apply a commercial mindset throughout engagements and support account development plans with Client Partners. 
- Be responsible for identifying further opportunities for AND Digital to support our clients, in order for them to be successful.
- Contribute to the revenue and financial success of the regional ‘Club’ through successful client engagements and the onboarding of new business and opportunities. 

**To do that, it’s essential you bring the following:**

- Formal consulting, professional services, or digital transformation experience, and involvement in effectively delivering change within a range of organisations.
- Good understanding of effective modern, technology-led organisations and what makes them different. Able to affect impactful change.
- Knowledge and strong appreciation of digital delivery - particularly Strategy, Product, AI, Technology, Delivery and People implications, backed up with your own insights and points of view.
- Ability to influence stakeholders with a recommended digital and AI -based transformation approach.
- Be comfortable in moving between various client assignments.
- Passion for delivering the required change for our clients in often complex, ambiguous circumstances.
- Demonstrable experience of deploying AI into your ways of working 

- Demonstrated ability in consulting clients and/or implementing internal change within an organisation in the adoption of AI into the operations / workflows within the business.

**It’s helpful if you also have:**

- A breadth and depth of consulting expertise, including business development, gained at a recognised consulting firm and and/or agency-based environment. I.e. experience of responding to RFPs, creating sales-based presentations and presenting to senior client teams.
- Experience in a role developing digital or product strategy and delivering commercial value.
- Enthusiasm to learn and develop your skills as a technology consultant and to share your expertise with those around you.
- Outstanding written and oral communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Relationship building skills, the ability to develop and maintain peer relationships with clients.
- Ability to spot opportunities to expand existing client relationships at a Club level.
- The flexibility to contribute to different types of engagement depending on the client problem we are helping with.

**Why join AND Digital?**

We’re building a culture where talented people can do meaningful work, continue growing, AND enjoy the journey along the way.

Our model is designed to build belonging and connection: we’re organised into regional ‘Clubs’ of no more than 80 people, so you (and our clients) get the benefits of that small company feel while also being connected to a larger whole.

Our Practice Areas act as a ‘second home’ for our ANDis - a place where you can innovate and learn with like-minded experts who care deeply about their craft, support each other generously, and believe the best ideas come from collaboration, not hierarchy.

Our culture is rooted in our values of Wonder, Share and Delight, and shows up through five traits that we celebrate and nurture in all our ANDis: we value curiosity, ambition and a growth-mindset. We are deeply client-centric. Most important of all we are human - we create an inclusive environment where people feel trusted, supported and able to be themselves.

**By joining AND, we’ll provide:**

- 25 days bookable holiday + flexible Bank Holidays 
- Pension: 6% of salary paid by AND Digital with a further 2% paid by you (can be increased by choice).
- Aviva healthcare cover (including pre-existing condition cover) for you.
- Flexibenefit: £1000 assigned to you via our benefits portal to select or upgrade the benefits that suit you the most. Any unused allowance from the £1000 can be taken as cash. 
- Life Assurance.
- Income Protection.
- Eye test + first pair of glasses.
- Parental Benefits: Generous Enhanced Maternity and Enhanced Partner (Paternity) Leave.

**AI Statement**

We champion tech that helps people work smarter, but we want to get to know you! If you use AI to assist with your application or interview prep, please ensure all information submitted remains an accurate, truthful representation of your personal achievements and capabilities rather than generating false or misleading information. We may reject applications where AI is used inappropriately at any stage of the recruitment process. 

**Equal Opportunities Statement**

Diversity and inclusion are hugely important to us, and we’re committed to providing equal opportunities for all. We’re actively recruiting for a diverse and inclusive workforce so want to ensure we do everything we can to support your application.

We want you to feel safe and empowered to let us know if you need any adjustments to be made to your application or interview process, so please speak to our recruitment team.

At Revolt we build brands the world wants more of. 
Revolt is a global brand communications agency specialising in positive impact, working with major brands, fast‑growing businesses and NGOs.

Sat at the intersection of brand communications, impact and business, we help brands build their corporate reputations, brand equity and internal culture. 

We operate like a hybrid between a strategy consultancy and a creative agency: intellectually rigorous, creatively ambitious, and values‑driven

Revolt is part of Anthesis, the world's leading specialist in sustainability, meaning everything we do is backed by substance and technical rigour.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Associate Strategy Director to join our Brand & Communications team. In this role, you will lead the development of sustainability narratives, messaging frameworks and creative communications strategies for global clients across topics such as climate, nature, circularity and regenerative agriculture.

You will combine research, insights and strategic thinking to help clients solve complex challenges through compelling brand and communications strategies. Working with multidisciplinary teams, you will lead projects independently, build trusted client relationships and contribute to business growth and thought leadership.

This role is ideal for someone with a background in sustainability communications, brand strategy, communications planning or strategic consulting, who can translate complex sustainability topics into engaging narratives, campaigns and creative propositions.

Client Strategy & Project Leadership
• Lead strategic workstreams and manage projects end-to-end with minimal supervision.

• Develop positioning platforms, sustainability narratives, messaging frameworks, campaign strategies and creative territories.
• Create clear, compelling and commercially impactful strategic recommendations that address client challenges.
• Present strategic thinking confidently to clients, facilitating discussions and responding effectively to feedback and questions.
• Collaborate with creative, account management and subject matter expert teams to translate strategy into impactful communications outputs.
Client Relationships
• Build trusted relationships with clients through strong strategic counsel and project leadership.
• Navigate complex conversations and manage stakeholder expectations effectively.
• Support client growth by identifying opportunities for additional strategic support and services.
Team Leadership
• Support and mentor junior strategists and consultants through effective briefing, delegation and coaching.
• Contribute to building a high-performing strategy team by sharing knowledge, approaches and best practices.
• Help drive strategic excellence across projects and encourage innovative thinking within the team.
New Business & Commercial Growth
• Support and lead strategic input into proposals, pitches and new business conversations.
• Define compelling narratives and proposition stories for prospective clients.
• Contribute to scopes of work, project approaches and strategic methodologies.
• Identify opportunities to improve project delivery, strategic outputs and team processes.
Thought Leadership
• Regularly contribute articles, reports, opinion pieces and industry commentary.
• Stay informed on emerging sustainability, communications and cultural trends.
• Represent the team externally where appropriate through events, webinars and industry forums.

• 5-8 years' experience in strategy, brand consulting, communications planning, sustainability communications or a related field.

job_title: Global Lead for Net Zero and Decarbonisation
job_description:
The Global Lead for Net Zero and Decarbonisation is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the global strategy, growth agenda, and market positioning of Anthesis' decarbonisation offering, ensuring a clear and differentiated proposition that connects client demand with technical expertise. 

The role drives commercial success through business development, flagship client engagement, go-to-market leadership, and revenue growth, while also leading innovation, thought leadership, and the evolution of services in response to changing market and regulatory requirements. 

Working as part of the Global Business Line Leadership Team, the role influences and coordinates teams across regions to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery, support talent development and strategic hiring, and strengthen collaboration across Anthesis' global network. 

Success is measured through revenue growth, new business generation, strategic client expansion, thought leadership impact, service innovation, and the delivery of a clear long-term growth strategy for the decarbonisation business.

Strategic Direction & Oversight (20%)

Global “Center of Expertise” Strategy Development
• Connect client demand with technical expertise to shape the global solution strategy and provide clarity on where Anthesis can successfully compete and differentiate.
Integrated Value Proposition
• Collaborate closely with other Climate & Nature GSLLs to maximize the client value proposition and demonstrate the strength of One Anthesis.
Regional Interpretation
• Keep the “Center of Expertise” market opportunity at the forefront of regional leadership discussions by sharing successes, challenges, and emerging opportunities to accelerate growth.
• Partner with regional teams to support the development and execution of growth plans.
Commercial Success (30%)

Flagship Client Cultivation
• Take a hands-on role in securing 5–10 flagship client engagements and support teams in identifying and pursuing subsequent phases of the client journey.
Go-to-Market
• Lead the global go-to-market strategy by: • Staying abreast of market drivers, emerging issues, and regulatory developments.
• Framing and contextualizing value propositions in response to evolving client needs.
• Developing and refining service offerings that resonate with clients.
• Testing offerings to assess both risk and value-creation opportunities.

Regional Client Engagement
• Translate, position, and promote “Center of Expertise” service offerings to Key Clients and high-growth/high-value accounts across the North America region.
Innovation & Thought Leadership (30%)

Solution & Service Innovation
• Lead innovation across the “Center of Expertise” portfolio, including new or enhanced service offerings, digital products, and market- or sector-specific adaptations that respond to client needs and market developments.
Thought Leadership
• Strengthen Anthesis’ global market presence by generating thought leadership on emerging issues, technical insights, and innovative delivery approaches.
• Increase visibility through proactive speaking engagements, publications, media opportunities, and industry participation.
Solutions Enablement (20%)

Solution Growth
• Support business growth by helping operations recruit, develop, and retain the required expertise, including building a pipeline of strategic hires and acquisitions, and supporting their successful integration into Anthesis.
Global Consistency & Quality
• Partner with “Center of Expertise” technical leads across regions to drive global consistency and quality, enhancing client satisfaction through: • Engaging technical communities to address delivery challenges and share learnings.
• Designing and implementing upskilling initiatives based on client needs and workforce capabilities.
• Promoting the sharing of best practices, lessons learned, and proven tools and approaches.
• Equipping regional teams with evolving value propositions and marketing collateral to support service campaigns.

• 15–20 years of experience, combining a strong commercial and sustainability background.
• Global perspective, supported by relevant international experience.
• Reporting line: reports to the Global Business Line Lead and works in close collaboration with Regional Line Leaders (RLLs).
• Position within the organisation: member of the Global Business Line Leadership Team.
• Management scope: responsible for cross-functional team coordination, driving alignment and influence across stakeholders without direct authority.

As a Principal Consultant in our Strategy and Transformation team, you will be client-focused, leading, project managing and supporting projects that allow organizations to develop and implement sustainability strategies. You will be an experienced sustainability practitioner, with fluency across topics and expertise in specific areas. You will be well-versed in sustainability strategy development, have strong commercial acumen and significant transformation-related expertise. 

This should include experience of operating model design, change management and implementation of large transformation programmes, preferably in a sustainability context. You will be meticulous on the details, but also get the wider picture – providing an informed market view and an ability to articulate business value and benefits. 

Alongside this, you will contribute to our long-term growth through supporting the development of our market proposition, line management responsibilities and business development.

(Note: We are welcoming applicants based in London and Dublin for this role)

Client & Project Delivery – 65% of time
• Project Management – managing the delivery of agreed consulting engagements / projects on time, on budget, and to high standards of quality.
• Deliverable Drafting & Presentation – preparing and delivering high quality reports, presentations, and workshops in line with project scope. 
• Expert input and QA – reviewing project work and providing expert viewpoint and quality assurance on deliverables. 
• Client Relationship Building – earning the confidence and trust of client teams, and representing our direct clients’ interests effectively inside their organisations. 
Business Development – 20% of time 
• Service development - contributing to the development of our strategy and transformation service offerings and/or streamlining and improving existing service offerings including creating delivery and proposal templates, providing training and acting as internal expert on strategy and transformation programmes. 
• Key Account Development – helping to guide and support deeper and longer-term partnerships with valuable and impactful clients over time. 
• Proposal / Bid Writing & Presentation – discussing, framing, designing, pricing and presenting project proposals (with the guidance and support of colleagues) 
• Thought Leadership & Marketing – supporting the team and wider business in lead generation and brand-building through the creation of IP and marketing materials 
Organisational & Personal Development – 15% of time 
• Training & Personal Development – using the ACE (Anthesis Centre of Excellence) learning and development platform, and guided by your line manager. Line Management – supporting more junior colleagues to guide and manage their growth and performance within Anthesis. 
• Strategic & Organisational Initiatives – contributing to important internal initiatives, proposition development and innovation. Recruitment – contributing to growing the team through recruitment.

We believe that great contributors can come from various backgrounds, and we welcome those shifting into the sustainability space from adjacent fields. As guidance, at this level, we’d typically look for: 
• 6+ years experience in strategy / transformation consulting from a leading management or sustainability consultancy. 
• Or 7+ years’ experience in-house, in a related organisational function / field, where strategy development and implementation was part of role. 
• Fluency across multiple sustainability topics, with expertise in specific areas (e.g. climate, circularity).
• Operating model design and large programme implementation experience are essential.
• Understanding and experience of applying best-practice strategy and transformation frameworks, and change management approaches.
• Experience in sustainability governance and progress management desirable Ability to understand commercial data sets, develop financial models and build sustainability-linked business cases.
• Confidence in talking to Board level stakeholders including CFOs and financial professionals in client organisations. 
• Extensive sustainability network in UK / EMEA and demonstrated success in proactively building pipeline and growing accounts.
• Strong working familiarity with MS Office Suite is required, with high levels of numeracy and strong Excel skills preferred. 
• Previous experience with working on corporate purpose programmes is a nice-to-have.
• Fluency in AI and ability to embed AI usage in internal and client-facing work.

We are looking for an exceptional Principal Consultant with deep expertise in Life Cycle Assessment and the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, as well as a track record of strategic service-line leadership and commercial growth. (Note: We are welcoming applicants based in the UK and EMEA for this role.) 
This is a senior, client-facing role combining technical leadership, project delivery, business development and strategic growth. You will lead complex LCA and CBAM engagements, act as Anthesis’s lead consultant for CBAM work, and help clients understand and respond to the rapidly evolving commercial and regulatory landscape. Just as importantly, you will help grow our business. 

This role is suited to an entrepreneurial sustainability innovator who can move comfortably between detailed technical analysis, senior client conversations and strategic business-building. 

Why this role exists: LCA and product carbon footprinting are becoming increasingly important to corporate decision-making, regulatory compliance, product strategy and value-chain decarbonisation. 

At the same time, EU CBAM is moving from a reporting obligation into a material financial and operational issue, while other countries look to implement similar poligies. Importers and suppliers need to understand their exposure, improve the quality of their emissions data, engage complex supply chains and make decisions about sourcing, product design, pricing and investment. 

Anthesis has established technical capabilities, client relationships and delivery experience in both areas. We are now looking for a senior consultant who can lead high-quality delivery while helping us turn these capabilities into a stronger, more scalable and commercially successful offering.

• Lead CBAM projects and technical delivery: Lead Anthesis’s CBAM service, maintaining a detailed and continuously updated understanding of the regulation, its implementation and its implications for importers and non-EU suppliers. 
• Lead complex CBAM engagements, including exposure assessments, embedded-emissions calculations, supplier data collection, emissions reporting, cost modelling, implementation planning and strategic advice. 
• Translate regulatory developments into clear, practical guidance for clients, helping them understand not only their compliance obligations but the wider commercial, procurement and supply-chain implications. 
• Maintain a forward-looking perspective on likely regulatory developments, implementation challenges, market responses and emerging client needs. 
• Lead LCA and product-footprinting engagements: Lead the technical design of a broad range of LCA, product carbon footprinting and related analytical projects, providing project leadership throughout. 
• Select appropriate methodologies, system boundaries, data sources, assumptions and modelling approaches, ensuring that outputs are technically robust, transparent and appropriate for the client’s intended use. 
• Oversee modelling in SimaPro, review technical work completed by other team members and maintain consistently high standards of quality. 
• Apply LCA findings to real-world business decisions, including product strategy, eco-design, procurement, supply-chain decarbonisation, regulatory compliance and commercial positioning. 
• Create trusted client partnerships Build a strong understanding of clients’ operations, commercial pressures, value chains and strategic priorities. 
• Turn complex technical and regulatory issues into clear, decision-useful insights for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
• Act as a trusted senior adviser, confidently leading client meetings, workshops and executive-level presentations.
• Develop strong, long-term client relationships and proactively identify opportunities to extend Anthesis’s support. 
• Win high-quality work Lead business-development conversations across LCA and CBAM, from initial opportunity identification through to proposal development, presentation and contract award. 
• Diagnose what the client actually needs rather than simply responding to the initial request. 
• Develop clear, differentiated and commercially compelling proposals, bringing together the right technical scope, delivery model, team and pricing approach. 
• Work with colleagues across sectors, regions and business lines to identify opportunities, develop integrated propositions and convert existing relationships into new work. 
• Drive strategic and commercial growth Lead the development and execution of the go-to-market plan for Anthesis’s CBAM offering, with additional responsibility for supporting growth across the wider LCA portfolio. 
• Assess market trends, regulatory developments, competitor activity and client feedback to identify priority markets, client segments and service opportunities. 
• Develop practical growth initiatives, including targeted campaigns, client propositions, thought-leadership activity, partnerships, events and sales-enablement materials. 
• Help evolve Anthesis’s CBAM offer beyond individual advisory projects towards scalable programmes, managed services, digital tools and recurring client relationships. 
• Track pipeline, sales performance and market response, adapting the growth plan based on evidence and results. 
• The strategic component should remain prominent: the role needs someone who can spot market opportunities, develop the offering and successfully commercialise it, rather than focusing exclusively on project delivery.
• Lead projects, teams and quality Provide strong project leadership across complex, multidisciplinary engagements, ensuring that scope, budget, timelines, risks and client expectations are actively managed. 
• Lead project teams with clarity and confidence, delegating effectively while remaining accountable for overall quality and delivery. 
• Coach and support consultants, helping strengthen technical capability, commercial confidence and client-management skills across the wider team. 
• Contribute to the development of consistent methodologies, templates, quality controls and efficient delivery approaches. 
• Communicate with impact Turn detailed regulatory and technical analysis into compelling stories with clear commercial relevance. 
• Produce concise, persuasive reports, presentations, proposals and thought-leadership materials. 
• Represent Anthesis in webinars, conferences, client events and other external forums. 
• Communicate with sufficient technical authority to engage LCA specialists and regulatory experts, while making the implications understandable and actionable for procurement, finance, sustainability and executive audiences.

Non-negotiable: 
• Strong practical knowledge of the EU CBAM Regulation, including its technical requirements, business implications, implementation challenges and likely future development. 
• Extensive professional experience conducting and leading a broad range of Life Cycle Assessments and product carbon footprints. 
• Excellent practical understanding of LCA standards, methodologies, data quality, modelling choices and interpretation. 
• Advanced experience using SimaPro. 
• Demonstrable experience leading complex consulting projects and multidisciplinary project teams. 
• Excellent client-management skills, including experience advising senior stakeholders and managing challenging client situations. 
• Strong business-development capability, with a track record of understanding client needs, developing compelling proposals and converting opportunities into work. 
• Strong strategic and commercial judgement, including experience developing propositions, go-to-market plans, campaigns or other structured growth initiatives. 
• Ability to translate robust technical analysis into clear recommendations and commercially relevant stories that drive action. 
• Excellent written and verbal English. 
Strong preferences: 
• Experience delivering CBAM work for both EU importers and non-EU producers or suppliers. 
• Experience with supplier engagement, primary-data collection and product or installation-level emissions calculations. 
• Experience developing or scaling new consulting propositions or service lines. 
• Familiarity with digital LCA, carbon-accounting or supply-chain data tools. 
• Experience working in a professional-services or sustainability-consulting environment, with an understanding of project profitability, utilisation, pipeline management and revenue growth. 
• Relevant postgraduate qualification in LCA, environmental science, engineering, sustainability, carbon management or a related discipline. 
• An additional European language.

Anthesis is seeking a Sustainability Data Expert to join our Circularity and Value Chain Transformation team. (Note: We are welcoming applicants based in the UK and EMEA for this role.) 

This role is critical in helping clients transform complex sustainability, packaging, product, waste, and regulatory data into meaningful insights that support compliance, business decision-making, and sustainability outcomes. 

As a senior technical specialist, you will combine sustainability expertise with advanced analytical capabilities to manage, analyse, and interpret large and complex datasets. 

You will develop robust methodologies, perform complex calculations, oversee data quality and assurance processes, and support clients in understanding the story behind their data. 
A significant proportion of the role will focus on regulatory compliance requirements, including Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR), the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), and other sustainability reporting obligations. 

Working closely with clients and project teams, you will ensure analytical outputs are accurate, auditable, and defensible while communicating complex findings in a clear, concise, and actionable manner. You will also play a key role in mentoring team members, setting technical standards, and building capability across the wider team.

• Lead the analysis of large, complex sustainability datasets, delivering robust, high-quality outputs that support client decision-making and regulatory compliance.
• Design and execute complex calculations, methodologies, and analytical approaches tailored to specific client needs, using tools such as Alteryx, Excel, Power Query, Power BI, and other analytical platforms. 
• Manage data collection, cleansing, validation, transformation, and interpretation processes to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability. 
• Develop and maintain transparent methodologies, assumptions, calculation logic, and audit trails that support accurate reporting and regulatory submissions. 
• Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and quality issues, implementing practical solutions and clearly documenting assumptions where data limitations exist. 
• Support clients with compliance and reporting requirements related to EPR, PPWR, and other sustainability regulations, ensuring analytical outputs are robust, traceable, and defensible. 
• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, translating complex analytical outputs into clear and compelling insights that inform strategic decisions. 
• Produce high-quality reports, presentations, dashboards, and visualisations that communicate the key messages behind the data to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
• Provide technical leadership across projects, overseeing the work of more junior members of the team to ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality. 
• Establish and maintain analytical standards, methodologies, quality assurance procedures, and best practices across the team. 
• Mentor and train colleagues, contributing to capability building and continuous improvement in sustainability data analysis and reporting. 
• Support business development activities through technical input into proposals, client discussions, and the evolution of Anthesis' sustainability data and analytics services.

• Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Master's degree desirable. 
• Senior Consultant: typically 5–8 years of relevant experience. 
• Principal Consultant: typically 8–12+ years of relevant experience. 
• Proven experience working with sustainability data, ideally including packaging, product, material composition, waste, recycling, circular economy, resource management, or regulatory reporting datasets. 
• Demonstrated ability to analyse and interpret large, complex datasets and apply advanced analytical techniques to solve client challenges. 
• Significant experience using Excel, Alteryx, Power Query, and similar tools to perform complex calculations, data transformation, validation, quality checks, and reporting. 
• Experience developing robust methodologies, assumptions, and analytical frameworks that ensure accuracy, consistency, and auditability. 
• Strong understanding of data governance, data quality management, and analytical quality assurance practices. 
• Experience supporting clients with sustainability reporting and regulatory compliance requirements, particularly EPR, PPWR, or related sustainability regulations. 
• Ability to evaluate data quality, identify gaps and limitations, and develop pragmatic approaches for dealing with incomplete or imperfect datasets while maintaining technical rigour and transparency. 
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical analysis into concise, engaging, and actionable insights for clients. 
• Proven experience managing projects, leading technical workstreams, and delivering high-quality outputs within commercial timelines. 
• Experience mentoring, training, and overseeing junior team members, including reviewing work, setting standards, and driving technical excellence across teams.

job_title: Customer Success Manager, Beneficial Deployments EMEA
job_description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Join Anthropic as an EMEA-based Customer Success Manager supporting our Beneficial Deployments team's work with nonprofits. You'll be a strategic partner and trusted advisor to mission-driven organizations across EMEA, spanning a range of impact areas. Your focus is driving activation, adoption, and value of Claude across Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and the API. That means helping these organizations evolve how they work internally, and guiding them as they evolve how they serve their missions and constituents with AI.

You'll work as a pod with your Account Executive and Applied AI counterpart. Within the pod, you'll decide what level of engagement each customer most needs and either personally deliver it or connect the customer to resources that serve their needs. CS-led engagements range from high-touch 1:1 partnerships to one-to-many cohort engagements, with the latitude to design other approaches where they serve customers better.

As one of our early Customer Success Managers in EMEA, you'll be a pioneer: helping to build regional processes, establish new customer relationships, and represent Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market. You'll operate with significant autonomy while staying closely aligned with global teams, which calls for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and works effectively across time zones.

The insights you gather from these partnerships will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and strategies for beneficial AI deployment. As the voice of the customer, you'll help shape how we build and deliver AI systems that amplify social good.

Key responsibilities

• 
Work as a pod with your Account Executive and Applied AI counterpart, building shared territory and success plans

•

Remote, UK

About the Role

The Senior Incident Response Forensic Analyst is a highly technical member of Digital Forensics and Incident Response (“DFIR”) team. The Senior Forensic Analyst is responsible for conducting forensic investigations of traditional network intrusions in Active Directory environments along with Business Email Compromises (“BEC”). The Senior Analyst assists with technical initiatives that further the business while taking opportunities to mentor junior analysts.

Primary Responsibilities and Duties

Technical Competencies
• Conduct forensic investigations for organizations that have suffered an attack from targeted threats, such as Advanced Persistent Threats, Organized Crime, and politically motivated groups, or from commodity threats such as ransomware groups.
• Perform host forensic analysis on Windows, Linux, and Mac OS based systems.
• Perform network analysis using a variety of tools and log sources to include firewall logs, NetFlow, and logs generated from a variety of network intrusions detection/prevention tools.
• Assist with/conduct the forensic acquisition and analysis from Azure, Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), and Google Cloud Platform (“GCP”) environments.
• Leverage applicable tooling to contain and eradicate a threat actor’s presence from a client’s network when responding to live intrusion events.
• Understand the capabilities of malicious binaries and scripts through basic static and dynamic analysis efforts.
• Make tactical recommendations for compromised client organizations.

Communication and Client Management
• Communicate both executive and detailed level findings in verbal and written form; Present technical findings in a manner that assists external legal counsel in understanding potential regulatory implications.
• Communicate all items relevant to the forensic investigation, in a manner that deescalates situations and presents a coherent strategy moving forward.
• Scope new cases and lead update calls when needed.

Leadership and Initiatives
• Stays current with developments within the DFIR field; Integrates new developments into current processes and procedures where necessary
• Partner with internal teams to publish blogs regarding threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (“TTP), vulnerabilities, 
• Mentor junior analysts on technical and soft skills

General
• Participate in weekday escalation and weekend/holiday on call schedules.
• Conduct audits and peer review of incident reports. 
• Fosters information sharing and collaboration.

Key Skills
• Analysis of disparate forensic artifacts
• Ability to draw sound conclusions despite gaps or ambiguity with evidence
• Written and verbal communication
• Team mentorship and knowledge sharing

Minimum Qualifications
• Three or more years professional experience with digital forensics and incident response or other similar cybersecurity roles
• Ability to respond to inquiries and work beyond normal business hours, as needed
• Advanced knowledge of host-based forensic, network analysis, and data breach response
• Advanced knowledge of current attack vectors and trends in cybersecurity
• Ability to identify indicators of compromise (“IOC”) from newly released exploits that have little to no community documentation
• Experience with IR and forensic tools, such as Magnet Axiom, Encase, FTK, X-Ways, SIFT, and other open-source forensic tools
• Experience with commercial Endpoint Detection and Response (“EDR”), network monitoring, and Security Information and Event Management (“SIEM”) tools

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree in Information Security, Digital Forensics, Computer Science, or other related field
• Certifications: GCFA, GCFE, ACE, EnCE, or similar training and certification
• Prior consulting experience
• Prior experience presenting at industry conferences and events
• Prior experience developing scripts and tools to analyze data
• Prior experience with malware analysis and reverse engineering

Bodyshop FAQs

What are the essential skills needed to work in car body repair?

At Arnold Clark, our vehicle body repair technicians restore vehicles to manufacturer standards using the latest tools, materials and repair methods. If you're considering a career in car body repair, you'll need confidence using hand tools, power tools and specialist equipment. From panel beating to welding and refinishing, using the correct techniques are vital to ensure cars are repaired safely and to a high standard. Also, bodyshop roles require good teamwork and communication and effective time management. As vehicle technology continues to evolve, you’ll be able to learn and develop your skills as you build a long-term career in one of our bodyshops.

What's it like working in an auto repair shop?

Working in an auto repair shop is hands-on, fast paced and highly rewarding. Every day brings new challenges, from diagnosing issues to carrying out precise repairs, so you can expect two days to be the same. It's a team-focused environment where communication and collaboration are important and where pride in quality workmanship matters. It's a career that offers continuous learning and opportunities to develop your skills.

What is a Panel Beater?

A Panel Beater is a skilled bodyshop technician who repairs and reshapes damaged vehicles after they've been subject to accidents or collisions. Using various specialist tools and techniques, a Panel Beater will restore cars to their original shape, repair dents and structural damage and ensure the vehicle meets the manufacters standards for safety and appearance. The role of a Panel Beater requires a mix of precision, technical expertise and a strong eye for detail to return vehicles to their former condition.

What is a MET Technician?

An MET Technician (Mechanical, Electrical and Trim) plays a vital role in a car body shop, carefully removing and refitting mechanical, electrical and interior components during the repair process. From bumpers to lighting and wiring, dashboards and advanced safety systems, an MET technician ensures every part is dismantled safely, reinstalled and fully tested to manufacturer standards. MET technician jobs require strong technical knowledge, attention to detail and a solid understanding of modern vehicle system repairs to ensure all repairs are carried out safely and correctly.

What is a Spray Painter?

A Spray Painter, often referred to as a Paint Sprayer, is responsible for preparing and refinishing vehicle panels to restore them to their original appearance in an auto repair shop. They will carefully mix and colour-match paint, prepare surfaces, and apply coatings using specialist paint sprayer equipment to achieve flawless, factory-standard finishes. Paint sprayer jobs require a keen eye for detail and a commitment to quality to ensure every vehicle leaves the bodyshop looking as good as new.

How to start a career in car body repair?

To get started in one of our bodyshop technician roles, the most common route is through an apprenticeship. In a bodyshop apprenticeship you’ll earn while you learn and work towards a recognised qualification. Bodyshop technician jobs require different types of practical skills, attention to detail and a willingness to learn, making on-the-job training and continuous development key to building a successful long-term career in the auto repair industry.

FAQs

Vehicle Technician FAQs

What salary can I earn as a Vehicle Technician?

At Arnold Clark, we offer our Vehicle Technicians a salary of £40,000 - £50,000 depending on experience, with the opportunity to earn up to £9,000 in performance bonus payments every three years. There is also the chance to earn an increase in hourly rate as part of our Technician Improvement Programme.

What is the difference between a Level 2 Vehicle Technician and a Level 3 Vehicle Technician?

Level 2 Vehicle Technicians are known at Arnold Clark as Used Vehicle Preparation Technicians and would have a minimum of two years’ previous experience in a vehicle workshop environment, plus a minimum Level 2 Light Vehicle Maintenance and Repair. Meanwhile, our Level 3 Vehicle Technicians would require a certificate in Light Vehicle Maintenance Level 3 and previous experience in the automotive industry.

What does a Vehicle Technician do at Arnold Clark?

Working as a Vehicle Technician, you’ll get the chance to work on an incredible range of manufacturers and models, developing your skills and staying up to date with the very latest in vehicle technology.

Day-to-day jobs could include:

- Carrying out servicing, repairs and maintenance to high standards
- Inspecting vehicle engine and mechanical/electrical components to diagnose issues accurately, using computer-based diagnostic equipment
- Repairing or replacing broken or defective parts and resolving defects
- Carrying out DVSA vehicle testing (if authorised)
- Road-testing vehicles to check repairs
- Maintaining equipment and making sure tools are in good condition
- Following checklists to ensure all procedures are completed
- Completing all documentation to the required standard

Will I receive electric vehicle technician training?

As an Arnold Clark Vehicle Technician, you will receive training to become an Electric Vehicle accredited Technician. This ensures you’re fully equipped with the latest skills to safely service and maintain all types of EVs. This is beneficial for our customers who get expert care for their vehicles and great for our Vehicle Technicians who stay ahead in a rapidly evolving automotive industry.

How can I become a Vehicle Technician?

If you're looking to get into a career as a Vehicle Technician, we can help! We offer a range of apprenticeships that will allow you to earn while you learn.

We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones.
