NOT SURE WHICH SUPPORT ROLE IS RIGHT FOR YOU?

We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles. 

 - Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

 - Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

 - Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

 - Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

 - Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

 - Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

 - Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF:

 - You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

 - You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

 - You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

 - You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

 - You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

 - You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.


YOU SHOULD NOT APPLY IF:

 - You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

Overview 
We’re looking for an Engineer - Endpoint Experience to join the Endpoint Experience team we are building within Workplace Experience, part of Digital Foundation. The team owns how ASOS manages its estate of employee devices (laptops, workstations, phones, and tablets): how security policy reaches every device, how changes are proven safe before they roll out, how applications are packaged and offered to ASOSers, how we measure whether the service works, and which devices we buy in the first place. 
ASOS is investing in endpoint engineering as an in-house capability. We want raising patch compliance, rolling out new tools to ASOSers (for example AI tooling for every employee), and evolving our device platforms to be routine engineering work we control end to end, rather than projects with long lead times. You will help build the foundations that make device management a product with version control, automated testing, staged rollouts, and clear metrics, and you will help evaluate the major device vendors and management platforms as we evolve our estate. 
This is a hands-on engineering role in a growing team. You will work with senior engineers who will support your development, and you will own meaningful pieces of the platform end to end: building pipelines, writing automation, packaging applications, running device evaluations, and instrumenting the metrics that tell us how we are doing. Our device management platforms today are Intune for Windows and Jamf for Apple devices. 
The role reports to the Engineering Manager for Endpoint Experience and works closely with Cyber Security, Developer Productivity, IT Support, Finance, and Procurement. The team is not a first-line support function: first response and device handover stay with IT Support, and servers are owned by Workplace Infrastructure (on-premises) and Developer Infrastructure (cloud). 
Purpose of the Role 
The Engineer - Endpoint Experience exists to help make the ASOS device estate secure by default, predictably reliable, and measurably good to use. Today, too much of what happens to a device between purchase and retirement is manual, slow to change, and hard to see. The team’s job is to make it engineered: every change versioned and reviewed, proven safe on a representative cohort before it reaches everyone, and visible in metrics that tell us whether employees are better off. 
Key Responsibilities 
Configuration & Compliance 
• Build and maintain the pipelines that take device configuration and the security policy authored by Cyber Security as versioned code and deploy it through Intune and Jamf, and the automation that detects and reports drift 

• Build and operate the automation that keeps patch compliance at the required level and reports it transparently 

• Build and maintain endpoint security configurations and compliance baselines, implementing device controls defined by Cyber Security through Intune and Jamf. 

• Build the device side of joiners-movers-leavers automation, from day-one provisioning to leaver device recovery and wipe 

Safe Change 
• Build and operate the test harness that validates policy, OS, application, and configuration changes against representative device cohorts before fleet-wide rollout, including staged rings, health checks, and rollback, and keep those cohorts healthy and representative 

Measurement & Continuous Improvement 
• Instrument device telemetry and build the dashboards that show service health, compliance, time to provision, change failure rate, support demand, and employee satisfaction 

• Help run the regular cadence of employee feedback, investigate incidents and change failures, fix root causes, and feed learnings back into the harness and pipelines 

The ASOS App Store 
• Package, test, and publish applications to the self-service catalogue and to automated deployments, keep them current with security updates prioritised, and retire software no longer needed or licensed 

• Package and maintain the curated developer toolset with Developer Productivity, so that a new engineer’s machine is ready to build and ship on day one 

• Automate repetitive packaging and update work so that employees can find and install what they need without a ticket 

Device Estate Governance 
• Run structured evaluations of candidate devices with real users, collect performance, reliability, and satisfaction data, and write up the results 

• Maintain device standards and employee personas, ensuring hardware, applications and device configurations remain aligned to business requirements, while supplying the data (device age, failure rates, cost) that informs lifecycle and refresh decisions. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 
• Work day to day with IT Support so that changes reaching the fleet are understood and supportable, and with Cyber Security engineers on translating requirements into tested device policy 

• Share what you learn across Digital Foundation through documentation and demos 

What Success Looks Like 
• Pipelines and automation you own running reliably, with runbooks others can follow, and your changes reaching the fleet through the harness with a low change failure rate 

• Dashboards that colleagues across Workplace Experience and its stakeholders trust and use 

• Applications you package reaching the fleet reliably, with employees able to self-serve rather than raise tickets 

• Device evaluations that produce clear, evidence-based write-ups that inform purchasing decisions 

• Visible growth in your ownership and technical scope over your first year

About You 
You have solid experience managing modern devices and want to move from operating tools to building the platform behind them. You are curious about how a fleet of devices can be managed like a production system, you enjoy automating things others do by hand, and you care about the people who use the devices you manage. AI assistants are a normal part of how you work, and you use them wherever they get you to a goal faster or better. 
You likely bring: 
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune or Jamf Pro, ideally both, managing Windows or macOS devices in an enterprise environment 

• Scripting and automation skills in PowerShell, Python, or shell, and some experience with version control and CI pipelines, or a strong desire to apply them to endpoint management

Why This Role Matters 
Every ASOS employee depends on devices that are secure, reliable, and stay out of their way. How we manage that estate determines how quickly we can respond to a new threat, how much time IT Support spends firefighting, and how much we spend on hardware. This role builds the foundations that let us move quickly on all three at once, with evidence rather than guesswork.

The SOC Level 3 (L3) Analyst is responsible for leading the investigation, coordination and resolution of complex security incidents. In addition to operational responsibilities, the L3 Analyst contributes to the continuous improvement of SOC processes, use cases, and detection capabilities. Your role

• Lead complex and high-severity cyber security investigations and incident response activities within a 24x7 Security Operations Centre (SOC), acting as a senior technical escalation point, taking ownership of investigations, and driving incidents through containment, eradication, recovery, and closure.

• Conduct proactive threat hunting, advanced investigations, and forensic triage across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and other enterprise environments to identify malicious activity, attacker persistence, and previously undetected compromise, while ensuring appropriate preservation and handling of investigative evidence.

• Drive automation and orchestration across security operations, using security queries, scripting, and automation to analyze data, accelerate investigations, reduce repetitive manual activities, and improve the consistency and effectiveness of response.
• Lead incident response exercises, tabletop scenarios, post-incident reviews, and continuous-improvement activities, translating lessons learned into measurable improvements to SOC processes, controls, detection capabilities, operational readiness, and cyber resilience.
• Collaborate with Security Engineering, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, Digital Forensics, IT, cloud and identity teams, and other stakeholders, while mentoring SOC analysts, producing high-quality technical and executive communications, supporting SOC metrics and SLAs, and participating in on-call/out-of-hours response for major incidents when required.

**Position Title:              Battery Test & Diagnostics Engineer**

**Duration:                      Contract**

**Location:                      Banbury, Oxfordshire.**

- Our Client is seeking a technically capable Battery Test & Diagnostics Engineer to support high-voltage battery and power-system commissioning, diagnostics, validation and engineering fault resolution.
- This hands-on role supports prototype and production build phases, with PEOL/EOL testing providing the environment for proactive engineering investigation rather than routine test execution alone.
- The engineer will independently isolate complex failures, test engineering hypotheses and drive corrective action across battery hardware, BMS, electrical interfaces and test systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Diagnose HV battery pack, BMS and power-system faults covering contactors, pre-charge circuits, HVIL, insulation monitoring, voltage/current sensing, thermal management and control interfaces.
- Interpret electrical schematics, CAN/XCP logs, diagnostic codes, oscilloscope traces and DAQ measurements to isolate hardware, software, calibration, network or test-equipment faults.
- Own systematic fault investigations from symptom reproduction and hypothesis development through root cause confirmation, corrective action and verification of resolution.
- Apply structured RCA methods including 5 Whys, 8D and fault-tree analysis; investigate intermittent, repeatable and operating-condition-dependent failures.
- Develop and perform controlled fault-injection and abnormal-condition tests to verify BMS diagnostics, fault detection thresholds, protective actions, interlocks and recovery behaviour.
- Use approved risk assessments, authorised equipment and safe test methods for all HV and fault-injection activities.
- Execute and technically assess PEOL/EOL commissioning and performance tests; investigate failed results rather than simply repeat or reset test sequences.
- Distinguish genuine product failures from false failures, test-rig limitations, incorrect limits, communications faults and calibration issues.
- Analyse trends in test data, identify recurring defects and recommend improvements to test coverage, test limits, diagnostic methods and production robustness.
- Develop or adapt diagnostic routines, test scripts, data acquisition and engineering test procedures to support investigation and validation.
- Work with battery design, BMS software, validation and manufacturing engineering teams to agree engineering fixes and verify their effectiveness.
- Produce clear test evidence, technical investigation reports, root-cause findings and practical recommendations; proactively escalate safety or delivery risks.

**Key Requirements:**

- Strong hands-on engineering experience with HV battery packs, battery management systems or closely related EV energy-storage and power systems.
- Proven ability to independently fault-find complex electrical, electronic and system-level issues and deliver evidence-based root cause analysis.
- Sound understanding of battery pack architecture, contactors, pre-charge, HVIL, insulation monitoring, sensors and BMS fault/protection strategies.
- Practical experience in fault injection, diagnostic validation, abnormal-condition testing or equivalent controlled fault simulation.
- Competence interpreting wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, system architectures, CAN signals and diagnostic data.
- Experience using oscilloscopes, multimeters, DAQ systems and CAN/XCP tools such as Vector CANoe, CANalyzer or CANape.
- Ability to analyse data, develop diagnostic hypotheses, challenge test outcomes and independently drive technical problems to closure.
- Formal HV training, safe-isolation competence and disciplined adherence to HV safety procedures and risk controls.
- Degree, HND or equivalent relevant experience in Electrical, Electronic, Automotive, Mechatronics or Systems Engineering.

**Tools & Knowledge (Desirable):**

- Lithium-ion battery module/pack validation, thermal management and BMS calibration experience.
- PEOL/EOL test development and engineering support in prototype, low-volume or production EV environments.
- Test scripting and automation using Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW or similar tools.
- Knowledge of DFMEA, DVP&R, fault coverage, diagnostic thresholds and software/hardware integration.

**Candidate Profile:**

- A proactive, technically inquisitive engineer who does not stop when an EOL test reports a failure.
- The successful candidate can explain why the system failed, safely reproduce and isolate the issue, establish the root cause and drive an effective engineering resolution.

STRATEGIC FINANCE / FP&A LEAD




THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring someone to build and run the FP&A and strategic finance function at cargo.one http://cargo.one - as a one-person function, with agents doing the heavy lifting.

You'll own the numbers: how the business is doing each month, the budget, the plan, and build the case for where we invest next.

The timing makes it more interesting. Every company is spending on AI right now - almost none can tell you what it's buying. We're running that experiment on ourselves and the early numbers are good. What we don't know yet - and as far as we can tell, nobody does - is how that spend turns into outcomes. If that feels like an exciting challenge, this could be a good fit.



WHAT CARGO.ONE http://cargo.one DOES

Logistics runs the global economy, and most of the work behind it is still done by hand - in inboxes, spreadsheets and phone calls. Air freight is a good example: under 1% of world trade by volume, more than a third by value. When something has to arrive fast it flies, and someone still has to price it, book it and chase it manually.

cargo.one http://cargo.one is the AI-powered infrastructure layer for logistics. Since 2018 we've been connecting the industry's data into one platform. Today, just about every airline in the world uses it to distribute capacity digitally, and many of the largest freight forwarders in the world use the platform to run their daily operations.

We're backed by leading investors including Index Ventures, Bessemer, Creandum, and Point 9.



WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

This is a one-person function, on purpose. There's no team to build. You'll build the systems and run the agents, so more of your time goes on the work itself, and you'll both progress and learn faster than you would managing people.

What we have today is a beta - a monthly reporting pack that runs on a partially agentic close, a P&L for every budget holder, and almost every core system connected. Your first job is to make it reliable, secure and close to hands-free, built properly. Producing numbers people trust should take up almost none of your week.

You spend the time that frees up on where the business puts its money.

The interesting part: you're the partner P&L owners bring in early, and also the person who keeps the numbers honest. Doing both well is a big part of the job.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build the engine first, then spend most of your time using it. You'll know it's working when the monthly pack runs without you and P&L owners pull you in because they want your view, not because they have to.

Build the engine (first months)

 - Decide what we report, how often and to whom - then automate it end to end.

 - Help design our commission and bonus plans, then build the agent that tracks them, reports on them and pushes the results into payroll. No spreadsheet in the middle.

 - Raise and ensure data quality.

Partner and allocate (most of the job)

 - Set up and run the controlling and business-partnering rhythm with P&L owners.

 - Build the benchmarks we need now that AI has changed the maths - org effectiveness, the return on AI initiatives once they're out of the incubator, what efficiency we should expect from each team - and turn them into capital allocation calls.

Events

 - Drive the annual budget process alongside the CFO.

 - Contribute to papers and presentations for SLT and board meetings.




WHAT YOU GET, AND WHERE IT LEADS

Nothing will slow you down. You will have the tools you need to get the job done. Every system on MCP. You'll have Claude, GitLab, the skills our teams have already built, and a laptop that can keep up. Need a private finance data warehouse? Make the case and we'll build it. The access is all there. What you build with it is up to you.

You own the numbers. You'll work closely with me and the finance, legal and people team, who'll get you up to speed fast. You will be a key partner to the Senior and Extended Leadership teams.

Where it leads. Finance careers are changing fast, and the people who've actually built this way will be in demand. Head of Finance, CFO, founder, CEO - we're not going to prescribe it. We think this role gives you more options, not fewer.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Nobody ticks every box on this page. If you've got the three below and you're already building, we would love to talk to you.

What you'll need

 1. You know what good looks like. 5+ years owning or scrutinising the numbers of B2B SaaS, usage based or platform businesses - as an operator, an investor or in strategic finance. You think in unit economics and profitability, and which levers to pull when.

 2. You've built something with AI that someone relies on. Something real, not a demo. You've thought about architecture, repeatability, quality and security, and you can talk us through what broke and what you changed.

 3. You are able to lead without authority, and your communication skills are S tier.



What sets you apart: Endless curiosity and a lot of grit. You're probably already building on the side, and hungry for more.

Everything else we can teach you.

This probably isn't the right fit if you want to build a big team, or you'd rather stay in the model than out in the business. It's built for people who'd rather work out something new than repeat what they've done before.



HOW WE WORK WITH AI TODAY

All of this is live, though some of it is young.

 - Engineering: engineers write the specs and own the architecture, and agents do much of the implementation. Output has doubled in three months.

 - Operations: we've taken 30-70% of the manual work out of key processes without dropping the quality bar.

 - Finance: a big chunk of the internal close and most invoicing runs on AI tooling. You'll take it from there.

 - Everyone else: a shared skills library, company-wide AI hackathons, and most teams building their own tools.

The role

Charles Russell Speechlys is seeking an experienced Senior Legal Project Manager to join our Legal Project Management team in a dedicated role supporting our Business Advisory & Transactional Services (BATS) division. This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned LPM professional with extensive transactional experience and a genuine passion for legal technology to drive innovation, efficiency, and excellence across some of the firm's most complex and high-value deals and advisory mandates.

Reporting to the Head of Legal Project Management, you will be embedded within our BATS division, working across seven dynamic practice groups: Corporate, Commercial, Banking & Finance, Corporate Tax & Incentives, Employment, Immigration, and Financial Services & Funds. This role goes well beyond a traditional LPM remit. You
will act as a true extension of the legal team, rolling up your sleeves to keep matters moving and engaging directly with clients, paying agents, third parties, and other external stakeholders. You will also champion the use of AIpowered legal tools such as Harvey, alongside other legal technology platforms, to optimise how work is delivered,
positioning you as a trusted adviser to our legal teams and clients alike.

Key Responsibilities

The following represent the primary responsibilities of the role. However, this list is not exhaustive, and the post holder may be required to undertake additional tasks and duties as reasonably requested to support the needs of the LPM Team, BATS division and the wider firm.

Transaction management & delivery
You will take ownership of the planning, execution, and completion of select transactional and advisory matters within the BATS division, including M&A transactions, refinancings, reorganisations and other corporate, finance and funds work, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality. Working in close partnership with legal teams and clients, you will help define scope, workstreams, and deliverables, establishing clear communication channels and ensuring alignment with client expectations from instruction through to completion. You will build and maintain deal timelines, critical path plans, and workstream trackers; chair regular deal and working group calls to review progress and priorities; and circulate updated action lists to the matter team, client, and other advisers while flagging any issues, dependencies, or blockers requiring attention.

Deal execution, closing logistics & conditions precedent
You will play a hands-on role in the run-up to signing and completion, coordinating closing logistics and keeping all parties aligned on what needs to happen, by whom, and by when. This includes preparing and managing closing and signing checklists, tracking conditions precedent and conditions subsequent through to satisfaction, coordinating signature pages and execution formalities, and managing funds flow and completion mechanics in liaison with the legal team, client, and counterparties. You will provide clear, timely status reporting throughout, supporting matter workflow across the full transaction lifecycle, from kick-off and due diligence through to completion and postcompletion actions.

Technology, AI & optimisation
Technology proficiency is a core requirement of this role. You will be a confident, hands-on user of AI-powered legal tools such as Harvey, and an active champion for their adoption across the BATS division, helping lawyers to apply them effectively and responsibly on live matters. You will also draw on other legal technology platforms, such as
document automation, workflow, data room, and e-signature tools, to streamline matter delivery. You will proactively identify opportunities to optimise processes, reduce manual effort, and improve efficiency and quality on matters, working with Legal Technology to test, embed, and share what works. You will be expected to stay close to
developments in the legal technology market and to translate them into practical, matter-ready solutions.

A true extension of the legal team
You will work as an integrated member of the transaction team, comfortable rolling up your sleeves and taking ownership of the practical delivery of deals. You will liaise directly with clients, paying agents, trustees, registrars, banks, other law firms, corporate services providers, and other third parties and external stakeholders as matters
require, managing information flow, chasing outstanding deliverables, and resolving practical issues before they affect timelines. Your ability to build credibility quickly, communicate clearly, and follow through will help the legal team to focus on advice and negotiation, while you keep the machinery of the matter running smoothly.

Budgeting & financial reporting
You will play a key role in preparing and managing matter budgets, working collaboratively with legal teams to develop accurate cost estimates and resource plans at the outset of matters. Throughout the matter lifecycle, you will monitor actual spend against budget, providing regular fee reporting and analysis to partners and clients. You will
work closely with the firm's Finance and Pricing teams to develop competitive and commercially sound pricing proposals, contribute to fixed fee and alternative fee arrangement discussions, and ensure robust financial oversight across the matters you support. Your ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights will help legal teams make informed decisions and maintain profitability while delivering value to clients.

Client relationship management
Throughout the project lifecycle, you will manage client relationships with professionalism and transparency, serving as a key point of contact for project-related communications, including with in-house legal, finance, and deal teams. You will address issues promptly, provide regular updates on matter progress, and ensure clients feel informed and confident in our delivery. Your ability to build trust and maintain high levels of client satisfaction will be essential to success in this role.

Cross-functional collaboration
You will work closely with your counterpart in Legal Technology, adopting a collaborative approach to integrating technology solutions into matter workflows. This partnership will be critical in identifying opportunities for innovation, implementing new and existing tools into the division and on specific matters (as required), and ensuring seamless coordination between project management and technical delivery. Together, you will drive continuous improvement in how the firm approaches transactional and advisory work, including repeatable deal processes, templates, and checklists across the BATS practice groups.

Innovation & development
As part of the firm's commitment to innovation, you will play a supporting role in Russell Up, our internal innovation programme. You will provide guidance and mentorship to colleagues undertaking innovation projects, sharing your expertise in project management methodologies and helping to cultivate the next generation of innovative legal
professionals. This aspect of the role offers an opportunity to shape the future of legal service delivery at Charles Russell Speechlys.

Strategic contribution & best practice development
You will contribute to the development and refinement of project management best practices across the firm, capturing insights and lessons learned from each matter to improve team efficiency and effectiveness. Working collaboratively with the Head of Legal Project Management and other senior leaders, you will support the firm's
strategic objectives and drive innovation in project delivery, helping to position Charles Russell Speechlys as a leader in modern legal service delivery. You will also play a key role in advancing the BATS division's strategic goals, contributing to initiatives and priorities as they evolve and helping shape how the division responds to changing client
and market demands.

Team development & knowledge sharing
You will play an active role in developing the capabilities of the wider LPM team, sharing your expertise through training sessions, mentoring, and informal knowledge exchange. By fostering a culture of continuous learning and best practice, you will help build team coverage and resilience, ensuring the LPM function can respond effectively to demand across the firm. You will also act as an ambassador for the CRS LPM brand, promoting the value and impact of legal project management within the business and helping to raise the profile of the team across all divisions.

Person Specification

Essential Requirements
You will bring proven experience in legal project management or transactional support within a law firm environment, with a particular focus on corporate, finance, and advisory matters. Your background will include hands-on experience working within transactional teams, giving you deep insight into the workflows, deadlines, and pressure points of M&A deals, refinancings, reorganisations, and similar matters, and a good understanding of the work of the BATS practice groups.

You will be technically proficient and enthusiastic about technology as a means of delivering better, faster, and more cost-effective legal services. You will be familiar with, and able to champion, AI-powered legal tools such as Harvey, as well as other legal technology platforms (for example document automation, workflow, data room, and esignature tools), with a track record of using technology to drive optimisation and efficiency on matters.

You will have well-developed transactional project management skills, including managing deal timelines and critical paths, coordinating closing logistics, tracking conditions precedent, and supporting matter workflow through signing, completion, and post-completion.

You will be a pragmatic, proactive “roll up your sleeves” operator, comfortable acting as a true extension of the legal team and taking ownership of the practicalities of delivery. You will be confident liaising directly with clients, paying agents, third parties, and other external stakeholders, and will bring professionalism, tact, and resilience to those interactions.

Your communication and influencing skills will be of a high calibre, with proven experience working effectively with senior stakeholders across international organisations. You will be able to collaborate professionally, diplomatically, and effectively across departments, building productive relationships that drive results.

You will be credible, articulate, and comfortable working with systems, data, and analysis, able to translate complex information into clear insights and recommendations.

Your attention to detail and organisational skills will be excellent, enabling you to manage multiple priorities and maintain high standards even in fast-paced, high-pressure, deadline-driven environments.

Citi's Offensive Security and Vulnerability Management (OSVM) team is hiring practitioners who can run security assessments against AI systems and use AI-powered tools to make security testing faster and more effective.

The AI Offensive Security Analyst is an operational role on a team that runs penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, and Red Team adversarial evaluations across Citi's application portfolio. The problems we're solving don't have playbooks yet.

• Security architecture for the AI era. Defining how a global bank deploys, monitors, and governs agentic AI — from standards and evaluation frameworks to production runtime monitoring.

• AI at scale, not in a lab. Citi has deployed AI tools to 180,000+ employees, equipped 30,000 developers with AI coding assistants, and is rolling out agentic AI capabilities firm wide. Securing that footprint and the platforms that underpin them is the job.

• Securing AI agents that can behave like insider threats. Frontier models can harvest credentials, escape sandboxes, and adapt when they detect monitoring. We're designing the containment architectures and runtime controls to operate them safely at enterprise scale.

• Real security engineering. This isn't a cyber seat where you'll spend your time in administration . You will be expected to understand the code, the architecture, the threats, and find solutions. You'll have the mandate and the backing to build something meaningful.

• ​Cyber Security Operations — Detection, triage, and response for a world where adversaries use AI to find and exploit vulnerabilities faster than traditional detection can keep up. Behavioral analytics for AI agents. Playbooks for AI-originated attack scenarios.

• Testing AI applications and agents. GenAI applications, agentic systems, and LLM-backed products require testing that goes beyond standard web app methodology. Prompt injection, indirect injection, retrieval poisoning, tool misuse, sensitive data extraction, unsafe delegation, these are real attack classes with real business impact. You'll design and execute test cases for them.

• Using AI to work better. AI-assisted testing changes what's possible in a pen testing engagement: broader coverage, faster reconnaissance, automated validation of common vulnerability classes. You'll be expected to know how to use these capabilities effectively and to help the broader team adopt what works.

• Embedding security into development. Working with development teams and security engineers to make sure AI application assessments happen at the right points in the build process.

• Familiarity with common security testing tools: Burp Suite, nuclei, nmap, or similar

• Ability to triage findings and communicate risk clearly to technical and non-technical audience

General

• Curious about the security implications of AI systems, not just the hype around them

Are you interested in building the next-generation risk quant pricing platform that runs on large-scale, high-performance compute grids? Are you driven by the challenge of orchestrating trillions of calculations across a hybrid cloud environment to compute risk P&Ls with extreme speed and precision? Do you want to own the core platform that brings sophisticated front-office pricing models to life at an industrial scale?
Citi is seeking a visionary Lead Engineer to architect and build our global Quant Pricing Platform. This is the computational heart of our risk system, where complex quantitative models meet massive-scale infrastructure. You will be responsible for creating a seamless, high-performance ecosystem that spans both in-house and external cloud grids, delivering the computational power our quants need to manage risk effectively.

Your Role and Impact
As the Lead Engineer for the Quant Pricing Platform, you are the master of distributed quantitative computation. You will build the end-to-end system that takes pricing models from front-office quants, deploys them onto a colossal hybrid grid, and orchestrates the massive-scale calculation of risk P&Ls. Your primary mission is to engineer a platform that is incredibly powerful, flexible, and efficient, enabling the firm to run complex scenario-based valuations on demand.
Your impact is foundational to the firm's risk management capabilities. You will build the bridge between quantitative research and production-scale execution. The platform you create will directly determine the speed, accuracy, and sophistication of our risk calculations, empowering our business to navigate complex markets with confidence.

Key Responsibilities
• Architect and build a next-generation, hybrid-cloud platform for running quantitative pricing calculations at massive scale.
• Design a sophisticated job orchestration and scheduling system that handles dynamic prioritization, efficient task packing, and resource optimization across the grid.
• Engineer a robust, event-driven framework for managing the entire job lifecycle, including handling notifications for job completion and managing the flow of result data from the grid.
• Develop a comprehensive error-handling and resiliency strategy to gracefully manage failures in a large-scale distributed environment.
• Pioneer the development of an intelligent monitoring platform using ML to perform anomaly detection, predict job failures, and optimize grid performance.
• Engineer the secure and efficient data logistics required to move terabytes of market and trade data between on-premise systems and public cloud environments.
• Partner closely with front-office quants to onboard, version, and optimize their C++ and Python pricing models for distributed computation.

What We're Looking For
• Professional experience with a proven track record of designing and building applications for massive-scale, high-performance compute (HPC) grids.
• A degree in a highly technical field such as Computer Science or Quantitative Finance.
• Deep domain knowledge in Capital Markets, financial derivatives, and a strong understanding of financial regulations like FRTB.
• Expert-level experience with job scheduling, resource management, and workload optimization techniques (task packing, prioritization) on large-scale grids.
• Deep expertise in building event-driven architectures and handling asynchronous notifications and replies from distributed systems.
• Proven experience designing and building intelligent monitoring tools, ideally leveraging ML for anomaly detection and performance tuning.
• Expert-level experience managing workloads in a hybrid cloud environment, with deep knowledge of at least one major public cloud (AWS, GCP) and on-premise grid technologies.
• Deep expertise in containerization, orchestration, and scheduling technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
• Strong programming skills in languages common to high-performance and quantitative computing, such as C++ and Python.
• Proven ability to debug complex pricing and model-related issues by partnering directly with quantitative analysts.
• Prior experience in a similar role within the financial industry, specifically working on quantitative pricing platforms, large-scale risk calculations, or XVA grids.

Education:
• Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
• Master’s degree preferred

We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilising a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…
We are committed to teaching you the ropes. The Placement Analyst Program starts in June with an in-depth education on the Analyst role’s fundamentals and the nuances of Citi’s culture. The program also includes on-the-desk training, an informative speaker series, and networking opportunities. Placement Analysts often return to Citi after graduating from university to become Full-Time Analysts and continue their career in technology. 

Your time here will look like this... 
You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:
• Back-End Development: Java, Python, Spring Framework
• Front-End Development: Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
• Generative AI & AI Agents: GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
• Data Analytics: Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.

No matter your team placement, as a member in our programme, you can expect:
· Global Exposure: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.
· Continuous Learning: Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programmes that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.
· Real Impact: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.

To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:
· Graduation between Dec 2028 and July 2029.
· Educational background: Pursuing Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.
· A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.
· Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.
· Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.
· Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.
· Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.
· Work Authorisation: Authorised to work in UK without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

Who we think will be a great fit...
A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.

This program is ideal for those who:
· Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
· Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.
· Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

job_title: Vice President, Sales Business Development Specialist - Services
job_description:
Are you looking for a career move that will put you at the heart of a global financial institution? Then bring your skills in analysis, problem solving and communication to Citi’s Sales Business Development team.

By Joining Citi, you will become part of a global organisation whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress.

Team/Role Overview:

 Sales Business Development team is a dedicated origination function focused on identifying and converting business opportunities with high-potential Corporate Banker Led clients without assigned Services coverage

The role is integral to the full sales lifecycle Liquidity and Payments solutions, identifying and converting relationship‑led opportunities in close collaboration with Banking, Product, Pricing, Marketing, and Implementation teams to win cluster, regional, and global mandates. The successful candidate will act as a deal originator, accountable for the end‑to‑end sales lifecycle—from opportunity identification and solution design through commercial negotiation, deal approval, and handover to implementation.

This position is suited to a highly motivated sales professional who combines strong sales origination drive, cash management expertise, disciplined execution, data‑driven decision making, and strong attention to detail in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment.

What you’ll do:

• Proactively identify and engage Banker led clients, building a high-quality pipeline across Liquidity and Payments, driving incremental revenue growth for Services business
• Use new tools, data sets, and processes to identify and action high-quality opportunities and leads.
• Execute data-driven outreach, prioritising the highest-value opportunities within the uncovered segment
• Lead sales pitches and proposals end-to-end, converting pipeline to wins through disciplined deal progression and coordination with implementation teams
• Act as a trusted SERVICES advisor on treasury transformation, liquidity optimisation, payment modernisation, and digital enablement
• Develop tailored value propositions aligned to each client's treasury environment and cash management requirements
• Focus on key metrics of calling intensity and origination, client pitching, negotiation and closing.
• Convert Pipeline - driving increased wins, revenue, and market share for Services through the sale of Liquidity and Payments solutions to this population of underpenetrated clients.
• Develop strong and effective working relationships with our country and cluster partners (Corporate Bank, Regional Product and Marketing) to coordinate and drive growth across identified client opportunities.
• Report progress against performance goals, and share feedback on results, best practices and lessons learned.
• Ensure internal systems are kept up to date (e.g. CRM, call report logging etc) in order to provide accurate and timely management information and reporting.
• Work with implementation, the Client Success Organisation and Client Service to ensure deals are implemented seamlessly, clients are satisfied and revenues ramp – and subsequently –clients are open to further discussions on additional services
• Ensure full compliance with Citi policies including Code of Conduct, AML, Information Security, Sales solicitation, and Data Governance

What we’ll need from you:

• Proven track record in proactive sales or business development within Transaction Banking, Payments, Liquidity, or a related field
• Strong working knowledge of Cash Management, Trade, Working Capital, Receivables, Liquidity, and Digital Channels
• Demonstrated ability to manage pipelines, secure client meetings, and close deals in a matrixed organisation
• Commercially driven, persuasive communicator with a results-focused outlook
• Ability to synthesise large data sets to inform outreach
• Experience in a risk-controlled, regulated environment
• University degree or equivalent; Cert ICM advantageous

What we can offer you:

• Access to learning & development resources
• Opportunity to adopt new Sales tools and processes and lead the way on data driven, proactive client outreach and origination.
• Opportunity to develop yourself as a sales professional within one of the most well-known global companies
• Exposure to a wide group of stakeholders across the bank – and the ability to develop an extensive professional network

We work hard to have a positive financial and social impact on the communities we serve. In turn, we put our employees first and provide the best-in-class benefits they need to be well, live well and save well.

By joining Citi London, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as: 

• Generous holiday allowance starting at 27 days plus bank holidays; increasing with tenure
• A discretional annual performance related bonus 
• Private medical insurance packages to suit your personal circumstances
• Employee Assistance Program 
• Pension Plan 
• Paid Parental Leave 
• Special discounts for employees, family, and friends 
• Access to an array of learning and development resources 

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive. 

Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities.

## Summary:

job_description:
Who We Are
At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the disruptive potential of AI for the world. By combining advanced technology with a global network of talented experts, we make unusable data usable and inference reliable and trustworthy, driving real-world business value at scale. 
More than just a workplace, we’re a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do, as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.
Our Culture
At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:
• Mission-Driven: We focus on creating economic and social impact.
• People-Centric: We care deeply about our team’s growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
• Innovative: We embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
• Globally Connected: We foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.
If you’re ready to earn, learn, serve, and be part of a vibrant global community, CloudFactory is your place!
About the Role
We are seeking a dedicated and motivated Construction Site Data Capture Technicians to operate reality capture equipment, such as 360-degree cameras and other surveying tools, in a variety of environments. The technician will be responsible for capturing comprehensive data of construction sites using different equipment and methodologies that align with algorithmic analysis.
We are looking for someone who is hardworking, responsible, and passionate about fieldwork, with the ability to effectively use technology to collect detailed site information. This is a part-time role, requiring one day of work per week.
What You'll Do

• Capture high-quality site data using 360° cameras and other data capture equipment across active construction sites. 
• Document site progress accurately by collecting visual data that supports project tracking and AI-powered construction solutions. 
• Follow all site safety procedures and wear the required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times to ensure your safety and the safety of those around you. 
• Work closely with the Project Team to meet project requirements and adapt to changing site conditions. 
• Handle and maintain company equipment responsibly, ensuring all captured data meets quality standards. 
• Follow detailed instructions and complete data capture tasks accurately and consistently.

About the Team

We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains Readable, Discoverable, and Callable for autonomous AI agents.

Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet. As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences.

About the Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across our Agentic Discovery portfolio.

You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind customer-facing products that help businesses manage how AI agents understand, represent, and interact with their digital properties. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to shape priorities around Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), content ingestion/indexing, agent observation and testing tools, and open tool-execution standards (such as WebMCP and Generative UI).

• Lead the development of tools enabling Cloudflare customers to make their content Readable (structured content transformation), Discoverable (indexing, directories, and AEO), and Callable (WebMCP, APIs, Generative UI) for autonomous agents.

• Build tools for customers to test, observe, measure, and control how AI agents find and interact with their websites and applications.

• Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.

• Identify how Cloudflare's global network and edge signals can enable unique products that help businesses reach trusted agentic audiences at scale.

• Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.

• Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, data quality, and long-term reliability.

• Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.

• You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.

• You are technically credible with experienced engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in distributed systems or web-scale data pipelines, and recognize when a technical problem needs deeper investigation.

• You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas (such as search/indexing, protocol standards, and UI engineering) and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.

• You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system is data that users and AI agents rely on to navigate the Internet.

• You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement, and what should not be built at all.

• You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.

• You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.

• Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, web-scale data platforms, agentic architectures, Internet infrastructure, or adjacent areas.

• Experience building customer-facing products involving content indexing, crawling, analytics, or complex user interaction patterns.

• Experience operating systems where correctness, data quality, and reliability matter as much as feature delivery.

• A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.

• Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.

• Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.

• Strong written and verbal communication.

Bonus Points

• Hands-on familiarity with emerging agentic technologies and standards such as WebMCP, AEO, and Generative UI.

• Experience building products for AI developers, AI agents, publishers, or content-heavy websites.

• Experience working with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platforms, search/indexing, or testing and observability platforms.

• Experience turning complex underlying internet systems or data into intuitive, high-value products for a broad audience.

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

## **Job Purpose**

Support the Packaging Engineering team in developing, improving and managing packaging solutions for production parts. The role will involve working with returnable packaging equipment such as metal stillages and racks, as well as internal protective packaging used to prevent part damage during transportation and handling. The intern will support packaging trials, material planning, packaging procurement activities, continuous improvement projects and packaging-related quality investigations to ensure packaging availability.

- Support packaging improvement projects aimed at reducing part damage, waste and handling activities.

- Assist with material planning activities to ensure packaging availability meets production volumes and customer demand.
- Create and maintain SAP purchase orders and support packaging procurement activities.
- Monitor returnable packaging assets and support the management of rack and container availability.
- Investigate packaging-related quality issues and help identify root causes and improvement opportunities.
- Work with suppliers and internal departments including Production, Logistics, Quality, Purchasing and Engineering to support packaging activities and continuous improvement projects.

- Self-motivated with a willingness to learn in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
- Understanding of Kaizen or Continuous Improvement principles would be beneficial.

## **About Us**

Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.

From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.  
 
**Grow a Career. Build a Future!**

Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.

## **Job Purpose**

The Marketing Intern supports the UK & ROI Parts & Service Marketing team in the day-to-day administration, communication and coordination of marketing activities across the dealer network.

Working closely with the Field Marketing Specialists and Marketing Lead, the role provides support across dealer communications, newsletters, dealer portal management, shared mailbox administration, merchandise enquiries and wider marketing administration activities.

## **Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Communications Support**

- Support the preparation and distribution of weekly, monthly and ad-hoc dealer communications.
- Assist in the production, formatting and deployment of newsletters, bulletins and communication materials for the UK & ROI dealer network.
- Support the Field Marketing Specialist with the deployment of marketing communications across all relevant channels.
- Maintain communication templates, mailing lists and supporting communication assets.
- Assist with proofreading communications to ensure consistency, accuracy and brand compliance.
- Support the preparation of internal marketing updates and team communications where required.

**Dealer Portal and Content Administration**

- Maintain and update content on the Dealer Portal to ensure information remains current, accurate and accessible.
- Upload approved marketing materials, bulletins, promotional information and supporting documentation to relevant platforms.
- Ensure dealer-facing content is updated in line with guidance provided by the Field Marketing Specialist and Marketing Lead.
- Support periodic reviews of dealer-facing content to ensure information remains relevant and current.

 **Shared Mailbox and Workflow Administration**

- Manage the Parts & Service Marketing shared mailbox on a day-to-day basis.
- Monitor incoming enquiries and route requests to the appropriate team member.
- Maintain team workflow trackers, communication logs and administration files to support project delivery and communication activities.
- Ensure marketing requests are logged, tracked and progressed in accordance with agreed processes.

**Merchandise and Dealer Enquiry Support**

- Act as the first point of contact for merchandise and promotional item enquiries.
- Coordinate requests relating to marketing merchandise and promotional materials.
- Liaise with suppliers and internal stakeholders regarding stock availability, delivery status and order queries where required.
- Escalate complex enquiries to the Field Marketing Specialists or Marketing Lead as appropriate.
- Maintain merchandise records and support inventory tracking activities where required.

 **Marketing Team Administrative Support**

- Provide general administrative support to the Marketing Lead and Field Marketing Specialists.
- Support event/meeting administration activities, including registrations, attendee communications and logistics support.
- Support ad-hoc projects and initiatives as required by the wider Parts & Service Marketing team.

## **Experience Required**

- Studying towards, or recently completed, a qualification in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related discipline.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams.
- Interest in marketing, communications and customer engagement.
- Experience with digital content management, newsletters or communications platforms would be beneficial.
- Experience using creative or design software would be advantageous but not essential.
- Fluency in written and spoken English is required.

## **Preferred Qualifications**

- Strong attention to detail.
- Organised and methodical approach to work.
- Strong written communication skills.
- Customer-focused mindset.
- Proactive and willing to learn.
- Strong team ethic and collaborative approach.
- Able to work independently on routine tasks.
- Comfortable managing administrative processes and maintaining accurate records.
- Positive attitude with a willingness to support a wide variety of activities.
- Strong time management and prioritisation skills.
- Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
- Professional approach when dealing with dealers, suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Our Community Data Administrator will be responsible for the quality, coverage, depth and development of Cogora’s HCP community. The role will ensure we have a high-quality, accurate, comprehensive, current, relevant and growing audience that meets the needs of the business and our clients.

Salary: £30,000 – £35,000.

They will develop a detailed understanding of Cogora’s HCP data and the wider addressable HCP market, identifying where we have strong coverage, where gaps exist and what actions we can take to address them. They will use first- and third-party data, market intelligence and behavioural and engagement data to understand the composition and health of our community and identify opportunities for growth and improvement.

This is a highly analytical role for someone who loves working with data, numbers and solving problems. They will interrogate datasets, spot patterns and anomalies, assess data quality and freshness, identify gaps and translate findings into clear actions.

Working closely with teams across Cogora, they will help source and evaluate new data, improve HCP profiling and segmentation, strengthen our understanding of audience engagement and ensure our HCP community becomes increasingly accurate, complete, current and commercially valuable.

## Responsibilities

**Data Quality:** Take ownership of the overall health of Cogora’s HCP database, including accuracy, completeness, recency, duplication, consistency, consent and compliance. Establish clear definitions and standards for data quality and regularly measure the database against them, including agreed definitions for active HCPs, inactive HCPs, dormant records, complete profiles and verified HCPs. Identify data quality issues and work with relevant teams to implement solutions and continually improve the reliability of our data.

**Data Coverage:** Build a detailed understanding of Cogora’s coverage of the HCP market and identify gaps by profession, specialty, geography, seniority and other relevant characteristics. Develop clear, data-led plans to address priority audience gaps and measure the impact of actions taken.

**Data Enrichment:** Identify opportunities to enhance existing HCP records with additional data points and attributes, improving the completeness and depth of our profiles. Determine which additional attributes would provide the greatest audience, editorial and commercial value and identify appropriate sources for obtaining them.

**Data Freshness & Engagement:** Assess HCP recency and frequency of interaction with Cogora, developing a consistent engagement score using behavioural signals across the business. Use engagement data to understand the active audience and identify opportunities to increase engagement.

**Audience Re-engagement & Cleansing:** Identify inactive, ageing, duplicate, incomplete or low-confidence records. Work with relevant teams to determine appropriate approaches for re-engagement, verification, consolidation, suppression or removal. Monitor the effectiveness of re-engagement and cleansing activity and use the findings to continually improve our approach.

**Segmentation & Audience Insight:** Develop meaningful HCP segments based on profession, specialty, geography, seniority, demographics, behaviour, engagement, recency and other relevant characteristics. Analyse these segments to identify patterns, opportunities and changes in audience behaviour. Translate complex data into clear insights that can be understood and acted upon by teams across the business.

**Data Acquisition & Gap Closure:** Research and evaluate new first- and third-party data sources that could strengthen Cogora’s HCP community. Assess potential sources based on quality, coverage, accuracy, recency, compliance, cost and likely incremental value. Develop data-led recommendations for acquiring or generating data to address identified audience gaps and measure whether those interventions successfully improve coverage.

**Commercial Audience Analysis:** Work closely with our commercial teams to understand current and emerging client audience requirements. Translate these requirements into data needs and assess Cogora’s ability to reach relevant HCP audiences. Identify areas where strengthening our data could create new commercial opportunities or improve our existing audience proposition.

**Reporting:** Develop and maintain reporting on the health and development of Cogora’s HCP community. Monitor key metrics including database size, net growth, coverage, completeness, duplication, freshness, active and inactive audiences, engagement and enrichment. Move beyond simply reporting numbers by identifying what the data tells us, highlighting emerging issues and opportunities and making clear recommendations for action.

**Internal expertise:** Become Cogora’s internal authority on our HCP community. Develop a comprehensive understanding of what data we hold, where it comes from, how reliable and current it is, how our audiences engage with Cogora, where gaps exist and what opportunities there are to improve the data. Support teams across the business with questions about HCP audience size, composition, coverage and engagement.

## Key skills

We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious and genuinely enjoys working with data. You’ll have a highly analytical mind, an exceptional eye for detail and a tendency to ask ‘why’ and ‘what does this tell us?’ rather than simply accepting the numbers at face value. You’ll enjoy getting into the detail of datasets, spotting patterns and inconsistencies and solving problems. You’ll be organised, methodical and comfortable working with large volumes of data, but equally able to step back and see the bigger picture.

Most importantly, you’ll be someone who lives and breathes data – excited by numbers, curious about what they can tell us and always looking for ways to make our data better and more current.

WHY CONDUCT

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand.

Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

 - Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of post-market surveillance, complaint analytics, digital enablement and process transformation. You’ll shape how emerging signals and product-performance concerns are identified, evaluated, communicated and acted upon, while helping advance the use of analytics, automation and AI-enabled tools in a highly regulated environment.

You’ll also play an important role in developing the capability of an established, multidisciplinary team, bringing external knowledge, strong technical judgement and a practical leadership style that raises standards across the function.

• Lead the global operating model for post-market monitoring, trending, signal detection and escalation, including governance, methodologies, thresholds and continuous improvement.

job_description:
When it comes to innovation and achievement there are few organisations with a better track record. Join us and you’ll be able to play a big part in the success of our highly successful, fast-paced business that opens up Europe so that people can exercise their get-up-and-go. Over the last 30 years, easyJet has disrupted the travel industry, changing the way people fly across the UK and Europe. Today, with a fleet of over 300 aircraft and 85 million annual passengers, we are still innovating. What sets us apart is our "Orange Spirit"—our passion, forward-thinking mindset, and sense of fun.

Now, we are looking for a skilled, high-stakes UX & Service Designer to join our Airline Operations Technology mission and transform the crew experience.

The Mission: Connected Crew & Optimised Flying

In this role, you will directly shape how our pilots and cabin crew receive, understand, and act on real-time data and flight efficiency insights. Operating in a high-workload, high-stakes environment, you will bridge the gap between complex software systems and human behavior.

You will work across a hybrid ecosystem of configurable SaaS platforms and custom-built products. • Own the End-to-End Crew Experience: Streamline how pilots and cabin crew make critical decisions on connected devices without increasing their workload.

• Lead Journey Mapping & IA: Map current and target workflows across the crew value chain to design out friction, fragmentation, and workarounds.

• Drive Product Configuration: Translate intricate workflows into practical SaaS settings (views, defaults, and terminology), keeping your design reasoning explicit and reviewable.

• Conduct Expert User Research: Run contextual interviews, live observations, and usability testing with expert operational users before deployment.

• Link Design to Impact: Partner with Product Managers to tie your design decisions directly to mission OKRs, including turn-time, on-time performance (OTP), and fuel efficiency.

• Collaborate Globally: Partner with a cross-functional network of architects, data specialists, delivery leads, change teams, and vendors.

• Operational UX Expertise: Extensive experience in UX, interaction, and service design focused on complex tools for expert users rather than consumer apps.

• Complex Decision Support: A proven ability to design real-time, data-heavy products that make complex information trustworthy and actionable.

• Platform Savvy: Skilled at navigating SaaS, device, and data constraints, knowing exactly when to configure vs. when to build custom.

• Strong Research & Mapping Skills: Advanced capabilities in end-to-end journey mapping, workflow design, and contextual research alongside Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).

• Stakeholder Management: A confident communicator who can articulate and defend design logic to senior operational, technical, and data leaders.

Customer
