**Welcome to the Pathogen Project:**

Within this ecosystem, the Pathogen Project exemplifies EIT’s dedication to ground-breaking science. It seeks to transform pathogen risk management, detection and response by leveraging Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS)-based metagenomic and pathogen-specific analytical tools. The goal is to power metagenomic devices using long-read sequencing technologies by building a comprehensive database of pathogen information to inform response. The database will comprise >400,00 paired high-quality long-read sequences with comprehensive antimicrobial susceptibility profiles. Enabled by Oracle Inc.’s cloud-computing scale and security, the Pathogen Project is advancing toward certified diagnostic tools for deployment in laboratories, hospitals, and public health organisations worldwide.

**Your Role:**

At EIT we are seeking an experienced and detailed orientated Research Assistant to join the Pathogen Program and support the generation of high-quality microbiology data and microbiology R&D.

We’re building a reference and innovation laboratory focused on large-scale biobanking and antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) of bacterial isolates, alongside sequencing-based characterisation. The goal is to generate high-quality datasets at scale to support  the development of metagenomic diagnostics and genome-based antimicrobial susceptibility prediction.

The laboratory is being developed as a highly automated environment, integrating robotics, data systems, and advanced instrumentation to enable scalable and reproducible workflows. Working under the supervision of senior microbiologists, you will work as part of a team towardsthe executionof a variety of protocols involving microbial culture, identification and biobanking, and phenotypic antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) primarily based on broth microdilution. While your core focus will be on protocol execution and laboratory operations within an automated laboratory system, you will also have the opportunity to contribute creatively to the design, development, and optimisation of workflows to enhance data generation and analytical depth.

This role operates in an objectives-driven, fast-paced environment, with a strong focus on delivery, data quality, and team outcomes.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone who enjoys working at the bench and is motivated to contribute to building efficient, scalable, and technology-driven laboratory systems towards the end-goal of reducing pathogen health burdens globally.

**Key Responsibilities**

Laboratory Testing, Design and Data Generation

- Perform AST of bacterial isolates compliant with established guidelines (EUCAST/CLSI).
- Contribute to the design and improvement of laboratory workflows, including assay setup, sample handling, and data generation processes.
- Prepare and handle microbial cultures under BSL-2 conditions, including plating, inoculation, and incubation ensuring excellent aseptic technique, biosafety, and quality control at all stages.
- Perform identification of microbial cultures using MALDI-TOF and/or culture-based methods.
- Perform biobanking of microbial cultures.
- Operate automated and semi-automated workflows for micro-broth dilution
- Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams, contributing to shared project and team objectives.

Laboratory Operations, Quality and Automation

- Execute laboratory workflows with a strong focus on quality, consistency, and reproducibility.
- Maintain detailed records of experiments, QC results and equipment logs.
- Perform quality control checks, flag deviations and troubleshoot unexpected results.
- Ensure laboratory equipment, consumables, and workspaces are in good working order.
- Work with and support automated laboratory platforms, including setup, operation, and basic troubleshooting.
- Ensure compliance with biosafety and laboratory standards.
- Perform stock control and ordering.

Workflow Development, Automation and Collaboration

- Work closely with microbiologists, genomics scientists, and automation engineers to support and improve workflows.
- Contribute to the design and optimisation of high-throughput laboratory processes.
- Support the implementation and continuous improvement of workflows on robotic and automated systems.
- Participate in team discussions and contribute ideas to improve efficiency, robustness, and scalability.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Essential skills**

First, we need the ability to write in the natural language of biology, enabling the rapid and scalable synthesis of entire genomes with precision. Second, we must understand what to write - determining which DNA sequences will generate biological systems that perform the desired functions. Addressing these challenges will allow us to harness the full power of biology to create transformative solutions across health, agriculture, clean energy and more.    

GBI will have sustained and substantial funding to support the unique scale and ambition of its ground-breaking vision for engineering biology. GBI researchers will also be supported by cutting-edge technology hubs including mass spectrometry, flow cytometry, sequencing, automation, imaging, and bioprocessing. GBI will also have access to substantial compute resources that can be leveraged to further accelerate progress, including scientific compute, bioinformatics, and machine learning. The environment at GBI will allow researchers to undertake ambitious, long-term, collaborative research, and we will actively support the translation of research to commercial applications, where appropriate.   

The Generative Biology Institute commenced operations in 2025, occupying newly renovated bespoke space in the Oxford Science Park. Once complete, this state-of-the-art facility will include more than 40,000 m² of research laboratory and office space.  It will house over 30 groups and up to 600 employees at scale, focused on solving the two critical challenges in making biology engineerable and applying the solutions to addressing the global challenges encapsulated in EIT’s Humane Endeavors.

This is an exciting opportunity to help establish and develop cutting-edge single-cell MS workflows within a highly collaborative, technology-driven research institute. The successful candidate will work closely with GBI research groups as well as scientists across other EIT institutes. We also work in close collaboration with other Tech Hubs including automation, flow cytometry, sequencing, bioinformatics, scientific computing and AI/ML, to deliver high-quality, reproducible and scalable analytical workflows.

We are looking for candidates with a good understanding of the challenges of low-input and single-cell analysis, that can communicate clearly with multidisciplinary teams, can develop robust experimental workflows, and are motivated to push the boundaries of what mass spectrometry can deliver.

This role is particularly suited to a scientist who enjoys developing new methods, troubleshooting complex analytical workflows, working across biological applications, and translating advanced MS technologies into accessible, high-impact research capability for the wider Institute.

**Welcome to the Plant Biology Institute:**

The Plant Biology Institute, headed by Professor Steve Kelly, is a key part of the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT) Oxford. The institute aims to develop impactful and commercially sustainable solutions for improving global food production and planetary health through pioneering plant science research.

The Plant Biology Institute will unite world-class researchers who are focused on expanding the frontiers of plant science. Our research is focused on enhancing our ability to feed the planet while simultaneously improving the climate and ecosystem outcomes of food production. By embedding cutting-edge plant science research within an organisation that is focused on solving global challenges at scale, we aim to accelerate the timeline from discovery to global impact.

Areas of exploration include:

- Improved plant productivity, both indoors and outside.
- Reduced reliance on inputs including water, fertilisers, pesticides, and herbicides.
- Novel decarbonised plant-based production platforms for food and medicines.
- Advanced technologies that speed up discovery and deployment in plants. 

Researchers will have access to state-of-the-art laboratory and plant growth facilities and have opportunities to collaborate with experts at the forefront of research on AI, automation, and generative biology across the EIT ecosystem. They will also work with global leaders in market development, commercialisation, and impact creation. The Plant Biology Institute has long-term substantial funding to support the unique scale and ambition of its vision.

**Your Role:**

EIT is seeking an experienced **Vector Design Manager** to join the Crop Transformation Pipeline team within the Plant Biology Institute. This role will lead the design, build strategy, quality control and release of transformation vectors and genome editing reagents for gene edited and transgenic crop programme.

The successful candidate will be a technical authority in commercial vector design, plant molecular biology and crop genome editing technologies. They will translate trait and editing objectives into transformation-ready vector designs, ensuring that constructs are fit-for-purpose for high-throughput transformation, event recovery, molecular characterisation and downstream product development.

This role is critical to building an industrial-grade vector design capability for crops including corn, wheat and other strategic species. The candidate will establish design standards, construct QC criteria, vendor workflows, sequence/data management processes and clear handover packages for transformation and event delivery teams.

The candidate will own the upstream design-to-vector-release process, ensuring that all constructs entering transformation are technically sound, traceable, QC-approved and aligned with commercial and regulatory expectations.

**Your Responsibilities:**

- Lead vector design strategy for gene edited and transgenic crop projects, including expression cassette architecture, promoter and terminator selection, selectable/reporter marker choice, cargo design, guide RNA modules, donor templates and multiplex editing configurations.
- Translate trait biology, editing objectives and transformation requirements into vectors suitable for Agrobacterium-mediated, biolistic and emerging plant delivery systems.
- Provide expert guidance on CRISPR/Cas systems, Cas12, base editing, prime editing, multiplex editing, homology-directed repair, transgene-free approaches and marker-free design options where appropriate.
- Develop commercial-grade design rules that consider transformation performance, event quality, freedom-to-operate, stewardship, regulatory needs, trait stacking, construct stability and downstream assay ability.
- Own construct intake, design review, annotation, nomenclature, barcode strategy, version control, sequence verification, risk assessment and release criteria before vectors enter transformation workflows.
- Manage internal and external vector build activities, including DNA synthesis, cloning, plasmid QC, sequence confirmation, Agrobacterium strain selection, Agrobacterium introduction, glycerol stock tracking and vector delivery to transformation teams.
- Work closely with event delivery and genotyping colleagues to ensure vectors are designed with the right molecular assay strategy, including junction assays, copy number assays, guide/edit assays and marker/backbone detection.
- Build and maintain a structured vector inventory and construct database using ELN, LIMS and sequence management tools, ensuring full traceability from request through vector release.
- Create SOPs, design templates, QC checklists, construct handover forms and decision records to support reproducible, auditable and scalable vector delivery.
- Track vector design and build milestones, budgets, vendor dependencies, quality risks and delivery timelines, escalating blockers early and proposing contingency plans.
- Partner with legal, IP, regulatory, procurement and external collaborators to ensure vector designs and material transfers are aligned with programme and commercial requirements.
- Train and mentor scientists, research associates and project teams in vector design principles, sequence review, construct documentation and transformation-readiness criteria.
- The successful candidate will combine deep molecular design expertise with strong operational discipline. They will help reduce failed transformation cycles by ensuring that constructs are technically robust, well documented and suitable for downstream event confirmation before experiments begin.

The candidate will be expected to identify opportunities for IP creation, support commercial vector design decisions and contribute to EIT's mission of translating plant science into high-impact, scalable crop improvement technologies.

## Requirements

**Essential Skills, Qualifications & Experience:**

- PhD in Plant Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Genomics, Crop Science or a related discipline, or MSc with significant relevant industry experience. At least 5-7 years of experience in plant biotechnology, molecular design, genome editing or vector development.
- Demonstrated expertise in plant vector design for crop transformation, including binary vectors, expression cassette design, regulatory elements, selectable/reporter systems, multi-gene constructs and transformation-compatible plasmid architecture.
- Strong understanding of genome editing technologies, including CRISPR/Cas systems, guide RNA design, multiplex editing, base editing, prime editing, donor template design and edited event confirmation requirements.
- Experience with construct design and sequence analysis tools such as Benchling, SnapGene, Geneious, Vector NTI or equivalent platforms, with strong capability in sequence annotation, alignment and design review.
- Practical understanding of crop transformation workflows and the design features that influence transformation efficiency, regeneration, event quality and molecular characterization.
- Experience managing DNA synthesis, cloning, sequencing, plasmid QC, Agrobacterium preparation or related external service provider workflows.
- Strong project management skills, including milestone tracking, risk management, vendor coordination, resource planning and delivery against time-sensitive programme goals.
- Excellent documentation discipline, including SOP development, construct release records, version control, data integrity and traceable decision-making.
- Ability to work across multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex vector design decisions clearly to scientists, operational teams and leadership stakeholders.

**Desirable Skills, Qualifications & Experience:**

- Experience in industrial ag-biotech, commercial seed/trait development, crop transformation platforms or product development pipelines.
- Hands-on experience supporting vector design for corn, wheat, soybean or other major crop species.
- Knowledge of GLP, QMS or quality-controlled research environments relevant to commercial product development.

- Experience with high-throughput or automated design-build-test-learn workflows, including LIMS integration, barcoding and dashboard reporting.

Due to continued growth and project demand, EPS seeks a graduate power system engineer to join our expanding team.

## What We’re Looking For: Electrical Engineering Background

We are seeking a motivated Graduate Power System Engineer with at least a **2:1 degree** in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. You should have a good understanding of core electrical engineering principles and ideally some exposure to onshore or offshore industries such as oil & gas, power distribution, wind energy, manufacturing, or petrochemicals. Proficiency with spreadsheets for calculations and analysis, along with strong problem-solving skills and clear communication, is essential.

Experience with power system modelling software such as **ETAP**, **DIgSILENT**, or **CDEGS** would be advantageous, but full training and mentoring will be provided through the EPS Graduate Programme. Above all, we are looking for someone eager to learn, confident working with clients, and committed to developing their career within a world-class engineering consultancy.

### Behavioural Competencies

- **Teamwork and Collaboration:** Works confidently autonomously and as part of a team, using own initiative whilst keeping colleagues and clients informed.
- **Self-Management:** Prioritises, works smart and demonstrates a high level of accountability and a willingness to learn.
- **Effective Communication:** Makes a highly effective and collaborative contribution to the team by sharing knowledge, learning and information.
- **Motivation and Drive:** Demonstrate a highly motivated approach and a can-do attitude – driven to deliver technical excellence and a desire to learn new skills.
- **Customer Awareness:** Receptive to client needs, with the ability to build an excellent rapport. The ability to represent EPS with a professional approach.

- **Report Writing Skills:** Uses well-developed report writing skills, paying attention to detail to produce written documentation of high quality.
- **Project Management Skills:** Utilises well-developed technical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills by establishing the accuracy and relevance of information.
- **Creativity and Curiosity:** Open to challenge, using creativity to think beyond boundaries.
- **A passion for engineering:** Any engineering-related activities carried out during or out of formal education would be advantageous.

### **Training & Development**

One-to-one training will be provided by an experienced Chartered Electrical Engineer to support your professional development. EPS will also deliver structured training in **ETAP**, **DIgSILENT**, and **PSCAD** power system modelling software, equipping you with the skills to perform complex engineering calculations and simulations.

Where required, Basic Offshore Safety Induction and Emergency Training **(BOSIET)** may also be provided to prepare you for offshore project work.

EPS is growing. Our clients value both the work we deliver and how we deliver it. That continued demand is creating opportunity across the business.

We’re looking for Power Systems Engineers at different stages of their careers. Whether you’re building your experience or already operating at a senior level, what matters is strong technical fundamentals and the appetite to keep developing, be challenged, and contribute to what comes next for EPS.

**The opportunity**

EY's Transaction Forensics – Sale and Purchase Agreements (SPA) team provides expert support to clients, investment banks, lawyers, and deal teams on Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) pricing mechanisms and the accounting aspects of SPAs, including support around any post-deal Completion Accounts. You will assist clients in their SPA negotiations and will interact with deal teams and clients across the transaction life cycle. 

**Your key responsibilities**

You will lead and deliver advice around the price adjustment mechanisms on M&A transactions, working closely with clients, their bankers and legal advisers, transaction diligence teams, and other SPA team members. - **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**The exceptional EY experience. Shape your future with confidence!**

**Apply now.**

The Principal Security Engineer is a technical security position in the F5 Security Incident Response Team (F5 SIRT). Addressing security issues in F5 products is the responsibility of the F5 Security Incident Response Team (F5 SIRT). The F5 SIRT is a dedicated, global team that manages the receipt, investigation, and public reporting of security vulnerability information that is related to F5 products and networks.
The Principal Security Engineer position provides expert security technical leadership for F5 SIRT. This position requires complete Security Knowledge and an expert with regards to security threats, incident handling methodologies and offensive/defensive attack vectors. A Principal Security Engineer follows incident handling procedures to drive mitigation of security incidents and will be called to perform expert attack analysis, configuration suggestions, and potential onsite interaction. A Principal Security Engineer can handle multiple active issues of diverse scope simultaneously while maintaining good communication, particularly written communication to our customers, and accepts ownership of issues until a resolution is delivered or a business as usual state is returned, providing high customer satisfaction. When not engaged in incidents, a Principal Security Engineer will mentor other security related issues, researches emerging threats and both documents and presents their impact on F5 products and services. Advocates every single day for improving the security of F5 products and services.
A good candidate has a deep passion for security and a desire to help develop a security mindset in others. The role also requires a strong ability to work with incomplete information and to adapt to changing priorities.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Responsible for upholding F5s business code of ethics & for promptly reporting violations of the code or other company policies
• Manages multiple issues and prioritizes based upon customer and business needs, without direction
• Provides F5 customers with a consistently high-quality support experience
• Assist other Security Engineers with other tasks as required based upon business operation needs
• Effectively engages supporting escalation personnel, without direction
• Participate in weekend support rotation
• Participate in tier 2 and tier 3 security support
• Provides F5 customers with high-quality support experience
• Manages multiple issues and prioritizes based upon customer and business needs, without direction
• Effectively engages supporting escalation personnel, without direction
• Ensure complete and clear incident documentation
• Maintain incident documentation, participate in post-mortems, and write incident reports.
• Continuous research into emerging threats and mitigation options
• Independently develops and deliver security content and training based on research and testing within the security field and with F5 products to drive security mindset.
• Perform general security awareness and specific security technology training
• Engages in ongoing training within the security field and with F5 products
• Follows processes defined in F5’s Quality Management System (QMS)
• Work closely with others to develop incident response plans
• Identify the gaps between the security incident response process and customers' needs, optimize/improve the workflow/process
• Act as the technical lead, identify the knowledge/technical skill gaps in the team, develop a training plan for the team, mentor/train other members of the team
• Identify trends and/or common knowledge gaps and ensure they are documented via the KCS Solve Loop
• Ensure that security-related knowledge is documented within KCS and represent Security within the KCS Evolve Loop, for example RCA feedback into product design & documentation
• May lead projects and provide guidance/training to less experienced staff, mentoring.
• Perform expert threat and vulnerability management, monitoring of CVE, and vendor notifications
• Evaluate and execute cross-functional security initiatives across the enterprise.
• Work with cross-functional Engineering teams to ensure all systems are properly remediated according to our policies and standards.
• Lead steering committee(s) to analyze vulnerabilities and their impact to assess risk ratings
• Provide strategic security analytics metrics and reports.
• Capable of anticipating future business challenges and crafting security strategies that mitigate those risks
• Provide security-related metrics for all levels, including executive-level dashboards to demonstrate process effectiveness and remediation across the enterprise
• Effectively communicate and document risks related to the vulnerability environment and appropriate levels of urgency to management and engineering staff
• Represent Security on organizational projects and ensure adherence to existing security policies and standards.
• Work closely with Incident Response and Risk Management teams and leverage corporate tools to provide supporting documentation for remediation prioritization and emergency security coverage.
• Ability to think with a security mindset. The successful candidate has a strong IT background with in-depth knowledge of several key security practice areas: application security, network security, and infrastructure security.

Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) and Vulnerability Management
• Monitor and identify security vulnerabilities in F5’s products and Services by tracking internal reports, external researcher submissions, bug bounty programs, and industry threat intelligence
• Triage and assess reported vulnerabilities and incidents, determining severity, impact, and prioritization based on risk to customers and systems
• Coordinate with Product Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Corporate Communications, and other teams to develop security advisories for security issues.
• Communicate effectively with stakeholders, disseminating clear security advisories, mitigations, and fix notifications to customers, partners, and the public.
• Manage interactions with external security researchers, validating vulnerability disclosures, and facilitating recognition or rewards through bug bounty programs when applicable.
• Document all security incidents, responses, and resolutions to ensure compliance, support audits, and drive process improvements.

• Engage with the broader security community, participating in industry forums, sharing threat intelligence, and collaborating with other PSIRTs to stay ahead of emerging threats (CISA, FIRST, VINCE, etc).

Customer Security Incident Response

Building Security Mindset - Security Evangelism

• Handling reactive mentor questions on Security from F5 SIRT Specialists and NSEs – Monitor F5 SIRT email
• Creating security presentations for a wide audience
• Engages in ongoing training within the security field and with F5 products
• May lead projects and provide guidance/training to less experienced staff and mentoring.
• Evaluate and execute cross-functional security initiatives across the enterprise.

• Information security subject matter expert
• Expert understanding of industry standards such as CVE, CPE, and CVSS

• Expert OS hardening and security best practices
• Knowledge of common Malware types and infection vectors
• Expert knowledge in threat modeling, secure architecture, secure coding practices, and security testing.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
• Hands on technical experience with and very knowledgeable on LAN/WAN operations, and/or networking hardware required
• CVE and CERT experience

• Proven track record in a team environment

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

At Fitch Ratings, credit analysts play a pivotal role in moving markets, as quality credit analysis is the lifeblood of our organization. With a legacy of over a century, our unique approach to credit ratings offers unmatched opportunities for professional growth. Embracing a “challenger mindset,” you'll join a team dedicated to innovating service to our clients. Our people-driven analysis thrives on collaboration across all levels and locations, surpassing traditional financial modeling. Lastly, as part of our global community, you'll find inspiration, challenge, and support, with ample opportunities for visibility and influence in the global financial marketplace.

Want to learn more about a career as a credit analyst at Fitch Ratings? Visit: [https://careers.fitch.group/content/Credit-Analysts/](https://careers.fitch.group/content/Credit-Analysts/)

Fitch Ratings’ Funds & Asset Management group is a global team responsible for fund ratings analysis, methodology and model development, and publication of research on analytical and regulatory developments affecting the asset management sector. The group analyzes and publishes research on private equity fund finance and securitizations, leveraged closed end funds (CEFs), money market funds (MMFs), bonds funds, exchange traded funds (ETFs), local government investment pools (LGIPs), and asset managers.

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**  

- Analyze quantitative and qualitative factors influencing the credit quality of funds and structured transactions, including portfolio analysis
- Review legal documentation for transactions, including indentures, prospectuses, etc.
- Develop financial models and databases
- Participate in on-site due diligence review meetings with fund managers
- Present rating recommendations to committees
- Contribute to research on relevant trends affecting the sectors the group covers
- Participate in industry events and interact with investors, bankers, fund managers, and other market participants

- Sound academic track record to at least first university degree level, preferably in finance, economics, statistics, accounting, or computer science
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- French or Italian language skills would be a plus

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

- Experience with fund finance, including subscription facilities or NAV loans; or experience with structured finance or lending
- Knowledge of SQL, VBA, and/or other programming languages
- Demonstrated track record of initiative and achievement

- **Hybrid Work Environment:**  3 days a week in office required

What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior SecOps Engineer to take ownership of security operations at Flagstone. That covers everything from alert triage and incident response through to detection engineering and continuous improvement of how our SOC works.

This is a hands-on role that sits right at the operational end of security. You’ll spend real time in the alert queue, as well as building the detections and automation that make it better. You’ll be right in the middle of complex investigations and P1s, while also shaping how the function operates. You’ll also own our relationship with our managed SOC provider, setting the standards they work to rather than simply receiving their output.

About the team

You’ll sit within Security Engineering, reporting to our Security Team Leader. In this role you’ll own detection, triage and incident response, and act as the technical counterpart to our managed SOC provider. That means directing their scope, holding them to clear detection and response standards, and keeping ownership of anything escalated or high severity in house.

Does this sound like you?

You’re an engineer at heart. You’d rather write the detection than describe it, and you treat detections and automation like any other engineering work: version controlled, tested and documented. You’re the go to expert when something serious happens, and you can explain security risk just as clearly to engineers as to senior stakeholders.

Job Description:
ABOUT THE CLIENT AND ROLE
Diageo is home to some of the most famous brands in the world, including Johnnie Walker, Guinness, Smirnoff and Baileys. These are brands with extraordinary heritage, global scale and ambitious plans for growth.
At PHD, we're helping Diageo transform how these brands connect with consumers around the world through a new approach to media and marketing built around Connected Reach.
At the heart of this transformation is a shift in how we activate brands. Rather than thinking about media as a collection of individual channels, we're building a more connected approach across four complementary areas: Communications, Communities, Creators and Commerce.
Each has a distinct role to play. Communications builds brand fame and reaches audiences at scale. Communities create relevance and deeper connections around shared interests and passions. Creators bring authenticity, influence and cultural credibility. Commerce connects consumer demand with opportunities to purchase.
Together, they create a more connected way to reach consumers, build brands and drive growth.
This transformation makes the role of Digital Planning Director more important than ever.
As the boundaries between media, content, culture and commerce become increasingly blurred, digital expertise needs to sit at the heart of strategic planning - not simply be brought in once the strategy has been developed.
Sitting at the intersection of our global strategy and digital teams, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how Connected Reach comes to life. You'll bring deep digital expertise into the strategic process, helping define the role of each of the 4Cs, identify opportunities to connect them and translate our thinking into actionable digital strategies.
Crucially, this isn't just about developing great strategies for individual brands. It's about building the global planning frameworks, playbooks and toolkits that will define how Diageo activates Connected Reach across its portfolio and markets worldwide.
You'll help establish a consistent, scalable approach to digital planning that regional and local teams can adopt, ensuring that our global strategies translate into connected, high-quality activation wherever Diageo's brands operate.
WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR
Bringing Connected Reach to Life
You'll play a central role in translating Diageo's Connected Reach transformation into practical media planning approaches. You'll help define how Communications, Communities, Creators and Commerce work individually and collectively to reach consumers, build brands and drive growth. You'll ensure that the 4Cs become an integrated planning approach rather than four separate activation disciplines.
Bridging Global Strategy and Digital Expertise
You'll act as the critical connection between our global strategy teams and digital specialists, ensuring that digital expertise shapes our thinking from the outset. You'll bring a deep understanding of platforms, audiences, technology and activation into strategic responses, helping develop ideas that are both ambitious and grounded in how digital media works.
Building Global Planning Frameworks and Toolkits
You'll lead the development of planning frameworks, playbooks and toolkits that turn Connected Reach into a practical, repeatable way of working. From defining the role of the 4Cs to establishing channel principles, audience approaches and activation guidelines, you'll create the tools that enable markets to translate global brand strategies into connected media plans.
Driving Consistency Across Global Markets
You'll help establish a standardised approach to digital planning across Diageo's regions and markets. Working closely with global, regional and local teams, you'll ensure that our frameworks and toolkits are understood, adopted and embedded in everyday planning, creating greater consistency while allowing for local consumer, cultural and market differences.
Connecting the 4Cs Across the Consumer Journey
You'll help identify how Communications, Communities, Creators and Commerce can work together to create more effective consumer experiences. Rather than planning channels in isolation, you'll bring a connected perspective to audience journeys, platform roles, content, influence and conversion — ensuring that each element contributes to the overall brand and business ambition.
Turning Global Strategy Into Actionable Digital Plans
You'll translate global brand and communications strategies into clear, implementable digital planning recommendations. Working with activation specialists, you'll help shape channel roles, audience strategies, platform approaches and investment priorities, ensuring that our plans are strategically rigorous, digitally sophisticated and practical for markets to execute.
Championing Digital Innovation and New Opportunities
You'll bring a forward-looking perspective on the changing digital landscape, identifying opportunities across platforms, creators, communities, commerce, data and technology. You'll work with our specialist teams and global partners to turn emerging opportunities into scalable approaches that can strengthen Diageo's Connected Reach ambitions.
Embedding Data, Technology and Planning Tools
You'll champion the use of Omni and our wider data and technology capabilities to strengthen the rigour of our planning. You'll help embed audience insights, planning tools and measurement frameworks into the global toolkits we develop, ensuring that teams have the capabilities and guidance needed to deliver more effective connected media strategies.
Building Capability Across Global and Local Teams
You'll help raise the standard of digital planning across the Diageo account, working with regional and local teams to embed new approaches, share best practice and develop digital planning capabilities. You'll play an important role in helping teams move from understanding Connected Reach as a strategic ambition to confidently applying it in their day-to-day planning.

WHAT YOU BRING
Experience in digital media planning and strategy within a leading media agency, ideally with experience working on large, international brands.
Deep understanding of the digital ecosystem, including programmatic, social, video, search, creators, communities and commerce, and how these disciplines can work together to drive brand growth.
A strong strategic mindset, with the ability to connect high-level brand ambitions with the realities and opportunities of digital media activation.
Experience developing integrated digital strategies that connect brand building, consumer engagement and conversion across the consumer journey.
Proven ability to develop planning frameworks, playbooks and toolkits that simplify complex strategic thinking into practical, scalable approaches.
Experience working across global, regional or multi-market accounts, with an understanding of how to balance global consistency and local market relevance.
The confidence and credibility to work across senior strategy, planning and digital teams, challenging thinking and bringing specialist expertise into the strategic process.
Strong knowledge of audience planning, data, measurement, technology and the role they play in delivering more connected and effective media strategies.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex digital subjects simple, compelling and actionable for a wide range of stakeholders.
A collaborative leadership style, with a passion for raising planning standards, developing capabilities and helping teams embrace new ways of working.

This role partners with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, Shared Services, and business stakeholders to ensure Workday processes, data, and controls are effective, compliant, and scalable. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

Job Description:
Reporting to: Head of Insights & Effectiveness

As an Insights & Effectiveness Director at Fuse, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering industry-leading sponsorship measurement programmes and insights-led solutions for UK and international clients.

As one of the senior leaders within the Insights & Effectiveness team, you will lead the continued development of Fuse's Media Valuation proposition, acting as the team's subject matter expert and senior client advisor in this area. Alongside this specialism, you will design and deliver broader sponsorship effectiveness programmes that combine media valuation, audience insight, consumer research, digital analytics and other measurement approaches to answer complex client challenges.

Working closely with the Head of Insights & Effectiveness and fellow Insights & Effectiveness Director, you will help drive the evolution of Fuse's measurement offering, maintain exceptional quality standards and support the development of future talent across the team.

The Insights & Effectiveness team is methodology agnostic and curious by nature. We believe the best answers come from bringing together multiple data sources and approaches rather than relying on a single framework. As such, we are looking for someone who is passionate about understanding sponsorship effectiveness through a blend of media research, consumer research, analytics and measurement innovation.

This role requires a combination of research expertise, strategic thinking, commercial acumen, leadership capability and a deep understanding of the evolving media, sponsorship and partnerships landscape.

Main day-to-day responsibilities will include, but not limited to:
Client Leadership
• Act as a senior lead across key UK and international clients, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and championing the Insights & Effectiveness offering.
• Serve as Fuse's primary subject matter expert for Media Valuation, providing strategic oversight, methodological expertise and senior client leadership across valuation programmes.
• Lead the design and delivery of holistic sponsorship measurement solutions, combining valuation, audience insights, brand measurement, digital analytics and other methodologies to address client objectives.
• Translate complex data and methodologies into clear, engaging and commercially actionable recommendations.
• Develop bespoke measurement approaches in response to client challenges, ensuring solutions are robust, innovative and aligned to business needs.
• Lead project scoping, renewals and growth conversations, identifying opportunities to expand both Insights & Effectiveness and broader Fuse services.
• Represent Fuse's expertise through client presentations, thought leadership initiatives and industry engagement opportunities.
Team Leadership
• Provide leadership, coaching and mentorship across the Insights & Effectiveness team, particularly in sponsorship valuation and measurement best practice.
• Foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration and continuous learning, encouraging the team to challenge assumptions and explore new approaches.
• Review team outputs and provide strategic guidance and constructive feedback, ensuring consistently high standards of analysis, storytelling and client delivery.
• Share knowledge and build capability across the wider business, helping colleagues understand both valuation methodologies and broader sponsorship effectiveness frameworks.
• Monitor industry developments, competitor offerings and emerging measurement approaches to ensure Fuse remains at the forefront of the market.
• Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Fuse's products, methodologies and analytical capabilities.
Commercial Leadership
• Play a key role in new business pitches, contributing strategic thinking, methodology design and compelling narratives.
• Identify opportunities to strengthen and grow Fuse's Insights & Effectiveness offering through new products, services and methodologies.
• Support business development efforts through thought leadership, innovation and commercial consultancy.
• Help develop propositions that demonstrate the value of sponsorship beyond media exposure alone.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with divisional leads to embed a "Seriously Effective" mindset across all Fuse work.
• Partner with the Strategy and Rights Consultancy teams to develop data-led partnership strategies and evidence-based recommendations.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Fuse and the Omnicom network to leverage the latest capabilities, tools and best practices.
• Support integrated client solutions by bringing together expertise from multiple disciplines and agencies.

Desired Skills & Experience
• Proven experience in a senior insights, research, analytics or measurement role, ideally within sponsorship, media, sport, entertainment, partnerships or a related industry.
• Significant experience delivering sponsorship media valuation programmes and advising clients on media value and sponsorship effectiveness.
• Good understanding of media planning, media measurement and audience analytics across broadcast, digital and social channels.
• Experience developing measurement frameworks that combine multiple methodologies and data sources.
• A naturally curious and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to identify the most appropriate methodology for a client challenge.
• Strong understanding of sponsorship, partnership marketing and communications effectiveness.
• Experience managing senior client relationships and acting as a trusted strategic advisor.
• Excellent storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex methodologies and data in a compelling and accessible way.
• Proven experience coaching, mentoring and developing talent.
• Commercially minded, with experience contributing to business growth and new business opportunities.
• Strong data visualisation skills and experience creating engaging client-ready presentations and reports.
• Experience delivering bespoke UK and international sponsorship measurement programmes.
• Understanding of consumer research (quantitative and qualitative), brand tracking and econometric concepts is desirable.
• Experience using industry tools and platforms including social listening, digital analytics and consumer research data sources (e.g. YouGov, TGI, GWI).
• Experience with Power BI and emerging AI-enabled analytical solutions is a plus.
• Passion for sport, entertainment, culture, media and brand storytelling.

You need to have the ability and willingness to work flexibly, usually in the London office, with occasional international travel.

This is a full-time role and you must be eligible to work in the UK.

• The ability to work confidently across Media Operations, Planning, Activation, Marketing Effectiveness, Data and Technology teams.

• A practical approach to problem solving: able to identify root causes, prioritise opportunities and translate requirements into scalable solutions.

Global Compliance & Operational Delivery

 Customer Relationship & Activation

• Escalations & Problem-Solving: Act as the direct escalation point for complex operational inquiries, resolving issues with high speed and precision.

Operational Scaling & Process Improvement

• Playbook Development: Document and refine implementation playbooks, scalable workflows, and enterprise delivery standards to continuously decrease time-to-first-payroll.

Minimum requirements

• Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and translate complex regulatory/operational realities into simple, actionable steps for clients.

• Experience handling complex, high-volume employee transfers (TUPE, M&A transitions, or enterprise-wide migrations).

• International work experience across EMEA, LATAM, or APAC regions.

• Stakeholder Orchestration: Keeping clients, local ops, and CSMs aligned on timeline and scope.

• Time-to-Activation / Speed-to-Onboard: Minimizing the cycle time from contract signing to employee active state.

As the Sr. Director & Head of Architecture at G-P, you will be the visionary leader responsible for defining and executing the long-term technical strategy for our global products and AI platforms and influence technical decisions across the company. • Strategic Technical Leadership: Define and strongly influence the execution of a target-state, AI-native architecture that supports both core software services and advanced AI Agentic behaviors.

• Architectural Governance: Establish global standards for architecture consistency, ensuring all platform components maximize reuse and align with the long-term technology roadmap.

• Innovation & Research: Serve as the ultimate "sounding board" for introducing new technologies, 3rd-party integrations, and open-source solutions to keep the platform at the forefront of the industry.

• Reliability & Performance: Ensure system and infrastructure architecture results in high reliability, low latency, and minimal outages as a primary measure of organizational success.

• Culture Builder: Help create a strong culture of innovation and technical excellence across the organization.

Minimum Requirements: 

• 15+ years of experience in software engineering and architecture, building products and platforms with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or directorial capacity managing Architecture teams.

• Extensive Cloud Expertise: Proven track record of designing and deploying distributed, cloud-native architectures, especially AWS.

• AI First Product & Tech Strategies : Experience with building AI Native products and technologies. 

• Strategic Communication: Demonstrated ability to gain buy-in for large-scale technical shifts from both executive leadership and hands-on engineering teams.

• Change Management: Experience leading architectural digital transformations within a rapidly growing or "unstructured" corporate environment.

• Financial Acumen: Ability to analyze technology trade-offs through the lens of Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and ROI.

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. About The Position

As an HR Specialist in the Employer of Record (EOR) industry, you’ll be a key business partner to our clients, not just a service provider. You’ll sit at the intersection of global expansion and workforce management- advising clients on complex HR matters across EMEA. You’ll own the full employee lifecycle, act as their trusted in-country HR expert, and ensure smooth operations, compliance, and growth.

What You Will Do

• Lead end-to-end TUPE processes across the UK/Ireland regions acting as the primary HR subject matter expert for incoming and outgoing business transfers.

• Coordinate and facilitate mandatory employee consultation processes, manage election of representatives where required, and ensure compliance with statutory consultation timelines.

• Oversee the collation, audit, and exchange of employment data, noting measures, and identify contractual risks and legacy benefits implications

• Manage sensitive transfer-related cases, pre- and post-transfer harmonisation queries, potential redundancy procedures, attend calls or meetings, and draft legally sound documentation.

• Build and manage relationships with external payroll providers, benefits brokers, pension administrators, and specialised employment legal advisors to ensure seamless benefit alignment and pension transfer compliance.

• Be the first point of contact for client queries on benefits, terms and conditions protections, compliance, and post-transfer integration strategies across the UK and Ireland.

• Stay ahead of evolving UK/Ireland TUPE regulations and cultural nuances to provide actionable, risk-aware guidance.

• Review and advise on measures statements, contract variations post-transfer, restrictive covenants, and overall risk mitigation strategies.

• Guide clients through post-transfer alignment, performance management, and ensure timely salary and benefit changes in line with legal protections.

• Drive automation and AI adoption to streamline TUPE diligence, documentation, and client-facing transfer HR processes.

• Provide cross-functional support on broader HR operational tasks, employee onboarding, lifecycle administration, etc. as business priorities dictate.

• Contribute to wider EMEA HR initiatives, projects, and ad-hoc operational requirements as part of the wider HR Operations team. 

What We Are Looking For

Minimum requirements:

• 3+ years of specialised HR experience with strong hands-on exposure to UK/Ireland TUPE regulations.

• Deep expertise of regional labour laws and regulatory frameworks in the UK and Ireland.

• Proven experience leading end-to-end business transfers, consultations, and managing complex employee relations.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, consultation, and problem-solving skills.

• Tech-savvy with HRIS, Zendesk, Jira, Confluence, Tableau, and collaboration tools like Zoom & Slack 

Preferred Requirements:

• Knowledge of the EOR industry

Assistant Commissioning Engineer - South West Water
Location - Plymouth
An opportunity has arisen for an Assistant Commissioning Engineer to join the team at Galliford Try within our Environment Business.
Ideally, you will be based in or around the Plymouth area and will have the opportunity to travel across multiple sites/projects in the Region.
You will work on our Capital Maintenance Water Frameworks within our Environment Business, who are experienced in successfully delivering schemes of varying sizes, predominantly to the Water Industry, across both Wastewater and Clean Water Treatment schemes.
What you will be doing:
As an Assistant Commissioning Engineer you will help make sure newly installed and modified water and wastewater treatment systems work safely and efficiently, meet the project specification and meet client requirements before handover.
You will be site based and paired with an experienced Commissioning Engineer as your mentor. Together you will test and troubleshoot new and modified equipment, write reports, and make sure every component works as it should. You will follow our Structured Training Framework (STF), which gives you a formal record of your training and competence. Once you complete the training modules and show competence, you will move up to full Commissioning Engineer.
Design to Commission sits at the heart of how we work. You will help develop the Project Commissioning Plan, Commissioning Strategy and commissioning documentation, from an outline strategy at early design through to a detailed plan at project award. You will provide regular MEICA & Commissioning status reports and help keep the commissioning programme up to date within the main contract programme, working with the planner.
You will help organise and supervise testing and commissioning, including supply chain packages, Plant in Operation commissioning, and witness testing of FATs and functional tests. You will check that MEICA installations meet client specifications, Asset Standards and, where relevant, WIMES, and that Galliford Try processes and procedures are followed.
You will work with the client's Asset Operations Team to keep new works integrated with existing assets, and with the client's Asset Integrator to agree the takeover deliverables list. You will also work with specialist teams, including DSEAR Hazardous Areas, Technical Authors and Document Controllers, and make sure O&M information from subcontractors reaches document control.
You will support the Project Manager with a successful handover by managing snags and defects collaboratively, clearing outstanding works while contractors are still on site, and showing that quality criteria are met through the performance test process.
Safety is part of every task. You will learn to put in place and maintain MEICA safe systems of work, help apply the Electrical & Mechanical safety rules, and regularly assess new risks and hazards on your projects.
About you:
• Able to read and work from engineering drawings, and apply safety regulations and site admin
• Enjoy troubleshooting and finding solutions to technical problems
• Clear verbal and written communication, for working with a wide range of stakeholders and writing reports
• A hands-on approach and a keen interest in learning new skills
• Happy to travel and stay overnight on occasion, as work is split between office and site
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Word and Excel, for reporting
• 5 GCSEs at Grade C / 4 or above, including Maths, English and Science
• Full UK driving licence
• CSCS or ECS card in a relevant discipline
• SSSTS as a minimum
Desirable:
• Degree, HNC/HND or equivalent in Mechanical, Electrical or a related discipline
• SMSTS
• EUSR National Water Hygiene Card
• First Aid at Work
• An understanding of water and wastewater treatment processes

What we can offer in return:
With an order book of over £4.3 billion, we are one of the industry's major principal contractors, giving you the chance to work on some of the UK's most exciting projects, with stability and room to grow your skills and reach long-held career goals. You will join diverse teams working at a high professional level with exceptional levels of commitment. With a clear strategy for growth, if you're committed, talented and enthusiastic, Galliford Try is the right place for you.

About this role:

Our Business Development teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market. Gartner Business Development Managers strategically acquire new clients by cultivating trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives to understand their mission critical priorities and uncover opportunities to deliver client-value through the lens of the industry in which they operate. Gartner Business Developers drive the full sales cycle, from identifying prospects to closure and transition of new accounts to the account management team. 

About Gartner Midsize Enterprise (MSE):

MSE represents one of Gartner’s largest sales populations across the US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. This high-growth sales organization acquires and supports our High Tech and End User client accounts with annual revenue targets between $10 million and $1 billion per year.

Understanding The Work Environment & Standards Across MSE:

Gartner MSE operates in a hybrid work environment. This means working virtually and in the office. We have in-office experiences which can be as often as several times each week like 1:1’s with your manager, team meetings, and upskilling sessions. Coming together with colleagues in our Gartner office is a great way to build relationships across the business while collaborating, learning, and growing together. 

At Gartner MSE, our sales associates play a key role in partnering with C-Level executives. We believe a professional appearance and workspace play a big part in building trust and credibility. As such, we maintain a business casual dress code. 

What you will do:

Business Development Managers will be given a territory of Midsize Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. Other role highlights include: 
• Build trust-based value-added relationships with C-Level prospects to quickly uncover the mission critical priorities and determine how Gartner can support success. 

• Drive high-quality activity to build pipeline with multi-touch prospecting outreach and campaigns. 

• Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team.

• Conduct calls with C-Level prospects to qualify, showcase capabilities and close the business. 

• Partner with internal partners across the business to bring Gartner to life through portal walkthroughs and proof of concepts. 

• Transition new accounts to account management to ensure a fast start to new client value. 

• Deliver against assigned annual quota for your territory. 

What you will need:
• 1+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments. 

• Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives. 

• Proven track record meeting and exceeding sales targets. 

• Proven ability to precisely manage and forecast a complex sales process. 

• Willingness to live within a commutable distance to the location required for this role.

• Relocation assistance is available for qualifying candidates. 

• Bachelor's degree desired 

What you will get:
• We'll invest in you. At Gartner, you'll get more than just a job. You'll get everything you need to build an exciting, rewarding career.

• Career growth starts here. Take your growth into your own hands by tapping into individual development plans, mentorships, and career progression opportunities.

• Uncapped earnings potential. Our sellers' success is recognized and rewarded accordingly.

• Comprehensive onboarding. All new hires begin their time at Gartner by going through Expedition, a robust training program to help them succeed.

• Rewards and recognition. Annual "Winners Circle" event, an all-expense paid trip for our top performers each year.

• Consistent quarter over quarter growth. Gartner is purposefully built to adjust, adapt and pivot our strategy when macro-environmental shifts occur.

About the role: 
The Recruiting Coordination team are candidate care experts. We’re a global team of resourceful, cross-functional professionals who partner closely with our TA partners to provide a world-class experience for candidates throughout the interview process.
The Recruiting Coordinator is responsible for scheduling interviews, managing logistics, and all aspects of candidate care for internal and external candidates. The RC will partner directly with hiring managers, candidates, and recruiters to ensure all logistics related to scheduling are managed professionally. This position demands an outstanding ability to multitask as well as superior organizational skills. It requires an individual who always understands the necessity for confidentiality and professionalism and can deliver in a fast-paced, demanding environment with the ability to adapt to change.

What you’ll do:
• Support scheduling and scheduling logistics for multiple recruiters and business units across the globe. 
• Aim to achieve or exceed the monthly scheduling goals and analyze scheduling trends that could impact the SLA delivery to our clients.
• Support recruiting drives globally by arranging multiple interviews in one day or a series of days conducted by the business.
• Project support, working on a programmatic task or an initiative to support the needs of the business.
• Take ownership and a proactive approach to be a subject matter expert in scheduling.
• Maintain strict discretion/confidentiality with details of all internal and external candidates throughout the interview process.
• Develop collaborative and trust-based value-added relationships with your global peers and recruiting partners.
• Remain change-agile and solution-oriented with all scheduling changes and reschedules, and quickly problem-solve challenges.
• Execute a best-in-class interview experience by driving a consistency and setting candidates up for success, whether in a virtual setting, or when visiting our offices. 
• Utilize metrics to identify process improvements and performance. Identify key enhancements and new opportunities to streamline our scheduling process to improve productivity and efficiency.
• Maintain proactive communication with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, and candidates throughout the scheduling process to ensure a first-class scheduling experience.
• Achieve best-in-class results while exemplifying the right behaviors and values at Gartner. Be viewed as a trusted partner to and a strong part of our candidate cultivation solution.
• Establish and maintain a strong personal brand and elevate the RC team brand. Maintain a positive and professional attitude, remain agile, and be solution-oriented when faced with challenges.
• Act as an RC champion, helping to onboard and train new RC team members throughout the year.
• Lead and participate in knowledge-sharing sessions across our global team.

What you’ll need:
• Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
• At least 1 year of business experience preferably in Human Resources or related areas.
• Proven ability to work collaboratively with others at all levels of the organization.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, ATS experience is a plus.
• Proven experience working in a fast-paced work environment with the ability to prioritize workload and manage time effectively.
• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

What you’ll get: 
• A seat at the table to help drive peak performance in a growing, people business.
• Encouragement to be innovative and challenge the status quo.
• Exposure to industry-leading training and development.
• Performance-based recognition and rewards.
• Inclusive environment with great balance for personal and family life.

We deliver actionable, objective insight that drives smarter decisions and stronger performance on an organization’s mission-critical priorities. Sales Development Program

Are you driven by results and achieving goals? Have a passion for problem solving? You’ve come to the right place. We’re seeking sales associates to join our Global Business Sales or Global Technology Sales team. You’ll be part of a fast-paced, dynamic team providing the highest level of sales support in procuring C-level individuals in some of the world’s most successful companies as potential new clients. You’ll apply strategic thinking and relationship building to help get executives on board to solve the most pressing business challenges affecting Fortune 500 executives from around the globe. You will understand their critical initiatives, align Gartner research and expertise, and help Gartner maintain its growth by ensuring strong business development of new clients. Upon joining Gartner, you will be aligned to one of two pathways – Account Management (AMX) or Business Development (BDX) where you will then be aligned with one or more Sales Executives. After successful completion of the Sales Development Program, you will have the opportunity to be promoted into a quota bearing role on one of our Sales teams.

What you will do
• Partner with Sales Executives to create customized strategic plans for sales territories, with a goal of supporting their monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets

• Successful participation and completion of the sales development program training curriculum within 15 months

• Generate leads by prospecting potential clients, identify new sales opportunities with existing clients, and qualifying inbound leads

• Research prospective and existing companies, C-Level executives, business trends, and competitive intelligence to prepare relevant and tailored outreach to secure meetings

• Proactively schedule calls with prospective and existing clients via phone, email, LinkedIn, and cold calling

• Educate prospects and clients on the value of Gartner’s renowned products and services

• Shadow and/or own calls with aligned Sales Executive

• Support follow up actions to enable pipeline progression and drive client engagement

• Extensive support: work closely with and learn from colleagues, mentors, and managers

• Have fun: socialize with other interns around the globe

• Fuel your future: develop your skill set as you look ahead to your future career

What You Will Need
• Bachelor’s degree preferred (all majors welcome

• Relevant work or internship in sales or customer service

• Unmatched ability to establish credibility with senior-level executives

• Advanced computer and internet search skills

• Varsity-level communication, writing, problem-solving, and time management skills

• Ability to plan and prioritize daily tasks/responsibilities

• Demonstrated ability to work well under pressure

• Collaborating with others to overcome challenges

Job Description Summary
Every major project starts with a question no one wants to answer blindly: Should we bid, and at what risk? As a Lead Project Planner at GE Vernova, you are the person who answers that question with evidence.

You will build the probabilistic schedules that give our leadership the confidence — or the caution — to make multi-million-pound bid decisions based on quantified data, not instinct. Your work directly shapes which projects GE Vernova pursues, how they are priced, and how confidently they are delivered.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who brings deep technical scheduling expertise together with genuine commercial and risk awareness. If you find precision satisfying and uncertainty worth solving, this role was built for your strengths.

Job Description
What You Will Do
• Build and own bid-stage schedules — develop fully scoped, resource- and cost-loaded schedules aligned to the Bill of Materials (BOM) / Statement of Work (SOW), with no scope gaps and full compliance with DCMA (Defense Contract Management Agency) 14-point health criteria.
• Drive probabilistic analysis — apply three-point estimating and quantitative risk analysis (including Monte Carlo / QRA methods) to produce a defensible, risk-adjusted cost and schedule position that informs bid/no-bid and pricing decisions.
• Maintain bi-directional traceability — link schedule activities to RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) risk references and maintain estimated time impacts throughout the bid phase, ensuring no data is lost at handover.
• Lead the ITO-to-execution transition — validate the bid schedule against final contracted scope, support formal baseline approval, and hand over the baselined schedule and associated RAID data to the Project Controller with a clear, structured briefing.
• Support change control during execution — re-engage when material schedule variance arises to construct What-If scenarios, quantify critical path impact, float consumption, and Extension of Time (EoT) entitlement without modifying the approved baseline.

What You Bring
You are someone who combines analytical rigour with strong communication skills — equally comfortable interrogating a schedule logic network and presenting risk findings to bid leadership.
Required
• Significant experience building and maintaining complex, resource-loaded project schedules using enterprise tools such as Planisware, Primavera P6 (P6), or equivalent.
• Strong working knowledge of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) / Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) development and alignment between planning tools and ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) / financial systems such as SAP.
• Practical experience with schedule health diagnostics, including DCMA 14-point analysis.
• Solid understanding of probabilistic risk techniques — three-point estimating, Expected Monetary Value (EMV), and Monte Carlo / Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) methods — and their application to contingency and margin decisions.
• Understanding of Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and how schedule integrity underpins performance measurement baseline (PMB) accuracy.
• Demonstrated ability to engage effectively across Commercial, Risk, Cost Engineering, and project leadership teams.
• Must hold, or be eligible to obtain, SC Clearance
Preferred
• Experience working in a bid or ITO (Invitation to Offer) environment within complex systems or capital projects delivery.
• Familiarity with change management processes, including What-If scenario modelling and the distinction between rebaselining and re-time-phasing.

Education

About Geomiq
Geomiq is a digital manufacturing platform. Engineers upload a CAD file, configure their parts, get a quote and order: CNC machining, injection moulding, sheet metal and 3D printing. Behind that sits a global supplier network and our own teams in London, China, India and Portugal, covering quoting, quality and logistics. We work with brands including BMW, Rolls-Royce, Brompton Bicycle and Google.
We're building the execution layer for distributed manufacturing. Demand isn't the hard part. Turning thousands of quotes a month into orders, repeat customers and suppliers who deliver is.
The role
This isn't a RevOps job. We don't need another dashboard.
This is a role for someone who wants to run a business within a business.
Every day, customers upload parts, get quotes, change their minds, order or go quiet. Suppliers quote, win, deliver or slip. Some problems are obvious: a key supplier's lead times, a step on the website that loses people, a customer who left for a reason sales already know. Others only show up when someone is looking closely. Your job is to find both, work out why they happen, and remove them.
The fix might be an AI agent, an automation, a change to a page, a new step in a workflow, or a change to how sales or suppliers work. Data, AI and automation are your tools. The outcome is fewer lost customers, less friction and more orders.
What you'll do
• Spend your first weeks with sales, supply chain and our hubs, and in our CRM and platform data, mapping where customers and suppliers get stuck.

• Keep a live list of the biggest friction points and reasons customers leave, ranked by what they cost us.

• Find the cause of each, then fix it yourself or own the fix with the team that has to make it.

• Build AI agents and automations (Claude, n8n, light scripting) that remove slow, manual or error-prone work.

• Work across sales, supply chain, quality and product, and follow each problem through until it's gone.

• Spot opportunities the data alone won't show, and bring them to the CEO with a case.

• Measure what changed after every fix, and be honest when something didn't work.

What we're looking for
• A rare mix: you genuinely enjoy getting deep into AI tools and automation, and you care about winning commercially. For you, the tech isn't the reward; the result is.

• Hands-on with AI: you've built agents, automations or tools with Claude, ChatGPT, n8n or similar, not just used them.

• Comfortable with data: SQL, Python or enough to get answers from raw data yourself.

• A record of owning outcomes, not just analysis: you've been on the hook for decisions with numbers attached, in a role such as buying, merchandising, forecasting, operations or commercial.

• Evidence that you found a problem nobody had spotted and fixed it. Tell us what it was, what you did and what changed.

• A quantitative degree (physics, maths, engineering or similar), or equivalent proof of how you think.

• You've stayed in roles long enough to live with the results of your decisions.

Nice to have
• B2B, marketplace, procurement or logistics experience (strongly preferred).

• Experience in a business that grew quickly while you were there.

• Manufacturing, engineering or industrial exposure.

• Experience with HubSpot or Metabase.

Practical requirements
• You must have the right to work in the UK. We can't offer visa sponsorship.

• You must live in the UK, within commuting distance of our Hackney office (E2 9DQ).

• At least 3 days a week in the office, ideally Monday, Wednesday and Friday, when most of the team is in.
