Job Description
Job Title: Product Analyst

Your new role
We’re looking for a commercially minded Product Analyst with experience in product analytics, data analysis, or a similar insight-led role, ideally gained in a fast-paced, data-driven business.

As a Product Analyst in Global’s DAX Product team, you’ll help squads make better product decisions through data discovery, insight generation, requirements gathering, and structured analytical problem-solving. You’ll report to the Product Lead and work closely with the Senior Product Owner in the DAX Data Engineering squad, alongside other Product Owners, Engineers, Operations, and commercial stakeholders across DAX.

This is not a purely reporting-led role. You’ll turn ambiguous questions into clear analysis, investigate trends and anomalies in product, operational, and commercial data, and provide evidence-based recommendations that inform product discovery, prioritisation, strategy, and OKRs.

It’s a great opportunity for someone who is naturally curious, commercially aware, and excited by using data to influence product direction across a complex and evolving ad-tech landscape. 

Key Responsibilities

Product-led data discovery and insight generation (50%)
You will work across DAX squads to investigate product, operational, and commercial data in order to uncover insights, identify trends, and support decision-making. You’ll help teams answer key questions through structured analysis, benchmarking, and exploratory data work, including investigating anomalies and patterns in DAX data such as spotting trends, delivery behaviours, or product performance shifts. 

Analytical solution design (25%)
You will partner with Product Owners, Engineers, and Stakeholders to understand business needs to then build dashboards or analytical outputs that support product discovery, trouble-shooting, prioritisation, and ongoing performance monitoring. 

Supporting product strategy, OKRs, and continuous improvement (25%)
You will contribute to OKR setting and product planning by providing robust data, benchmarks, and performance insights. You’ll support squads in measuring success, understanding opportunities, and improving how they use data in decision-making. You’ll also help improve analytical ways of working, data quality awareness, and reporting consistency across the DAX product organisation. 

What You’ll Love About This Role

Think Big: Help shape how data informs product thinking across DAX, bringing a strategic mindset to product discovery and decision-making.

Own It: Take responsibility for turning ambiguous questions into clear analysis, actionable insight, and meaningful recommendations.

Keep it Simple: Use data to cut through complexity, focusing on the metrics and insights that matter most.

Better Together: Collaborate across squads, disciplines, and stakeholders to help build a stronger, more insight-led product organisation. 

What Success Looks Like
In your first few months, you’ll have:

• Built a strong understanding of the DAX product landscape, including how different squads operate and where data can most effectively support product discovery and decision-making 

• Developed a good working relationships across the DAX technology teams (e.g. engineers, product owners, design, etc.) and key stakeholders outside technology

• Become familiar with the main datasets, dashboards, workflows, and systems used across the DAX environment 

• Supported product squads by investigating questions, identifying data trends or anomalies, and turning findings into clear recommendations / actionable insights

• Contributed to requirements gathering for analytical work and helped shape dashboards, reporting, or exploratory analysis that supports squad priorities 

• Added value to OKR discussions and benchmarking exercises through thoughtful analysis and evidence-based input 

What You’ll Need

• 3+ years experience in a Product Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar analytical role 

• Experience working closely with product, engineering, or delivery teams to support discovery, prioritisation, and product decision-making 

• Demonstrated ability to take work from problem definition and requirements gathering through to analysis, insight, and presentation 

• Strong experience working with large and complex datasets in a commercial environment 

• Strong SQL skills and confidence querying, validating, and exploring data independently 

•. Experience with dash boarding and visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar 

• Experience building clear, useful dashboards and reporting to support business and product stakeholders 

• A strong analytical mindset, with the curiosity to investigate trends, spot anomalies, and ask the right questions 

• The ability to translate complex findings into simple, compelling narratives and recommendations for non-technical audiences 

• Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple squads and functions

You’ll write API documentation, usage examples and migration guidance to help developers adopt changes confidently. Work with library users across the software stack to understand requirements, resolve integration issues and guide API improvements.

job_title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure and Network Operations Solutions Architect
job_description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Senior Network and Fabric Operations Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial organizations around the world are using NVIDIA products to redefine deep learning and data analytics, and to power next-generation data centres. Join the team building and advising on the networks behind many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world!

We are looking for someone who combines deep networking expertise with strong consulting and communication skills. This role will engage directly with customers, partners and cross-functional teams to assess, architect and operate the compute, storage and scale-up fabrics that underpin large GPU estates—serving as both a trusted advisor and a hands-on technical leader. You will own the fabric side of NVIDIA’s Cloud Partner (NCP) operating model across the full Day 1 to Day 2 lifecycle: from InfiniBand/UFM and Ethernet validation at handover, through NVLink partition operations, to a production-stable fabric running at maximum goodput. NCP estates are open-source-first and heterogeneous—Cumulus Linux, SONiC, Spectrum-X, DOCA/DPU services, upstream Kubernetes and Prometheus/Grafana—so this role is deliberately tool-agnostic: you will meet each partner on the fabric they actually run rather than on a single proprietary product.

What You’ll Be Doing:
• Own Day 2 fabric operations across NCP fleets: NVLink/NVSwitch partition management (NMX-C / NMX-M) on GB200/GB300 NVL72-class systems, maintenance-partition isolation, and safe partition-change workflows for multi-tenant estates.

• Own the switch software and firmware lifecycle—Cumulus Linux, SONiC and switch-OS upgrades, CPLD and field-notice rollout campaigns—with staged, tested upgrade plans that keep partner fabrics off stale releases without disrupting production workloads.

• Support Day 1 fabric validation and acceptance: InfiniBand and UFM bring-up, Spectrum-X/RoCE Ethernet configuration, cabling and link-health verification, routing and congestion-control validation, and multi-day, multi-rack burn-in against agreed MTBI and goodput targets.

• Minimise the time from cluster handover to first production workload, removing duplicated fabric validation across hardware bring-up, managed-service intake and the partner’s own network operations teams.

• Drive fabric reliability at fleet scale: telemetry for link flaps, retransmits and congestion, fault detection through to remediation, root-cause analysis of network-induced job failures, and measurable improvement of MTBI and job goodput.

• Provide consultative guidance and hands-on troubleshooting across the fabric stack—NICs and DPUs, switch OS, routing and congestion control, host networking and Kubernetes network integration—and act as the technical leader for assigned accounts, running structured knowledge transfer and producing runbooks so partner teams can operate advanced fabric configurations independently.

What We Need to See:
• BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of professional experience in data centre networking, fabric engineering or large-scale network operations roles.

• Fabric & Data Centre Networking: Deep understanding of data centre network architectures and RDMA fabrics—InfiniBand and RoCE/Ethernet—including topology and routing design (fat-tree, rail-optimised), congestion control, lossless/QoS configuration, and troubleshooting across NICs, switches and high-speed interconnects.

• NVIDIA Fabric Technologies: Hands-on experience with InfiniBand and UFM, Spectrum-X Ethernet, Cumulus Linux and/or SONiC, ConnectX and BlueField NICs/DPUs, and NVLink/NVSwitch systems—ideally including NMX-C / NMX-M partition operations on NVL72-class platforms.

• Linux & Switch Platforms: Deep knowledge of Linux (RedHat, Ubuntu) and switch operating systems, network OS internals, host networking and OS-level security, together with an understanding of the storage and compute traffic patterns of HPC/AI clusters.

• Automation, GitOps & Observability: Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting, configuration management and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g. Ansible, Terraform), GitOps-based network configuration and firmware/upgrade management for large fleets, and observability stacks (Grafana, Loki, Prometheus) applied to fabric telemetry.

• Fleet Reliability & Customer Engagement: Demonstrated ability to measure and improve MTBI and job goodput on large GPU clusters—fault detection, drain and remediation workflows, SLO/error-budget definition and post-incident review—combined with a strong consultative background leading architectural reviews and presenting to executive stakeholders.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:
• Experience operating Kubernetes networking in GPU clusters—CNI plugins, multi-network attachment, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins—and with the NVIDIA Network and GPU Operators for automated resource lifecycle management.

• Expertise with DOCA and DPU infrastructure services (e.g. DOCA DPF) for offloaded networking, security and storage services.

• Familiarity with fabric and GPU health telemetry—DCGM and XID diagnostics, link-level and switch counters, node-level health agents, and fleet-wide reliability intelligence.

• Knowledge of large-scale training traffic behaviour: collective communication (NCCL) tuning, rail alignment, and diagnosing network-bound performance regressions in distributed training jobs.

• Experience delivering multi-tenant network isolation for GPU-as-a-service estates—VRF/VLAN/EVPN segmentation, tenant partitioning and secure fabric handover between tenants.

job_title: Senior Cloud Partner Marketing Manager - EMEA
job_description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

NVIDIA, industry leader in AI, is looking for a Sr Marketing Manager to join our EMEA Cloud Partner Marketing team. This exciting opportunity will expose you to our latest and greatest innovations in AI and cloud computing. If you enjoy working alongside partners and are passionate about leading large-scale, sophisticated marketing projects this is the job for you! We seek proactive individuals who have a strong marketing background across multiple fields. They need to be hands on and detail oriented. They should handle multitasking and work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Are you ready to make a difference? Come and join us!

What You’ll Be Doing:
• Lead EMEA partner marketing strategy, planning, and execution with NVIDIA Cloud Service Provider Partners (CSP’s) to drive adoption of NVIDIA accelerated computing platforms.
• Define joint regional co-marketing objectives, annual plans, and half-yearly execution roadmaps in collaboration with marketing teams across the region and industries.
• Operates as the regional marketing point of contact for NVIDIA Cloud Partners, building long-term executive collaboration and influencing joint strategy in close collaboration with our NVIDIA headquarters team.
• Work closely with campaign marketing, communications, product marketing, sales, PR, events, and executive leadership to define global co-marketing priorities and deliver integrated campaigns.
• Lead NVIDIA’s EMEA presence with NVIDIA Cloud Partners at all relevant events.
• Own and actively handle EMEA Market Development Fund (MDF) budgets, ensuring investment alignment to business priorities, regional execution needs, and measurable ROI.
• Operate with a hands-on, “roll-up-your-sleeves” leadership style—balancing strategy with detailed execution in a fast-paced environment.
• Track, analyze, and report marketing performance, pipeline contribution, and program effectiveness.

What We Need to See:
• 10+ years experience in high-tech or enterprise marketing with a strong focus on partner marketing, AI, cloud, or infrastructure technologies.
• Proven success leading marketing programs with large ecosystem partners across EMEA. 
• Demonstrate strength in cross-functional leadership across multiple marketing fields:Strong program management skills, balancing long-term vision with near-term execution.
• Highly organized, performance-focused, hands-on operator who thrives in high-growth, high-visibility environments. 
• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience); MBA preferred.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Evidence of building lasting partner relationships that sustain engagement and support business growth.
• Outstanding communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, different teams and external partners.
• Deep understanding of AI’s impact on enterprise businesses, with practical experience using AI tools to improve marketing planning, execution, and measurement.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are looking to hire a senior CPU Compiler performance Engineer for an exciting and fun role at NVIDIA. We craft outstanding compilers that realise the potential of NVIDIA's CPUs designed for the world's largest AI and computing markets: https://www.nvidia.com/en-in/data-center/grace-cpu/. Our compiler organisation makes its mark on every CPU, GPU and compute unit that NVIDIA builds. Would you like to be part of this outstanding organisation?

We need you to design compiler and hardware software together including developing new technologies to help with hardware software co-design. These compilers are key for the performance of AI, HPC and other performance critical software deployed on NVIDIA Data Centres, on the cloud and at super computing centres around the world. In this role you will solve critical problems working alongside an outstanding engineering team with vision in Compiler technology and systems software, doing what you enjoy! You will also be collaborating with the relevant upstream projects and improving the state of the art If this sounds like a fun challenge, we would be delighted to hear from you!!

What you will be doing:
• Work with a geographically distributed partner organisation to understand, modify and improve CPU Compiler SW at NVIDIA.

• Analyse AI workloads to champion improvements in both new hardware and compiler toolchain and improve hardware-software co-design.

• Contribute new features and optimisation techniques targeting NVIDIA CPUs engaging with upstream and open source communities.

• Develop compiler SW that is optimised for performance.

• Be part of a team that is at the centre of artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and data centre technologies.

• Contribute towards the development of next generation compute

What we need to see:
• BS, MS or higher degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent work experience with 8+ years of work experience.

• Experience with compiler development or a related academic project.

• Knowledge of Language Front-Ends or Compiler optimisation techniques and code generation modules.

• Strong hands-on C++ programming skills

• Good CPU architecture and low level performance analysis skills with hands-on experience of pre-Silicon hardware / software co-design.

• Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Knowledge of workload analysis and the ability to drive improvements in hardware ,software, libraries and compilers including demonstrable ability of effectively improving hardware and software by all performance tools at disposal including but not limited to performance modeling / simulation and performance analysis tools.

• Expertise with CPU architectures such as Arm Architecture (AArch32, AArch64), RISC-V, x86_64, PowerPC or DSPs and engaging with pre-silicon compiler and toolchain contributions.

• A track record of working with industry standard compiler infrastructure such as GCC, LLVM or MLIR

• Knowledge of AI algorithms, scientific HPC applications and related code optimisations.

• Significant contributions to free software and open source compiler communities.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most innovative and talented people on the planet working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are expanding fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we would love to connect with you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We are seeking a highly technical and strategic Developer Relations Manager to join our team, with a focus on engaging developer ecosystems across emerging technology domains. In this pivotal role, you will work directly with software solution providers, developers, and industry professionals to foster the adoption of NVIDIA’s advanced AI and computing platforms. The ideal candidate brings a blend of deep technical expertise and commercial go-to-market experience, combined with a passion for developer advocacy and a talent for communicating how NVIDIA technology can solve complex, real-world challenges. 

NVIDIA is seeking a senior Developer Relations leader to accelerate the integration of NVIDIA technologies across the Energy & Utilities ecosystem in EMEA. This role will focus primarily on the electric power and utilities industry, working with leading software vendors, technology partners, utilities, engineering companies, and energy infrastructure providers to help integrate NVIDIA accelerated computing, AI, simulation, digital twin, and edge technologies into industry software platforms and solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong energy industry domain expertise, technical depth, partner engagement experience, and the ability to identify and develop strategic opportunities with Independent Software Vendors (ISVs). Approximately 80% of the role will focus on utilities, electrical power systems, grid software and related ISVs, with approximately 20% supporting Oil & Gas and adjacent energy applications.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Serve as the trusted technical advisor, problem solver, and champion for the developer ecosystem in the Energy & Utilities, EMEA segments with multi-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies. 

• Build strategic technical relationships with leading power and utility ISVs, including transmission, grid operations, power simulation, DER and renewable integration and digital twins and simulation.

• Advise on the technical enablement resources—such as sample code, guides, demonstration pipelines, and tools to highlight the application of technologies in solving real-world problems in Energy & Utilities. 

• Guide partners and startups through onboarding and integration with NVIDIA’s programs, fostering co-innovation and the development of next-generation solutions. 

• Map, track, and supervise the developer ecosystem to identify growth opportunities, advise technology roadmaps, and shape adoption strategies. 

• Collaborate multi-functionally with solution architects, engineering, product management, and marketing to drive developer engagement and optimize partner adoption strategies. 

• Engage with partner engineering teams, technical leaders, and decision-makers to identify goals, tackle technical challenges, and promote best practices for successful integrations. 

• Represent and advocate for the partner technical needs and feedback to NVIDIA’s internal product and engineering teams, supplying actionable insights from field deployments to influence product roadmaps. 

What We Need to See:

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 

• A minimum of 8+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, including 5+ years of direct hands-on experience in your designated ecosystem. 

• Proven experience leading, partnering, and scaling developer programs in the Eerbgy vertical and ISVs. 

• Significant financial services technical proficiency in high-performance computing, cloud, AI/ML, and/or vertical-specific frameworks and libraries. 

• Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to distill complex technical concepts for diverse technical and non-technical audiences from engineers to executives. 

• Experience leading technical collaborations with engineering and product teams - including architectural design, code reviews, technical mentorship, and delivery of technical talks or workshops 

• Proven ability to structure and implement sophisticated technical engagements, negotiate requirements, prioritize issues, and collaborate with internal or external stakeholders (across sales, legal, product or marketing teams as needed). 

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

• Experience with major power system, utility, electrical engineering, industrial automation, or energy management software platforms. 

• Experience working directly with major European utilities, grid operators, OEMs, EPCs, or energy technology companies. 

• Knowledge of GPU computing, CUDA, AI/ML, generative AI, optimization, simulation, or high-performance computing

• Track record in crafting and implementing systems for real-time processing and low-latency decision-making. 

• Successful history of building and scaling developer communities and delivering impactful technical enablement programs. 

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

NVIDIA is seeking a technical leader interested in defining, crafting, implementing, and guiding the implementation of security research, architecture, implementation, and design for next-generation NVIDIA Networking products. You'll be expected to take a strong hands-on role, working with diverse teams across NVIDIA and with external partners to meet security requirements for our state-of-the-art network products.

NVIDIA’s invention of the GPU 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company”. We are looking to grow our teams with the smartest people in the world. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

What you'll be doing:
• Research, design, develop and implement architecture solutions (Hardware and software) meeting internal and external security requirements and standards.

• Apply innovative hardware security primitives to enable next generation secure software extensions supported by hardware.

• Collaborate with partners on the implementation of open-source software.

• Collaborate across the company to guide the direction of Its (USB, I2C, I3C, UART, PCI) working with hardware, software, research and product teams.

• Architectural modeling, validation, microarchitectural definition, following standards bodies, and developing infrastructure enabling trusted platforms using hardware security methods.

• Work with customers, partners to identify and address security issues and threats.

What we need to see:
• BSc, MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 12+ years of relevant experience.

• First-hand work experience with IO interface including: I2C, I3C, SPI, UART, USB, PCIe

• Have directly worked on several of the following:

• Computing platform boot architecture in embedded devices and servers

• RISC-V architecture, Root-of-trust, and security processors.

• Familiarity with embedded systems and programming low-level firmware.

• Familiar with Security-by-design hardware and principles of privileges.

• Programming and debugging fundamentals across languages such as: Verilog, Python/Perl scripting, ARM assembly and C/C++.

• The ability to work in a dynamic collaboration oriented team is required and strong communication skills and a real passion for working as a team are essential.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

These services include software to manage hardware and network provisioning to build a multi-tenant infrastructure. As a software engineer, you will work with other software engineers, product architects, and product managers as a collaborative team to deliver end-to-end software solutions to manage complex cloud infrastructure deployments.

You will write services and software that aligns with the broad architectural vision for the NVIDIA Cloud Platform, working with other teams to develop a robust and scalable system. You own your code - from development to commit to test to production. We expect you to be passionate about code quality, testing, deployment efficiency/simplicity and bringing amazing products to market.

What you will be doing:
• Work with NVIDIA internal customers

• Design and build scalable software systems to manage NVIDIA’s cloud infrastructure.

• Building network and systems automation software for managing a multi-tenant cloud infrastructure

• Participate in open-source communities of software we leverage and build.

• Present to internal stakeholders and NVIDIA leadership on roadmaps, vision, & demos

What we need to see:
• 8+ years of experience with designing and building distributed software systems.

• BS/MS degree in Computer science or related areas (or equivalent experience)

• Demonstrated ability to write code in a mainstream systems programming language such as C, C++, Golang, or Rust.

• Demonstrated ability to design and implement maintainable APIs for consumers.

• Practical experience with asynchronous programming, type safety, threading models, state machines and data structures.

• Background of data persistence (SQL or similar).

• Understanding of secure communication protocols (mutual-TLS, IPsec, or similar).

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Experience in a Hyperscale Cloud Service Provider (public facing or not)

• Understanding of networking protocols such as IP, IPv6, BGP, HTTP, ICMP, tunneling protocols (VXLAN, Geneve, FoU, GRE), etc.

• Background with Host management systems (DHCP, Redfish, UEFI) and host security services such as TPM, TXT, and SecureBoot

job_title: Senior Solutions Architect, Higher Education and Research - Open Models and LLM
job_description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics and accelerated computing for three decades. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and exceptional talent. As an NVIDIAN, you will be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to do their best work and make a lasting impact on the world. We are looking for a Solutions Architect's to work with academia and research partners. Solutions Architects are the primary technical contacts for our customers and engage deeply with researchers and application developers to drive the adoption of NVIDIA technology. We seek an individual who combines an intricate understanding of modern AI and HPC research workloads with expertise in accelerated computing and architecture.

What you will be doing: 
• Partner directly with leading research labs, researchers, and university faculty as a trusted technical advisor: develop a keen understanding of their scientific goals and drive joint research projects at supercomputing scale.

• Identify and accelerate high-impact workloads by integrating NVIDIA's frameworks, libraries, and core software stack into research projects, and help researchers amplify their impact through publications, conference presentations, and technical content.

• Advocate for accelerated computing and Deep Learning, and deliver hands-on trainings, workshops, lectures, and demonstrations across NVIDIA's platforms, and mentor power users to become NVIDIA champions.

• Track emerging research trends and turn gaps between researcher needs and NVIDIA's o erings into prototypical solutions and direct feedback to NVIDIA Engineering.

• Maintain deep expertise in your domain while staying versatile across NVIDIA's full platform: GPUs, CPUs, networking, and software

What we need to see: 
• A graduate degree from a leading university in a STEM related discipline.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience running the large language model lifecycle across multi-node systems: training, fine-tuning, inference, serving, and/or agentic workflows.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with academic and research stakeholders, and to communicate complex ideas clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences.

• Action oriented, analytical, self-motivated, and a passionate learner, with excellent organization skills to work in a heavily multi-tasked environment.

• Fluent in English, both oral and written, and comfortable working in Python.

Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
• A PhD from a leading university in a STEM related discipline, with 3+ years of research on large language models or foundation models and their applications.

• A track record of thought leadership: high-impact publications, talks at academic conferences and workshops, as well as good understanding of scientific policy engagement, grant processes, or national/European research program structures.

• Experience with NVIDIA's AI software stack, powered by CUDA and CUDA-X libraries, e.g. NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NeMo Framework, Megatron Bridge, NIM, TensorRT-LLM, Dynamo, NeMo Agent Toolkit, and Triton Inference Server, as well as the Nemotron open-model methodology.

As a Solutions Architect, there is travel involved (30% of the working time), as often the best way to figure things out is a face to-face meeting, but the job is not life on the road. We make heavy use of conferencing tools, and you are empowered to figure out how to get the job done and do what it takes to make our customers successful.

 Senior Python (Quant) Developer – Equities Technology 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 JUXT - London (part of Grid Dynamics) is partnering with Citi's Equities Technology organisation on a multi-year transformation to build a best-in-class global platform spanning execution, prime services, clearing, and cross-product margining.
The programme aims to modernise Citi's technology estate, improving performance, resilience, market connectivity, execution capabilities, and post-trade processes.
As a Python Developer, you will work closely with traders, quantitative researchers, structurers, and engineering teams supporting the Derivatives Flow, Delta 1, and Exotics desks. You will build production-grade, data-driven trading analytics, quantitative models, and front-office applications used for pricing, risk analysis, signal generation, backtesting, and real-time market insight.
This is a hands-on engineering role combining quantitative development, data engineering, and software delivery in a front-office financial environment.

 Essential functions

 Key Responsibilities
• Partner with traders, quants, and structurers to design and deliver production-grade models, analytical tools, and trading workflows.

• Develop real-time pricing, risk, and market-data capabilities covering positions, Greeks, P&L, exposures, and execution monitoring.

• Build scalable data pipelines and services for market data and trade data.

• Develop analytics supporting idea generation, volatility and flow analysis, basket and index insights, and hedging strategies.

• Build reusable libraries, APIs, and services to strengthen the desk technology platform.

• Optimise quantitative applications for performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Apply robust software engineering practices, including automated testing, maintainable architecture, and production-ready deployment.

• Leverage agentic development frameworks and AI-native solutions to improve engineering productivity and software delivery.

 Qualifications

 Required Technical Skills
Python and data engineering
• Strong experience with Python and its data engineering ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience with Polars, Parquet, FastAPI, Jupyter, Airflow, Streamlit, and Ray.

Data platforms and query engines
• Experience with high-performance data stores and query engines, particularly Trino and KDB.

Financial markets
• Experience working with financial products such as equities, options, and futures.

• Understanding of trading analytics, pricing, risk, market data, or related front-office workflows.

AI-assisted and agentic development
• Demonstrable experience with agentic frameworks for software development.

• Experience developing AI-native solutions using context-engineering techniques.

Software engineering
• Strong software development and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to build production-grade applications and services with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability.

Education
A degree in a quantitative discipline, such as:
• Engineering

• Applied Mathematics

• Physics

• Software Engineering

 Would be a plus

 Working Environment
You will work alongside experienced engineers and closely engaged business and product stakeholders in a front-office technology environment. The role offers the opportunity to contribute to a major transformation programme and build technology supporting global equities trading, analytics, and risk management.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is a hands-on quantitative developer who combines strong Python engineering skills with data-intensive application development experience and an understanding of financial markets. They should be comfortable working directly with trading and quantitative teams, translating business requirements into robust technical solutions, and continuously improving the performance and reliability of production systems.

 We offer

• Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects

• Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team

• Competitive salary

• Flexible schedule

• Benefits package - medical insurance, sports

• Corporate social events

• Professional development opportunities

• Well-equipped office

 About us

 Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI,
 and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical
 challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation.
 A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in
 enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in

job_title: Advanced Manufacturing Engineer – Body, Chassis & Powertrain - 3 month contract
job_description:
Body, Chassis & Powertrain
Department: Advanced Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering
Contract: 3-month Fixed-Term Contract, with potential for extension subject to business requirements and review
Positions Available: 3 (Body, Chassis and Powertrain)
Reports to: Advanced Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering Manager
About the Role
We are looking for three experienced Advanced Manufacturing Engineers to join Lotus, supporting an exciting vehicle programme across our Body, Chassis and Powertrain manufacturing areas.
This is an opportunity to play a key role in the industrialisation and delivery of a new vehicle programme, taking ownership of manufacturing processes from initial concept and development through to equipment installation, vehicle builds and production readiness.
Working closely with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Production, Logistics, Facilities, Purchasing and external suppliers, you will help develop robust, safe and efficient manufacturing solutions that support programme delivery.
We are recruiting across three specialist areas: Body, Chassis and Powertrain, and welcome applications from candidates with relevant experience in any of these disciplines.
What You'll Be Doing
Manufacturing Process Development
• Take ownership of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering deliverables within your specialist area.

• Develop manufacturing concepts, process flows, assembly sequences and build strategies.

• Translate engineering designs and product requirements into practical manufacturing solutions.

• Provide Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) input to support product development.

• Identify manufacturing constraints and influence product design to improve assembly efficiency and repeatability.

• Define process requirements, manufacturing parameters and supporting documentation.

Equipment, Tooling & Facilities
• Define requirements for manufacturing equipment, tooling, fixtures and facilities.

• Develop technical specifications and Statements of Requirements.

• Support equipment supplier selection, technical reviews and make-versus-buy assessments.

• Coordinate engineering activities relating to equipment design, manufacture, installation and commissioning.

• Ensure manufacturing equipment and processes meet quality, safety, ergonomic and programme requirements.

• Work with Industrial Engineering teams to integrate manufacturing processes into the production facility.

Manufacturing Quality & Risk Management
• Develop and maintain Process FMEAs (PFMEAs) and manufacturing risk assessments.

• Identify potential manufacturing risks and implement mitigation plans.

• Define critical process characteristics and manufacturing controls.

• Support process validation, dimensional accuracy and manufacturing capability activities.

• Apply structured problem-solving and root-cause analysis to resolve manufacturing challenges.

Programme Delivery & Build Support
• Support prototype, pilot, pre-production and production build activities.

• Provide hands-on engineering support during vehicle builds.

• Lead the resolution of manufacturing issues within your assigned area.

• Monitor engineering actions, risks and deliverables against programme milestones.

• Communicate manufacturing readiness and escalate significant risks where necessary.

• Support production launch and manufacturing ramp-up activities.

Our Specialist Opportunities
We have three positions available, each focusing on a different aspect of vehicle manufacturing.
Advanced Manufacturing Engineer – Body
You will focus on manufacturing processes associated with vehicle body structures and body assembly.
Relevant experience may include:
• Body-in-White (BIW) and structural assembly.

• Aluminium and steel body structures.

• Bonding, riveting, fastening and joining technologies.

• Body assembly processes, sequences and tooling.

• Jigs, fixtures, dimensional control and tolerances.

• Closures and structural component installation.

• Low- or medium-volume body manufacturing.

Advanced Manufacturing Engineer – Chassis
You will focus on manufacturing processes associated with chassis assembly and vehicle mechanical systems.
Relevant experience may include:
• Front and rear suspension systems.

• Subframes and structural chassis components.

• Steering and braking systems.

• Wheels, tyres, chassis alignment and vehicle geometry.

• Underbody assembly and installation.

• Torque-controlled and safety-critical fastening processes.

• Assembly tooling, fastening equipment and fluid filling processes.

Advanced Manufacturing Engineer – Powertrain
You will focus on powertrain installation, manufacturing processes and vehicle integration.
Relevant experience may include:
• Internal combustion, hybrid and electric vehicle powertrains.

• Engine, electric motor and transmission installation.

• Powertrain mounting and cooling systems.

• Fuel systems and fluid filling processes.

• High-voltage batteries, power electronics and associated components.

• Electrical and mechanical connections.

• Powertrain assembly tooling.

• End-of-line testing and functional verification.

Experience with high-voltage safety and electrified powertrain manufacturing would be particularly advantageous.
What We're Looking For
Essential Experience & Skills
• Manufacturing Engineering experience within automotive or a comparable complex manufacturing environment.

• Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), vehicle programmes or significant product changes.

• Proven experience developing and implementing manufacturing processes.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing industrialisation and process development.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD data and technical specifications.

• Experience defining manufacturing equipment, tooling or fixture requirements.

• Practical knowledge of PFMEA and manufacturing risk management.

• Experience supporting prototype, pilot or production builds.

• Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.

• Ability to manage engineering deliverables against programme deadlines.

• Excellent communication and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of a defined manufacturing area.

• Working knowledge and practical experience of Teamcenter, including product data, engineering changes and manufacturing information management.

Desirable Experience
• Automotive OEM or Tier 1 supplier background.

• Vehicle launch or NPI programme experience.

• Low- or medium-volume vehicle manufacturing.

• Equipment procurement, installation and commissioning.

• Knowledge of APQP, PPAP and manufacturing readiness processes.

• Experience managing engineering or equipment suppliers.

• Understanding of Industrial Engineering, ergonomics and line balancing.

• Experience working within structured programme gateway environments.

Qualifications
A degree, HNC/HND or equivalent qualification in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or a related discipline is desirable. Equivalent relevant industry experience will also be considered.

• This role will ideally be based at our HQ in Hethel full-time.

• This role does not support sponsorship, candidates will need to have the permanent right to work in the UK.

Our Company:
Group Lotus is a leading sports car manufacturer with over 75-year long history of iconic designs, groundbreaking engineering and legendary victories on the F1 track. Today we are transforming into a truly global performance car brand focused on the electrical future. In 2022 we launched the Eletre, the world’s first all-electric hyper-SUV, and in 2023 our fully-electric Hyper-GT, Emeya.  
As part of the Lotus team, you push boundaries. Those of the car industry and of your own. Every member of the Lotus family has some of the pioneering mindset of founder Colin Chapman in them. 
Hethel, Norfolk, England has been the home of Lotus for over 60 years, ever since Colin Chapman, our founder, started making championship-winning racing cars. In conjunction with production facilities in Norwich, and research facilities near Warwick, our UK sites offer a wide breadth of roles for all disciplines.
We're not just a car company; we're a diverse mix of talent from all walks of life. At Group Lotus, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are not just buzzwords but essential pillars of a thriving and successful organisation. Read more here: Equity, Diversity & Inclusion in Lotus Cars.
Do you want to know what Sophisticated, Rebellious and Pioneering mean for Lotus Cars Limited? Come and take a look at our career site and join the incredible adventure: https://lotusukmanufacturing.teamtailor.com/

About the Role
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Material Planner to join our Material Control team at Lotus, based at our Hethel headquarters in Norfolk.
In this role, you'll play a key part in ensuring the smooth and efficient supply of materials to support our vehicle manufacturing operations, helping us deliver production schedules while maintaining cost-effective inventory levels.
Working closely with suppliers and internal teams, you'll be responsible for maintaining material availability, managing supplier schedules and proactively resolving supply challenges to minimise disruption to production.
You'll also support the Material Planning Team Supervisor and provide day-to-day leadership to Material Planners, helping ensure our manufacturing operations run efficiently.
What You'll Be Doing
• Support the Material Planning Team Supervisor in the day-to-day management of material planning activities.

• Oversee the creation and management of supplier material schedules, ensuring materials arrive on time and in the correct quantities.

• Manage and support Material Planners, ensuring supplier adherence to agreed delivery schedules.

• Monitor supplier capacity, scheduling constraints and potential bottlenecks, taking proactive action to maintain material continuity.

• Work closely with Purchasing, Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA), Logistics, Material Handling and suppliers to coordinate material requirements.

• Balance inventory levels and material availability to support production requirements while managing working capital effectively.

• Liaise with suppliers regarding production volumes, shipping schedules, build requirements and delivery arrangements.

• Identify and resolve potential supply issues to minimise production downtime and disruption.

• Independently review and adjust supplier schedules to maintain material availability and improve performance.

• Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

What We're Looking For
Essential Skills & Experience
• Strong knowledge and practical experience of ERP and MRP systems and processes.

• Good understanding of Bill of Materials (BoM) structures.

• Knowledge of procurement practices and commercial awareness.

• Understanding of supply and demand planning and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP).

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and resolve complex material planning challenges.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate potential issues and develop effective solutions.

• Excellent attention to detail, organisational skills and follow-through.

• Confident communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive, customer-focused approach with strong systems thinking.

Desirable
• Experience working within a manufacturing or automotive material planning environment.

• Experience coordinating supplier readiness and capacity activities.

• Flexibility to undertake occasional supplier visits where required.

About You
We're looking for someone who is organised, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
You'll have a strong understanding of material planning processes and the confidence to take ownership of supplier schedules, resolve issues and make decisions that support production requirements.
You'll also enjoy working collaboratively with colleagues across Production, Logistics, Purchasing, Quality, Engineering and Finance, building positive relationships and ensuring everyone is working towards the same objectives.
With strong attention to detail and a solutions-focused mindset, you'll be able to anticipate challenges, manage competing priorities and contribute to the continuous improvement of our material planning operations.
Interested in Joining Lotus?
If you're an experienced Material Planner looking to take the next step in your career, we'd love to hear from you.
Join our team at Hethel and play an important role in supporting the production of our iconic Lotus vehicles.

What you'll bring:
•  Experience in managing teams, business processes, documentation, and similar projects in a complex environment such as automotive, ideally in premium brand

• Real passion for the customer experience and satisfaction

• Organized, reliable and results-driven professional

• Must have a practical mind to solve problems

• Excellent organisational and leadership skills with a big picture vision

What we offer:
• 25 Vacation Days + Bank Holidays: Recharge, explore, or binge-watch your favorite series with plenty of time to relax and enjoy life outside of work.

• Performance Bonus: Get rewarded for your hard work with an exciting, non-contractual bonus scheme—because great effort deserves great perks.

• Future-Proof Pension: Plan for your tomorrow while thriving today with a solid pension scheme to keep your future bright.

• Private Healthcare: Stay healthy and stress-free with premium healthcare coverage tailored to keep you at your best.

Additional Information:
• This role will be working from our Hethel plant, and will be required on site. 

• Candidates must be eligible to work in UK without VISA sponsorship.

Provide senior operational construction leadership across allocated HadleyFRAME projects, ensuring safe, compliant and commercially controlled delivery from mobilisation through completion and defects closure. Lead allocated project and site teams, maintain reliable programme and resource controls, and strengthen management resilience as the business delivers larger main contractor and specialist LGSF contracts.

Support the Construction Director and Business Unit Director by resolving delivery issues, maintaining construction standards and escalating material risks early. Work with Commercial, Finance, Technical, Manufacturing, Preconstruction and Health and Safety to deliver the agreed contract scope and maintain the BOPAS assessed system.

The role complements the Projects Director. The Construction Director or BUD will allocate projects, line management and decision authority in writing. Temporary director responsibilities require separate written delegation and confirmation of competence; this job description does not confer statutory appointment, contract signing or technical design approval authority.

###### The Role

**Construction Planning and Delivery**

Lead mobilisation and delivery of allocated projects, including full building scopes where HadleyFRAME acts as main or principal contractor. Review contract scope, baseline programmes, critical paths, design release, procurement, site logistics and commissioning plans. Maintain lookahead programmes, progress evidence and recovery actions, coordinating groundworks, structures, envelope, M&E, finishes and handover interfaces.

**Leadership and Resource Resilience**

Manage allocated Project Managers and Site Managers, set clear objectives and review competence, workload and performance. Maintain the project resource and cover schedule, with named deputies and escalation contacts. Secure competent supervision before critical activities proceed, and escalate capacity gaps before accepting further delivery commitments.

**Health, Safety and Environmental Leadership**

Lead the implementation of safe working practices with project managers and the Health and Safety function. Support HadleyFRAME’s duties under CDM 2015 and applicable environmental requirements. Ensure appropriate construction phase planning, welfare, induction, RAMS, temporary works arrangements and contractor competence checks. Stop unsafe work and require corrective action before restart.

**Building Compliance and Quality**

Coordinate construction delivery to approved designs, specifications and applicable Building Regulations. Verify that inspections, tests and approvals are planned and completed by competent people. Manage fire safety, structural and M&E interfaces with Technical and specialist consultants. Ensure commissioning, completion evidence, O&M information, warranties and handover requirements are planned from mobilisation.

**Commercial Control and Risk**

Provide accurate progress, resource, productivity and cost to complete inputs to CVRs. Work with Commercial to identify change, delay and entitlement promptly, preserve contemporaneous records and support notices and claims. Implement agreed cost and recovery actions within delegated limits. Escalate forecast loss, programme slippage, material defects and client disputes without delay.

**Cross Functional Coordination and Clients**

Review buildability and delivery capacity during tender and contract handover. Coordinate design release, manufacturing, logistics and subcontract delivery against project need. Maintain professional client and supply chain relationships, report progress accurately and resolve interfaces. Capture lessons learned and implement improvement actions across the construction portfolio.

###### BOPAS Responsibilities and Delegated Authority

Maintain the construction management structure, competent site cover and escalation routes for allocated BOPAS projects. Brief project and site teams on project quality plans, inspection and test plans, Fieldview records, RAMS, hold points, non-conformances and handover evidence. Support the nominated BOPAS Responsible Person with audits, corrective action and evidence retention.

Each allocated live BOPAS project must have a named Site Manager, deputy or escalation contact and defined management support. Confirm and record cover where the Site Manager is absent for more than one working day. Where no Site Engineer is allocated, document how setting out, inspections and quality evidence will be maintained.

Do not permit a critical inspection hold point to be passed without competent inspection and completed records. Use Fieldview or an authorised alternative. Subcontractor supervisors may only certify critical hold points where specifically authorised and supported by HadleyFRAME review evidence. Escalate missing evidence, repeated non-conformances and certification or warranty risk promptly.

Coordinate site non-conformance reporting, root cause reviews, corrective action and lessons learned. Refer design changes, substitutions and departures from the BOPAS assessed system to the authorised Technical and BOPAS roles before implementation. The Head of Construction cannot approve technical departures or change certification scope by virtue of this role.

Operate within the current Group and HadleyFRAME delegation of authority. Escalate commitments, settlements, changes and contractual matters outside those limits to the Construction Director or BUD. Retain authority to stop unsafe work and suspend affected work where required inspection or quality controls are absent, notifying the appropriate manager promptly.

###### Key Results and Measures of Success

- Allocated projects deliver agreed milestones with credible programmes, accurate progress reports and recovery action where required.
- Project and site teams have clear accountability, competent supervision and recorded cover, with capacity gaps identified before they affect delivery.
- Safety and regulatory controls are implemented and verified, with incidents and concerns reported openly and corrective actions closed promptly.
- Critical hold points and inspection evidence are completed before acceptance; non-conformances, defects and rework are controlled and lessons applied.
- CVR inputs and cost to complete assessments are timely and evidenced, with changes and delays recorded promptly to support Commercial.
- Commissioning and handover records are complete, client concerns are resolved and post completion obligations are progressed.

Mission 
As a Lead Product Manager on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.
Your main responsibilities will include:
• Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles: core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
• Own LiveOps end-to-end. You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
• Lead your team. You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
• Oversee the monetization model. Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
• Drive growth, in partnership with UA. You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
• Cross-functional excellence. You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
• Set the bar. Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
• Stay hands-on when it counts. This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.

This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

Product & RPG expertise
• Product experience on live F2P mobile games, ideally RPG/midcore, with end-to-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
• Strong fluency in RPG mechanics and meta systems: progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
• Ideally, you’ve taken a title from concept/pre-launch through launch and LiveOps, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

• Deep LiveOps experience, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
• Strong track record owning features end-to-end: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of what a live team can realistically ship and maintain, balancing ambition with feasibility.

job_title: Head of EMEA Quality & Food Safety
job_description:
Hey! We're Huel, and we're pleased to meet you 👋
Our culture thrives on high performance, and we set the bar high for new Hueligans who join us.
We invite you to read the advert below for our new Head of EMEA Quality & Food Safety position to understand the role, and explore our 7 Huel values before applying to ensure we have the right working environment for you!
The role
Food Safety and Quality sit at the heart of everything we do, and we’re now looking for a Head of EMEA Quality & Food Safety to take ownership of these areas and drive our EMEA QFS agenda. As Head of EMEA Quality & Food Safety, you’ll be accountable for driving our EMEA QFS strategic plan across a complex, international manufacturing base. You’ll play a critical role in protecting our brand and our customers, while enabling Huel to scale safely across the region.
This role will be based at our HQ in Tring, UK, with regular travel to co-manufacturing partners across the UK & EU and occasionally Japan and other EMEA regions as we grow. Here is an insight into your day-to-day:
• Lead our EMEA Quality & Food Safety (QFS) function, taking overall accountability for food safety and quality across all Huel products and sites, including raw materials and co-manufacturing (RTD, Powders, Bars, Hot & Savoury and other categories).

• Lead, coach and develop a high-performing EMEA team across three direct reports and their teams, providing clear direction, building capability and ensuring strong ownership across each function.

• Define and drive our EMEA QFS strategy, delivering 'right first time' products and an outstanding consumer experience, while setting CPMU reduction targets and driving continuous improvement across all sites.

• Ensure compliance with EMEA food safety regulations and standards (BRC, FSSC 22000, SEDEX etc.), owning and continually improving our Food Safety & Quality Management Systems (HACCP, VACCP, TACCP and GFSI standards).

• Oversee our EMEA raw material suppliers and co-manufacturers, ensuring ingredients and products are safe, compliant and consistently meet Huel's standards, while building strong partnerships and a resilient supply network.

• Own the EMEA-wide co-manufacturing performance strategy, setting clear governance, KPIs and accountability across all categories and sites to drive improvements in quality, consistency and CPMU.

• Lead regulatory and food safety risk assessments across the UK, EU and wider EMEA region, including heavy metals, pesticide residues and other contaminants, translating legislation and findings into effective risk-management and compliance actions.

• Take ownership of our end-to-end testing agenda for ingredients and finished products, ensuring timely analysis, monitoring trends and driving investigations and corrective actions where needed.

• Be the key escalation point for EMEA food safety incidents and quality crises, leading decisive responses, clear stakeholder communication and escalation to the Technical Director and SLT when required.

• Work closely with Product Supply, our Milton Keynes factory team and Regulatory & Compliance to strengthen manufacturing controls, support regulatory initiatives (including DRS, PPWR and market registrations), and champion a culture of food safety and continuous improvement across Huel.

Not yet sure if this is the right role for you? Click HERE to read a more detailed job description.

What we're looking for in you
• A proven QFS leader with 10+ years' experience in the food industry (FMCG, manufacturing or retail), bringing deep knowledge of Food Safety & Quality systems across EMEA

• A brilliant people leader who knows how to build, develop and inspire multi-disciplinary technical teams, providing clear direction and structure while empowering autonomy across three direct report functions.

• Strong technical knowledge of EMEA food law, ingredients, nutrition and manufacturing processes, with the curiosity and foresight to spot emerging risks and opportunities across the region.

• Hands-on experience working with products similar to Huel's range, including powders and dry ingredient mixes, RTD/aseptic bottling, canning, bars and Hot & Savoury, within an EMEA manufacturing environment.

• A confident communicator and natural relationship builder who can influence and collaborate across NPD, Supply Chain, Logistics, Procurement and Commercial/Marketing teams, while representing Huel credibly with regulators, accreditation bodies and co-manufacturing partners.

• A strong understanding of allergen controls, testing methodologies and limits, alongside experience working with third-party accreditation bodies to maintain high standards.

• A degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Food Technology or a related discipline. Advanced HACCP qualifications and internal/lead auditor certification (FSSC 22000 or BRC) would be a big plus!

And as always, we’re on the lookout for new Hueligans who love a fast-paced environment and are always striving to be their best. We want people who aren’t afraid to think differently and push boundaries. If you’re all about setting big goals and believe that amazing things happen through creativity and teamwork, you’ll fit right in at Huel!
What do we offer in return?
We know that at times, our teams face demanding pressures, and exceptional effort deserves meaningful rewards. That's why we've created a world-class perks and benefits program designed to support our Hueligans in achieving their best, both professionally and personally, while celebrating the global impact they're making!
🕖 Hybrid working - We spend Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office together. The remaining two days have the option to be worked from home.
🌴 30 days annual leave PLUS bank holidays
🥤 Free Huel to keep you going
🏖️ 2 weeks a year to work remotely from anywhere! 
🐾 Dog friendly
🙋 Paid Volunteering Days
🏋️ Free on-site gym with free classes, and we will give you your own nutrition plan
🧘 Free on-site wellness area offering infrared saunas and an ice bath🧘
🧠 Free 1-on-1 therapy provided by Self-Space.
🏥 Private Medical and Health insurance for you and your loved ones, including free life insurance covering up to 4x your salary
⚡ Electric Car Scheme with onsite charging
🚴 Cycle to Work Scheme
🤰 Enhanced Family Leave
👪 Workplace Nursery Scheme
💸 Paid Employee Referral Scheme
🎉 Biannual events to celebrate success - Have you heard about Huelchella?
We are Hueligans
We know diversity isn’t just important... it’s essential. It makes us stronger, sharper, and better at what we do. At Huel, we’re about people, not just sustainable nutrition - real people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
We celebrate what makes each of us unique and we actively bring together Hueligans from all walks of life. Because whilst we share the same 7 values, it’s our differences that power our thinking, challenge our ideas, and help us build better products for a global community.
Belonging matters here. So does fairness. We want every Hueligan to have the opportunity to thrive, contribute, and be heard - no matter where they come from or what path they’ve taken to get here.
We don’t just welcome diversity of thought…we go looking for it!
Meet our teams here.

Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Robotics Applied Research Lead establishes and leads Humanoid’s AI research and engineering function.

You decide which Physical AI data problems we work on, define how we test them, and stay directly involved in the most important technical work. You connect four areas that often sit apart:

 1. Multimodal and embodied data

 2. Transformer-based models and how data impacts robot policies

 3. Rigorous offline and real-world evaluation of policies

 4. Deployment of models in the data ecosystem

This is a player-coach role. In the first year, at least half of your time is direct technical work: designing models and experiments, reviewing or writing code, inspecting data, debugging training, examining failures, and reviewing robot rollouts.

You will also build a small research and engineering team. Add people only when the work requires them.




MANDATE

Turn Humanoid data and technical access into measurable advances in Physical AI systems.

You own the answers, and the evidence, to questions such as:

 - Which model families should we train, adapt, or evaluate?

 - Which data produces meaningful gains in robot performance?

 - What coverage, sensors, annotations, and quality controls do the models require?

 - Which offline measurements predict real-world robot performance?

 - Where should we adapt existing open models rather than train from scratch?

 - What should Humanoid build itself, and what should it reuse or obtain through partners?

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the technical direction: Define a focused research and engineering roadmap. Select a small number of high-value bets with clear hypotheses, baselines, milestones, and stop criteria. Decide what we build, adapt, license, or access through partners. Drop work that no longer has a strong case. Likely scope includes vision-language-action models, multimodal Transformers, robot foundation models, action representation, imitation and reinforcement learning, world models, cross-embodiment transfer, data-efficient adaptation, and robot-policy evaluation.

 - Own Transformer research and engineering: Design, adapt, train, and evaluate Transformer-based systems for embodied tasks. Make the architecture and training decisions yourself. Start from strong existing models and baselines. Train from scratch only when evidence supports the cost. Build or review the critical code.

 - Connect models to data strategy: Define the data needed to train and evaluate the selected models. Specify sensors, modalities, annotations, mixtures, and quality controls. Measure the effect of data quality, diversity, and composition on model behavior. Distinguish data volume from data value. You set technical data requirements; you do not run annotation workforces or field collection.

 - Own evaluation: Establish offline and real-world evaluation systems, baselines, held-out conditions, and release gates. Guard against leakage, overfitting, and weak success definitions. Compare offline metrics with real-robot outcomes. A benchmark score alone is not a successful result. The evaluation must support a decision.

 - Move work onto physical systems: Take projects from problem definition through training, hardware integration, and real-world testing. Design safe test plans and staged deployment. Analyse failures across data, perception, model, control, hardware, and environment. Validate material claims on physical systems.

 - Build a small technical team: Recruit a few complementary researchers and engineers. Lead architecture, experiment, code, and failure reviews. Keep the team focused on validated results, not paper count, benchmark theatre, or headcount.

 - Represent the function and own responsible development: Explain the strategy to customers, partners, and investors. Convert customer needs into testable technical requirements. State uncertainty and limits clearly. Define safety constraints, supervision, and rollback paths for physical trials. Require reproducible evidence before making capability or safety claims.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Deep, direct Transformer expertise: This is a hard requirement. You must have personally made material architecture or training decisions in one or more substantial Transformer-based systems, such as vision Transformers, VLMs, VLAs, multimodal foundation models, Decision Transformers, diffusion Transformers, video Transformers, world models, or Transformer-based perception, planning, or control. You should be able to explain, in detail, how you represented inputs and outputs, tokenized data, fused modalities, structured attention and temporal context, chose losses, built the data mixture, distributed and monitored training, diagnosed failures, and what you personally changed and why it affected task performance. Using hosted model APIs, prompting language models, or running an unchanged public training recipe does not meet this requirement.

 - Physical AI or embodied-system experience: You have worked on machine learning for a system that perceives or acts in the physical world: robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, industrial automation, manipulation, mobile robots, humanoids, wearable or egocentric systems, or similar. At least one substantial project progressed beyond an offline dataset into a real or operational physical system. Simulation-only experience is not sufficient unless you also owned credible sim-to-real transfer and physical validation.

 - Hands-on technical ability: You write and review high-quality Python. You work directly with PyTorch or an equivalent framework. You can read unfamiliar model and training code, design and debug experiments, inspect failures and rollout traces, work with large multimodal datasets, and make informed decisions about compute, memory, latency, and cost.

 - Technical leadership: You have set direction for important technical work: a research or engineering group, a major model or robotics programme, or a cross-functional project you owned. You have hired or mentored researchers or engineers, made architecture and resource decisions, stopped weak work, and taken a result into deployment. A management title is not required. Direct ownership is.

 - Evaluation, communication, and judgment: You design held-out tests, run controlled comparisons, find leakage and confounds, and report results with appropriate uncertainty. You separate evidence from belief, state what remains unknown, and reduce broad research questions to testable work.

 - Strong preference - Computer Vision: We are particularly interested in candidates who combine deep expertise in Transformer architectures with a strong background in computer vision. Relevant experience may include visual representation learning, vision-language models (VLMs), video and temporal modelling, object detection, segmentation, tracking, multi-view and egocentric vision, 3D and spatial reasoning, pose estimation, calibration, localisation, sensor fusion, or real-time vision systems.

 - Education: A PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics, computer science or a related field is valuable but not required. An equivalent record of original model work, technical leadership, and real-system delivery is sufficient. We care more about what you personally designed, trained, tested, and deployed than about a specific degree or number of years.




NICE-TO-HAVE:

 - Technical expertise: Experience with VLA or robotic foundation models, action generation, diffusion or flow-matching policies, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, world models, robotic manipulation, cross-embodiment training, sim-to-real transfer, distributed training, ROS 2, or safety-critical systems.

 - Additional experience: Research publications, open-source contributions, early-stage company experience, or direct collaboration with technical customers and research partners.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive equity: stock options with meaningful upside as we scale.

 - 30+ paid days off, including 23 days of annual leave, all UK bank holidays, and additional company closure days (including Christmas–New Year shutdown).

 - Private healthcare, including virtual and in-person care.

 - Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings.

 - Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office.

 - Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics.

 - Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.
