Applications are also welcome from candidates based elsewhere in the UK; however, travel to the London office will be required as and when needed to meet business demands.

The Role:

The Associate Manager - Cyber Security Incident Response will play a key role in managing and responding to security incidents within WTW’s Global Cyber Security Incident Response Team. Responsibilities of this role will include:

- Serve as the primary lead for significant security incidents, coordinating response efforts across technical and business teams to minimize impact and ensure timely resolution.
- Establish, refine, and maintain incident response processes, playbooks, and workflows to align with industry best practices and WTW’s organizational needs.
- Act as the central point of contact for incident response activities, ensuring effective communication with internal and external stakeholders, including senior leadership, Legal, HR, and Compliance teams.
- Leverage AI and automation to accelerate incident containment, response, and remediation — embedding AI-assisted triage, alert enrichment, and decision support into SOAR playbooks and response workflows
- Lead the in-depth technical investigation of security incidents escalated from the SOC, ensuring timely containment, eradication, and recovery while identifying root causes and potential impact.
- Adept at leading global response teams, integrating SIEM/SOAR platforms, and collaborating with MSSPs to mitigate cloud-native and supply chain attack.
- Work closely with SOC, Threat Hunting, CTI, Insider Threat, and Vulnerability Management teams to ensure seamless coordination and information sharing during incidents.
- Lead root cause analysis and post-incident reviews to identify gaps, implement lessons learned, and enhance the overall incident response program.
- Evaluate and prioritize incidents based on potential impact and severity, escalating issues to higher levels of management or other teams as required.
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure the effectiveness of incident response processes.
- Act as a liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, ensuring clear communication during incidents and status updates.

Qualifications

What you'll bring: 

We are looking for a candidate for Cyber Security Incident Response who has the following:

- Strong work experience in SOC or incident response, with a strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, frameworks, and tools.
- Understanding of AI/ML applications in security operations, including AI-augmented detection, triage, and response automation.
- Awareness of AI-specific threats and incident types (prompt injection, model/data poisoning, sensitive-data exposure via GenAI), and familiarity with OWASP LLM Top 10 / MITRE ATLAS.
- Hands-on cloud incident response across Azure, AWS, and/or GCP, including cloud-native log sources (Azure Activity/Entra ID sign-in logs, AWS CloudTrail) and the reality that cloud IR differs from on-prem.
- Proven ability to lead high-stakes security incidents and coordinate cross-functional teams effectively.
- Deep understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, cyber kill chain, and incident response methodologies.
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including executives.
- A proactive and decisive mindset with the ability to operate under pressure.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to make informed decisions in complex situations.
- Collaborative and adaptable, with a passion for mentoring and developing team members.

🚀 ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with a front-end focus who has experience working with commercial. You’ll turn a marketing campaign, a pricing test or a new product launch into a fast, reliable experience, then measure whether it worked.

Your main focus will be zoe.com http://zoe.com and our acquisition and conversion journeys, including landing pages, checkout, sign-up and product launches across our app subscriptions and physical products. You’ll spend most of your time in TypeScript, React and Next.js, and you’ll work in our backend services (Kotlin or Python) whenever a feature needs it.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We’re looking for someone who works autonomously, makes sound decisions independently and takes full ownership of their work.




💻 OUR STACK

 - Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, React, GraphQL

 - Backend: Kotlin / Spring Boot, Python / FastAPI and Django

 - Tools: DatoCMS / headless CMS, Optimizely / AB testing tools, Grafana, Sentry, Firebase Auth

Our wider Engineering team is a distributed across the UK and EU, with skills spanning web, mobile and backend engineering, machine learning, data science and analytics.  - Building a fast, high-converting zoe.com http://zoe.com: owning web performance, accessibility and conversion across key journeys such as landing pages, sign-up and checkout.

 - Adapting to changing priorities: making pragmatic trade-offs when plans change, and helping the team decide what to build, what to defer and what to drop.

 - Working across the stack: shaping APIs and making backend changes where growth features need them, in Kotlin or Python.

 - Have hands-on experience with experimentation and analytics, such as A/B testing, conversion optimisation or funnel analysis.

# Cross-Line of Business Underwriting Product Owner

137581

 **Working hours:** This role is available on a part-time, job-share or full-time basis.

**Location:** London or Whiteley

**Closing date for applications:** 10th November 2026

**The opportunity**

We’re looking for an experienced and influential Cross-Line of Business (LoB) Underwriting Product Owner to help shape the future of Zurich’s underwriting platforms, including Neo Pre-Bind and Z-Horizon+. This is a high-impact role at the centre of underwriting transformation, providing clear business ownership, prioritisation and decision-making across multiple Lines of Business, segments and geographies.

You’ll will play a critical role in ensuring that common underwriting capabilities are designed once, reused wherever possible and delivered in line with the CAPDAN principle: Common as Possible, Different as Needed. By aligning senior stakeholders, delivery teams and underwriting communities, this role will help reduce fragmentation, improve delivery confidence and protect the business value and return on investment into our strategic platforms.

Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need.

**What will you be doing?** 

- Own and maintain the cross-LOB underwriting vision and drive business strategy to bring a clear underwriting view to future priorities, including for theNeo Pre-Bind and Z-Horizon+ roadmaps – considering the needs and opportunities for UW tooling today, and how those will evolve as technologies like AI rapidly expand
- Provide clear business direction and prioritisation to Business Analysts, delivery teams, platform teams and change stakeholders.
- Apply CAPDAN consistently to ensure common underwriting capabilities are standardised and reused wherever possible.
- Engage and align senior stakeholders across Group, Business Units, Lines of Business and underwriting communities.
- Manage competing priorities and resolve conflicts between local requirements and enterprise-wide outcomes.
- Shape and prioritise the cross-LOB underwriting backlog, ensuring requirements are clear aligned to business priorities.
- Work closely with post-bind, operations, technology and change teams to ensure an aligned end-to-end underwriting journey.
- Own execution of business case preparation, investment prioritisation and tracking of expected benefits and value realisation.
- Champion adoption by ensuring delivered capabilities are embedded into day-to-day underwriting practice.

**What are we looking for?**

- Strong experience of underwriting processes, ideally across multiple Lines of Business, segments or business units.
- Experience in strategic thinking and vision setting, ideally in the context of solutions to support the UW community
- Ability to consider the needs and opportunities for UW tooling today, and how those will evolve as technologies like AI rapidly expand
- Proven ability to operate as a Product Owner, business lead or transformation owner in a complex change environment.
- Experience shaping product roadmaps, prioritising backlogs and working closely with business, technology and delivery teams.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence, challenge and align senior leaders.

Strong judgement and decision-making capability, including the ability to make balanced decisions in ambiguous or time-sensitive situations.

- A practical understanding of standardisation, reusability and process optimisation across large-scale platforms or operating models.
- Clear and structured communication skills, with the ability to translate complex business and platform topics into actionable priorities.
- Experience working across levels (including C-suite) in large, international or matrixed organisations would be an advantage.
- Professional underwriting qualifications or relevant product, agile or change delivery certifications would be beneficial.

**Why join us?**

This is a rare opportunity to take on a visible and strategically important role in a major underwriting transformation programme. You will work with senior stakeholders across the business, influence how Zurich’s underwriting platforms evolve, and help deliver more efficient and insights-driven underwriting journeys across the enterprise.

**About you**

You will be commercially minded, delivery-focused and confident working at the intersection of underwriting, technology and transformation. You will bring the credibility to engage senior stakeholders, the structure to create clarity from complexity, and the judgement to balance local needs with enterprise-wide outcomes.

**What will you get in return?**

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday, alongside a range of other flexible benefits

You can find out more about our wide range of [employee benefits on our website](https://www.zurich.co.uk/careers/working-at-zurich/zurich-employee-benefits).

**Who we are**

At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. Together, we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

With over 65,000 employees, you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company that is a long-standing player in the insurance industry.

We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee: to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

If you’re interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment where your creativity, ideas and contributions are recognised and rewarded, Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

**Our culture**

At Zurich, our strength comes from the diverse experiences, perspectives and talents of our people. Our goal is to create a workplace where every employee can flourish and where everyone feels valued, heard and respected.

Over a quarter of our employees are members of at least one of our inclusion communities (Employee Resource Groups), with groups focused on areas such as social mobility and cultural awareness. We’re proud to have received [numerous industry awards](https://www.zurich.co.uk/about-us/awards) recognising our [diversity and inclusion](https://www.zurich.co.uk/about-us/diversity-and-inclusion) policies and initiatives.

We’ve created an environment that places real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide practical advice and access to a wide range of lifestyle support, alongside opportunities to learn, grow and develop the skills needed for the future.

We actively support our employees to give back to their communities through volunteering and charitable activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest‑established corporate trusts in the UK. Together, we’ve supported causes across the UK through grants and volunteering, contributing over £100 million in funding and volunteered time.

**Your application**

We’re committed to treating all applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, sexual orientation, disability or any other protected characteristic.

As an inclusive employer we also want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.

We’d love it if you could submit your application online. If you require an alternative method of applying, please send an email to [recruitment@uk.zurich.com](mailto:recruitment@uk.zurich.com)

**So, make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.**  

 The financials

 Time away

Zyte is looking for a Quality Engineer to join our unified Quality Engineering function. This is an automation-first, AI-native role embedded directly within our engineering squads.

You will be responsible for designing risk-based test strategies, rapidly converting them into automated checks using AI-assisted development workflows, and continuously improving the quality, speed, and reliability of software delivery. Quality at Zyte is not a gatekeeping function. It is an engineering discipline focused on preventing defects, accelerating delivery, and increasing confidence in every release.

AI coding agents are a core part of how we work. You will be expected to use Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development environments as your primary development partner for generating, reviewing, debugging, refactoring, and maintaining automation code.

- Design risk-based test strategies for new features and releases, then rapidly convert those strategies into automated coverage using AI-assisted development workflows
- Use Claude Code within VS Code or equivalent AI coding agents as your primary development environment to generate, scale, and maintain automated test coverage
- Build and maintain automated test suites using Playwright, integrated within GitHub CI/CD pipelines, ensuring quality gates are embedded throughout the software development lifecycle
- Design and implement agentic testing workflows that generate, adapt, and maintain automated tests using AI models and APIs
- Build reusable frameworks, utilities, shared libraries, and AI-powered tools that increase test authoring velocity across engineering teams
- Partner closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to shift quality left, influencing requirements, design decisions, observability, and deployment strategies
- Continuously improve test suite health by reducing flakiness, increasing execution speed, and ensuring reliable quality signals for every release
- Drive quality upstream by identifying risks early and implementing preventative quality practices
- Own and improve quality metrics including automated coverage growth, escaped defects, test execution performance, flakiness rates, and release confidence
- Enable developers to write, execute, and maintain automated tests as part of their daily workflow

- Strong experience with modern test automation frameworks, preferably Playwright
- Demonstrated ability to use AI coding agents as a primary development partner for generating, reviewing, debugging, refactoring, and maintaining code
- Comfortable delegating significant portions of implementation work to AI agents while maintaining high engineering and quality standards
- Experience building and maintaining scalable automation frameworks
- Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar platforms
- Experience with agentic testing frameworks, AI-powered testing tools, or LLM API integrations within engineering workflows
- Proven track record of increasing automation coverage, reducing manual effort, and improving software quality outcomes
- Strong understanding of quality engineering principles, test strategy, risk analysis, and defect prevention
- Comfortable working as an embedded engineer within cross-functional product squads
- Strong communication skills with the ability to provide concise, actionable updates and collaborate effectively across teams
- Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset toward emerging AI technologies and engineering practices

### Nice to Have

- Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-generated outputs
- Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI quality assessment, and AI observability
- Experience with performance, load, or resilience testing

- Experience building internal developer platforms, testing tools, or engineering productivity solutions

### Success in This Role

Within your first six months, you will:

- Reduce manual testing effort sprint over sprint
- Build reusable automation components adopted by multiple teams
- Demonstrate effective use of AI agents to accelerate automation development and maintenance
- Improve release confidence while supporting fast, reliable software delivery
- Contribute to a culture where quality is owned by the entire engineering team

About Zyte

Zyte is a leader in web data extraction. Our full-stack Zyte API and world-class data services help thousands of companies, from individual developers to global enterprises, turn the web into reliable, structured data. We're a remote-first, globally distributed team that ships fast and lets results speak.

This is a transformative moment for web data, and AI is reshaping both sides of the market. The world needs web data more than ever: to train models, power agents and feed AI applications, so the audience for web data is exploding - creating new personas and new buying journeys almost overnight. At the same time AI is changing how that data is collected - from manual work by engineers to automation with AI.

Zyte is unique in solving both challenges of web data - the software needed for reliable access to websites and the AI and skills needed to turn web content into structured data. We have an important mission in the AI revolution.

The role

We're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to lead our self-serve acquisition and growth journeys across the channels used by personas hungry for web data. Our users are engineers, data teams and the builders of AI agents, and your job is to understand what they seek, what they try first and what convinces them to stay.

You'll lead conversion and growth across channels: our website, agents an the developer ecosystem. You'll be product owner for the website and application UI and will take a data driven approach to customer acquisition and growth, from traffic through trial, activation and subscription, right up to an account-managed relationship.

Our goal is to engage 500,000 developers next year who need web data and this role is central to converting them. In this role you'll shape the rhythm of funnels and experiments, ideating and iterating with a talented team on how we can improve experiences, find truths in data and build on the insight of customers to figure out the next growth step. You'll be fascinated by how engineers evaluate tools, how AI is changing the way they build and what it takes to earn their trust. You'll work to explode an audience in a market that is itself exploding, and to be able to point at the growth curve and say "I did that".

What you'll do

Manage the self-serve funnel end-to-end. Define, measure and improve every stage: signup, trial, activation, conversion to paid and expansion.

Be product owner for the website and product UI. Set the roadmap and priorities for our web presence and platform UX, working directly with the development lead, engineers and designers to ship improvements that capture demand and drive funnel activity.

Optimise the funnel as a conversion mechanism - design and run experiments, work closely with our design and product marketing teams on formats, copy and narratives for conversion.

Optimise PLG journeys that start in the developer ecosystem. Optimise the buying journeys that begin in open source and in the emerging ecosystems of agents, turning developer adoption and ecosystem presence into activation and growth. This means deeply understanding developer workflows: docs, SDKs, code examples and the first ten minutes of hands-on experience.

Build intelligent customer data and nurture growth. Build customer data based on usage and firmographics, and use this to nurture customers for growth with tailored onboarding, relevant content and (with our RevOps function) identify when our sales professionals should reach out and make contact. . 

Run a rigorous experimentation practice. Develop hypotheses, ship A/B tests and funnel experiments, and report results honestly, doubling down on what works and killing what doesn't.

## Requirements

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; you can align marketing, product, CS, RevOps and sales around a shared funnel.

About the Job

Reverse engineering is at the heart of how Zyte stays ahead in the banning war. We've cracked some of the hardest antibots on the web — but the ground shifts weekly: antibots ship new sensor formats overnight, obfuscation schemes mutate, and new fingerprinting surfaces appear faster than any team could chase by hand.

This role is not about solving tickets one at a time. It's about building the tools, pipelines, and automation that let both engineers and AI agents solve them at scale. You will be the person who turns a reverse-engineering breakthrough into reusable tooling, who automates the investigation that used to take days into a readout that takes minutes, and who feeds the intelligence our AI systems learn from. You'll work at the intersection of deep JS/VM reverse engineering and modern AI-assisted engineering — using LLMs and agentic tooling aggressively to compress the loop between "new detection surface discovered" and "solution shipped."

If you're energized by wielding AI to multiply your own output, by automating away manual toil, and by working on problems where the adversary is smart and the target moves — this is the seat.

Roles & Responsibilities

- Reverse-engineer the hardest antibot and fingerprinting systems on the web, across JS VMs, WASM, and polymorphic/obfuscated code.
- Build the JS function tracing, deobfuscation pipelines, and fingerprint-inspection tooling that turn manual reverse-engineering investigations into fast, repeatable, largely automated workflows.
- Use AI aggressively — LLMs, agents, and custom automation — to deobfuscate, classify, and diagnose detection surfaces, and to rapidly prototype and ship tooling that previously would have taken weeks.
- Build and maintain website intel pipelines with checkpointed history, so that when an antibot ships an update we diff against a known-good baseline instead of rediscovering the problem from scratch.
- Feed our AI reverse-engineering and ban-resolution systems the context, signals, and structured intelligence they need to autonomously resolve the majority of cases.
- Codify one-off reverse-engineering wins into durable capability — tools, rules, and pipelines usable by other engineers and by AI agents alike.
- Collaborate across engineering to fold your tooling into the custom browser and automation stack, and mentor others in AI-augmented reverse-engineering technique.

Requirements

- A hacker mindset — able to rapidly develop proof-of-concepts and working tools to get to a result, and comfortable with the inherent uncertainty and open-endedness of the work.
- Demonstrated use of AI tooling (LLMs, coding agents, automation) to accelerate your own engineering, with a strong instinct for what to automate and when.
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js and Python, with a broad programming background and exceptional problem-solving ability.
- Strong research, debugging, fuzzing, and reverse-engineering skills, including static, dynamic, and concolic analysis.
- Hands-on experience reversing JavaScript VMs, WASM, and heavily obfuscated or polymorphic code.
- A deep understanding of operating systems and computer networking concepts.
- Adept with tools such as Wireshark, Burp Suite, and similar for intercepting and debugging network traffic.
- Understanding of browser engines, browser fingerprinting, and antibot/anti-scraping mechanisms.
- Approach prioritization logically and with a measurement-backed strategy, and thrive in a collaborative environment.

Bonus points for

- Experience with reverse-engineering tools like IDA, Ghidra, Frida, or Babel.
- Experience building tooling or pipelines that feed machine-learning or AI systems.
- Experience with C/C++ and Rust.
- Core contributions to Mozilla or Chromium projects.

Benefits

By joining the Zyte team, you will:

- Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team
- Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work
- Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe
- Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools
